This challenge is pronounced in visual RL, where high-dimensional inputs often obscure learning signals. While prior work in visual RL has focused on algorithmic solutions, such as better dynamics models or exploration strategies, recent advances in state-based RL show that architectural design alone can lead to significant gains in sample efficiency. This raises an important question: Can these architectural principles transfer to visual RL? In response, we introduce V-Simba, a simple yet effective visual RL architecture inspired by the Simba architecture from state-based RL. Built on top of Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) with data augmentation, V-Simba modifies the architecture by adding normalization layers to stabilize training and using pointwise convolutions to reduce computation. Despite its simplicity, V-Simba matches or outperforms the state-of-the-art methods across the DMC, Adroit, and Meta-World benchmarks, while being more computationally efficient than DrQ-v2. We make our code publicly available at https://github.com/DAVIAN-Robotics/V-Simba.

AI.tldr: V-Simba是受状态空间RL中Simba架构启发的视觉RL架构，通过添加归一化层和逐点卷积，在SAC+数据增强基础上实现了与SOTA方法相当或更优的性能，且比DrQ-v2更高效。
AI.motivation: 视觉RL中高维输入掩盖学习信号导致样本效率低下，先前工作多聚焦算法改进（动力学模型、探索策略），但状态空间RL的最新研究表明架构设计本身就能显著提升样本效率。本文旨在探究这些架构原则能否迁移到视觉RL领域。
AI.method: 在Soft Actor-Critic (SAC)结合数据增强的基础上，借鉴Simba架构设计了V-Simba。具体修改包括：(1)添加归一化层以稳定训练过程；(2)使用逐点卷积（pointwise convolutions）降低计算开销。
AI.result: 在DMC、Adroit和Meta-World三个基准上，V-Simba匹配或超越了现有最先进方法，同时计算效率高于DrQ-v2。
AI.conclusion: 架构设计原则可以成功从状态空间RL迁移到视觉RL，简单架构修改即可带来显著的样本效率提升，无需复杂的算法创新。

title: Contextual Value Alignment via Multilayer Combinatorial Fusion
summary:
Aligning large language models (LLMs) with human values remains a major challenge, especially for trustworthy AI. While existing approaches such as RLHF, CAI, and their variants have achieved promising results, they often rely on a single-agent framework and a unified reward system. This limits their ability to capture ethical pluralism, adapt to diverse moral contexts, and reflect the dynamics of multi-agent moral reasoning.
  In this work, we propose a framework that utilizes multilayer combinatorial fusion for contextual value alignment (MCF-CVA). At the first layer of the framework, it instantiates multiple moral agents, each fine-tuned to represent a distinctive value. Their outputs are then expanded combinatorially using both score- and rank-combinations as well as average and weighted aggregations. These combined models are then reduced to the same number of initial moral agents. This expansion and reduction (EAR) process continues for multi-layers until a stopping criterion is reached.
  The MCF-CVA framework leverages cognitive diversity between agents to mitigate conflicts and redundancies across multiple agents, producing responses that better reflect contextual human values. The framework using the EAR algorithm is performed on the dual architecture of Euclidean score space and Kemeny rank space. Empirical evaluations demonstrated that the proposed framework outperforms single-agent baselines, multi-agent single-layer results, and previous aggregation approaches on standard metrics, showing that the MCF-CVA framework provides a robust and effective mechanism for advancing contextual value alignment in LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MCF-CVA框架，利用多层组合融合实现大语言模型的上下文价值对齐。该框架实例化多个代表不同价值观的道德智能体，通过分数组合与排名组合在欧几里得分数空间和Kemeny排名空间中进行扩展-缩减（EAR）的多层循环，利用智能体间的认知多样性减少冲突和冗余，最终在标准指标上优于单智能体基线和多智能体单层方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM价值对齐方法（如RLHF、CAI及其变体）多依赖单智能体框架和统一奖励系统，难以捕捉道德多元主义、适应多样化的道德情境，也无法反映多智能体道德推理的动态性。
AI.method: MCF-CVA框架采用多层组合融合：第一层实例化多个分别针对不同价值观微调的道德智能体；随后通过分数组合和排名组合（包含平均值和加权聚合）对输出进行组合式扩展；再将组合模型精简还原为与初始相同数量的道德智能体。该扩展-缩减（EAR）过程在欧几里得分数空间和Kemeny排名空间的双架构上持续多层迭代，直至满足停止准则。
AI.result: 实证评估表明，该框架在标准指标上优于单智能体基线、多智能体单层结果以及以往的聚合方法，证明了MCF-CVA框架在推进LLM上下文价值对齐方面的鲁棒性和有效性。
AI.conclusion: 利用智能体间的认知多样性解决多智能体间的冲突和冗余问题，能够使LLM生成更贴合上下文人类价值观的响应，为可信AI中的价值对齐提供了一种稳健有效的多智能体融合机制。

title: Direct Search Methods for Online Nonconvex Optimization Under Inexact Bandit Feedback
summary: Optimization under zeroth-order (i.e., bandit) feedback is central to many engineering problems where the analytic forms of objectives and/or constraints are unavailable. In modern applications, such as online control and online learning, optimization problems often evolve with time, requiring adaptive optimization methodologies. Yet, existing methods in this seting are largely confined to adaptations of methodologies developed for time-invariant or first-order optimization, and thus often rely on gradient surrogates that fail to fully exploit the zeroth-order structure of the available information. In this paper, we propose a randomized two-point direct-search algorithm for nonconvex time-varying optimization and derive iteration-complexity bounds under both constant and diminishing probing ratios. The resulting analysis yields explicit stationarity bounds in terms of the temporal variability of the problem and possible oracle errors. Our complexity bounds recover the complexity of existing zeroth-order methods in the time-invariant setting, while extending direct- search methods beyond static settings. As an illustrative application, we show that the methodology is naturally suited to solve optimal (equilibrium-selection) control problems for dynamical systems. In this setting, the analysis yields explicit stationarity bounds in terms of the temporal variability of the problem, measured through the effects of plant dynamics and exogenous disturbance variations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于非凸时变优化问题的随机两点直接搜索算法，并推导了在常数和递减探测比率下的迭代复杂度界，所得复杂度在时不变情境下可恢复现有零阶方法的复杂度，并拓展了直接搜索方法在动态环境下的应用。
AI.motivation: 零阶（bandit）反馈下的优化是许多无法获得目标函数和约束解析形式的工程问题的核心。在现代应用中（如在线控制和在线学习），优化问题往往随时间演化，需要自适应优化方法。然而，现有方法多局限于对时不变或一阶优化方法的改编，依赖的梯度替代方法未能充分利用零阶信息的结构特点。
AI.method: 提出一种随机两点直接搜索（randomized two-point direct-search）算法用于非凸时变优化，并在常数和递减两种探测比率设置下分析迭代复杂度。算法通过两点采样来估计搜索方向，从而利用零阶反馈的几何结构。
AI.result: 推导了以问题时间变异性和可能存在的oracle误差表示的显式平稳性界。在时不变情形下，复杂度界可恢复现有零阶方法的复杂度，同时将直接搜索方法拓展到静态设置之外。在动力系统最优（均衡选择）控制问题中，该分析的平稳性界以扰动动力学和外部扰动变化的影响来衡量问题的时间变异性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法自然适用于求解动力系统的最优（均衡选择）控制问题，其分析框架能显式刻画问题时间变异性（通过植物动力学和外生扰动变化的影响来衡量）对算法性能的影响，拓展了直接搜索算法在动态和非平稳场景中的适用范围。

title: When Can Fraud Operations Authorize Automation? A Decision-Support Framework for Fresh Audit Evidence and Review Workload
summary: Fraud operations must allocate events among automatic approval, analyst review, and automatic blocking even though the labels needed to evaluate these actions are selective and delayed. Predictive scores order cases, but they do not show whether the evidence is current and representative enough to delegate an action to the model. We develop freshness-constrained audit capacity (FCAC), a decision-support framework that treats automation as an authorization decision constrained by action risk, evidence freshness, and shared review capacity. It evaluates candidate action regions from mature randomized audits and a prespecified temporal allowance. Supported regions are automated; unsupported regions remain in review. The resulting decision record reports evidence age, audit demand, total review workload, value exposure, and compatible temporal change. We show that current action risk is unidentified without restricting unobserved label evolution. Under representative randomized audits, label-independent evidence windows, and a prespecified condition linking historical and current action risk, we derive simultaneous finite-sample control of unsafe authorization. Chronological evaluations with simulated audits on IEEE-CIS, ULB-Worldline, and Elliptic++ yield zero-drift automation rates of 84.4%, 67.4%, and 81.3%, with total review workloads of 24.1%, 46.0%, and 43.1%. The experiments reveal an audit-capacity trade-off: sparse auditing delays authorization, whereas intensive auditing eventually increases workload. A separately specified BAF stress test further indicates that fallback thresholds must reflect candidate-specific evidence rather than a common fraction of the risk limit. These findings identify audit freshness and analyst capacity as joint design considerations for fraud decision support.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"新鲜度约束审计容量"(FCAC)决策支持框架，将欺诈操作中的自动化视为受行动风险、证据新鲜度和共享复核容量约束的授权决策。在代表性随机审计和标签无关证据窗口等假设下，可实现对不安全授权的同步有限样本控制。在三个数据集上实现了84.4%/67.4%/81.3%的零漂移自动化率。
AI.motivation: 欺诈运营需要在自动审批、分析师复核和自动拦截之间分配事件，但评估这些行动所需的标签是选择性的且延迟到达的。预测分数只能对案例排序，无法判断证据是否足够新鲜和具有代表性以授权模型执行行动。现有方法未能将证据新鲜度作为自动化授权的关键约束来考虑。
AI.method: 提出FCAC框架，将自动化视为受行动风险、证据新鲜度和共享复核容量约束的授权决策。从成熟的随机审计和预设时间容限中评估候选行动区域，支持的区域自动化，不支持的留在复核中。在代表性随机审计、标签无关证据窗口、以及连接历史与当前行动风险的预设条件下，推导出对不安全授权的同步有限样本控制。
AI.result: 在IEEE-CIS、ULB-Worldline和Elliptic++三个数据集上的时序评估（模拟审计）中，零漂移自动化率分别为84.4%、67.4%和81.3%，总复核工作量分别为24.1%、46.0%和43.1%。实验揭示了审计容量权衡：稀疏审计延迟授权，密集审计最终增加工作量。BAF压力测试表明回退阈值须反映候选特定证据，而非风险限额的公共比例。
AI.conclusion: 审计新鲜度和分析师容量是欺诈决策支持的联合设计考量。当前行动风险在不限制未观测标签演化的情况下是不可识别的；FCAC框架为在不安全授权控制与审计资源投入之间提供了一种系统化的权衡方法。

title: Router Sensitivity Under Lightweight Fine-Tuning Identifies Prunable Experts in Mixture-of-Experts Models
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models decouple total parameters from per-token compute, but deployment still requires storing every expert. Recent theory shows that pruning experts with the smallest router-norm changes during fine-tuning can preserve accuracy, but assumes full fine-tuning. We test whether lightweight adaptation can recover this signal. We briefly fine-tune with a parameter-efficient adapter, rank experts by the induced $\ell_2$ router change, and prune the least-changed experts in one shot. On Mixtral-8$\times$7B-Instruct (44.83% MMLU-Pro), router-only LoRA trains 0.002% of parameters and outperforms all-module LoRA at matched rank with half the experts removed (27.54% vs. 24.42%); signal quality declines as adaptation spreads to attention and expert weights. Accuracy improves monotonically with LoRA rank, reaching 28.76%. IA3, which leaves router weights frozen, matches direct router adaptation, whereas unconstrained additive adapters degrade the signal. Router-guided MMLU-Pro accuracy decays quasi-linearly rather than collapsing, remains nearly 1.8 times that of magnitude-based or random pruning at maximal compression, and reduces memory by 49% and per-token latency by 37%. At 25% compression, retention is competitive with methods using full activation statistics. The criterion also transfers to Qwen1.5-MoE fine-tuned for mathematics, retaining 49.7% mean accuracy over eleven benchmarks with half the experts removed while random pruning falls to single digits. Router sensitivity under lightweight fine-tuning therefore makes provably motivated expert pruning practical at scale.

AI.tldr: 本文研究如何在混合专家（MoE）模型中通过轻量级适配（LoRA）高效地进行专家剪枝。作者发现，仅训练路由器权重（router-only LoRA，仅占参数0.002%）来识别剪枝信号，比全模块LoRA更有效，在Mixtral-8×7B-Instruct上去掉一半专家仍保持较高MMLU-Pro准确率，并实现了49%内存和37%延迟的削减；该准则还能迁移到Qwen1.5-MoE数学微调任务上。
AI.motivation: MoE模型虽然解耦了总参数量与单token计算量，但部署时仍需存储所有专家。先前理论表明在完整微调下按路由器范数变化对专家进行剪枝可保持精度，但完整微调代价高昂。作者希望验证轻量级适配是否也能捕捉到这一剪枝信号，从而使理论驱动的专家剪枝在实际中可扩展。
AI.method: 在短暂微调中使用参数高效适配器（LoRA），仅训练路由器权重，根据诱导的ℓ₂路由器变化对专家排序，然后一次性剪掉变化最小的专家。作者系统比较了router-only LoRA、all-module LoRA、IA3（冻结路由器权重）以及无约束加性适配器对剪枝信号质量的影响，并考察了LoRA秩、压缩率等因素。
AI.result: router-only LoRA（训练0.002%参数）在移除一半专家后达到27.54% MMLU-Pro，优于匹配置的全模块LoRA（24.42%）；精度随LoRA秩单调提升至28.76%。IA3与直接路由器适配效果相当，而无约束加性适配器会破坏信号。路由器引导的MMLU-Pro精度呈准线性衰减而非崩溃，在最大压缩下仍约为基于幅值或随机剪枝的1.8倍，内存减少49%、延迟降低37%。在25%压缩时与使用完整激活统计的方法竞争力相当。该准则迁移至Qwen1.5-MoE数学任务，移除一半专家仍保留49.7%平均准确率，而随机剪枝降至个位数。
AI.conclusion: 轻量级微调下的路由器敏感性可以有效识别应保留的专家，使有理论依据的专家剪枝在规模上变得实用。仅训练路由器权重（而非注意力或专家权重）是捕捉高质量剪枝信号的关键，这大幅降低了剪枝成本并实现了显著的内存与延迟收益。

title: Mendel Gödel Machine: Recursive Self-Improving Coding Agents via Comparative Evolution
comment: Project Page at https://reallcz.github.io/MGM; Code at https://github.com/RealLcz/MGM
summary: Self-improving coding agents that iteratively rewrite their own source code have demonstrated impressive performance on coding tasks. However, existing solutions generally derive self-modification from a single failure trajectory at a time, overlooking rich comparative signals available in the agent's expanding archive of past attempts. According to Mendelian principles of controlled inheritance, we introduce Mendel Gödel Machine (MGM). In addition to the general single-trajectory clonal mutation, MGM includes two new types of self-modification that better utilizes evidences accumulated: the reaction-norm mutation edits an agent based on its trajectories on multiple tasks simultaneously, and the cross-lineage hybridization edits an agent using the trajectory of a reference agent from another lineage on the same task. Under an additive fitness landscape model, we prove theoretically and demonstrate via controlled surrogate simulation that the new strategies facilitate a faster and better convergence over single-trajectory baselines. Experiments on SWE-bench and Polyglot confirm MGM's consistent improvement in performance, efficiency, and generalizability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Mendel Gödel Machine (MGM)，一种利用孟德尔遗传学原理的自我改进编码智能体，通过反应规范突变和跨谱系杂交两种新的自我修改策略，利用累积的历史轨迹证据而非单一失败轨迹来驱动代码改进，在理论和实验上均优于基线。
AI.motivation: 现有自我改进编码智能体（self-improving coding agents）通常仅从单一失败轨迹中推导自我修改，忽视了智能体已积累的大量历史尝试中蕴含的丰富比较信号（comparative signals），导致信息利用不充分，收敛速度和最终性能受限。
AI.method: 借鉴孟德尔遗传学中的受控遗传原理，MGM在传统单一轨迹克隆突变（clonal mutation）之外，引入了两种新的自我修改机制：1) 反应规范突变（reaction-norm mutation），基于智能体在多个任务上的轨迹同时进行编辑；2) 跨谱系杂交（cross-lineage hybridization），利用同一任务上另一谱系参考智能体的轨迹进行编辑。同时基于加性适应度景观模型（additive fitness landscape）提供理论证明。
AI.result: 理论分析和受控代理仿真均表明，新策略相比单轨迹基线实现了更快且更好的收敛。在SWE-bench和Polyglot基准上的实验验证了MGM在性能、效率和泛化能力上的一致提升。
AI.conclusion: MGM通过利用累积的历史比较信号而非单一失败轨迹来驱动自我修改，为自我改进编码智能体提供了一种更高效、更具泛化能力的改进范式，具有理论保障和实证支撑。

title: A Tight Lower Bound for Smooth Nonconvex Stochastic Optimization with Bounded Gradient Noise
summary: We prove a sharp lower bound for smooth nonconvex stochastic optimization with uniformly bounded gradient noise. In the \(K=1\) fresh-sample model, every randomized adaptive algorithm requires $$Ω\left( \frac{ΔL}{ε^2} + \frac{ΔLσ^2}{ε^4} \right)$$ queries to find a point with expected gradient norm at most \(ε\). This matches the standard upper bound and, to the best of our knowledge, resolves the question raised by [Arjevani et al. 2023] of whether almost-surely bounded oracle error permits a better rate than bounded variance. The proof was independently generated with GPT-5.6 Sol in Codex's Ultra mode during a two-hour session. The human author supplied the prompt and was responsible only forchecking the proof and revising and polishing the manuscript.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了在均匀有界梯度噪声条件下，光滑非凸随机优化的尖锐下界：在K=1新样本模型中，任何随机自适应算法至少需要Ω(ΔL/ε² + ΔLσ²/ε⁴)次查询才能找到期望梯度范数不超过ε的点，从而解决了一个公开问题。
AI.motivation: Arjevani等人2023年提出了一个悬而未决的问题：当随机梯度的误差几乎必然有界（而非仅有界方差）时，是否能够获得比有界方差情形更好的优化率？本文旨在通过证明下界来回答这一问题。
AI.method: 采用信息论/对抗式下界证明技术，针对K=1新鲜样本模型下的任意随机自适应算法，构造最坏情形实例，证明其查询复杂度下界为Ω(ΔL/ε² + ΔLσ²/ε⁴)。
AI.result: 证明了下界Ω(ΔL/ε² + ΔLσ²/ε⁴)，该下界与标准上界匹配，表明几乎必然有界的梯度噪声并不会比有界方差情形提供更好的优化率。论文证明过程由GPT-5.6 Sol在Codex Ultra模式下独立生成。
AI.conclusion: 该结果否定了几乎必然有界噪声可能带来更优率的猜测，解决了Arjevani等人2023年提出的开放问题，为非凸随机优化的复杂度边界提供了最终答案。

title: Provable Parameter-Free Fixed-Point Algorithms with Linear Convergence Rates
summary: In this paper, we develop provable parameter-free and adaptive fixed-point algorithms for contractive mappings, with an emphasis on automatically exploiting hidden contractivity without requiring prior knowledge of the contraction factor. Our first method is a completely parameter-free variant of the Halpern fixed-point iteration. It requires no line search, bisection, or prior estimate of the contraction factor, while retaining essentially the same per-iteration computational cost as classical fixed-point schemes. We establish explicit linear convergence rates for both the fixed-point residual and the distance to the unique fixed point. The second algorithm is an adaptive Halpern method that requires only an upper bound on the contraction factor and reduces to an existing adaptive Halpern scheme in the nonexpansive case. This method also enjoys explicit linear convergence guarantees. We further extend these ideas in two directions. First, by combining the proposed fixed-point schemes with Tikhonov regularization, we obtain a parameter-free method for solving co-coercive equations and establish an iteration complexity of $\mathcal{O}({ε^{-1}\ln(ε^{-1})})$ for computing an $ε$-solution. Second, using the relation between Halpern iterations and Nesterov's accelerated fixed-point schemes, we derive parameter-free Nesterov's accelerated variants that inherit linear convergence in the contractive setting. Numerical experiments on several examples demonstrate that the proposed algorithms are competitive with, and often outperform, existing adaptive fixed-point methods. In particular, the methods successfully exploit contractive behavior when it is present while remaining effective on nonexpansive problems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了两类可证明的、无需参数（parameter-free）和自适应的不动点算法，用于压缩映射。第一类是无需任何参数的Halpern不动点迭代变体，无需线搜索、二分法或对压缩因子的先验估计；第二类是仅需压缩因子上界的自适应Halpern方法。两种方法均具有显式线性收敛率。此外，结合Tikhonov正则化求解co-coercive方程（复杂度O(ε⁻¹ln(ε⁻¹))），并推导出参数无关的Nesterov加速变体。数值实验表明方法具有竞争力和有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有不动点算法（如Halpern迭代）通常需要预先知道压缩因子或依赖线搜索等调参机制，这在实际应用中难以满足。本文旨在开发无需先验参数即可自动利用隐藏压缩性质的不动点算法，同时保持与经典方法相近的计算成本。
AI.method: 1) 提出完全参数自由的Halpern不动点迭代变体，无需线搜索、二分或压缩因子先验估计；2) 提出仅需压缩因子上界的自适应Halpern方法，在非扩张情形下退化为已有的自适应Halpern方案；3) 将不动点算法与Tikhonov正则化结合求解co-coercive方程；4) 利用Halpern迭代与Nesterov加速不动点方案的关系，推导参数自由的Nesterov加速变体。所有方法均提供显式线性收敛率分析。
AI.result: 两种Halpern类算法均获得显式线性收敛保证（对不动点残差和到唯一不动点的距离）。对co-coercive方程达到O(ε⁻¹ln(ε⁻¹))的迭代复杂度。数值实验表明：所提方法在压缩场景下能自动利用压缩性质，竞争力强于或优于现有的自适应不动点方法，且对非扩张问题仍然有效。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明无需先验参数即可自动利用压缩映射的隐藏压缩性实现线性收敛，打破了自适应不动点算法对参数估计的依赖。该方法在理论保障（显式线性收敛率）和实际性能（数值实验优于基线）之间取得了良好平衡，为不动点迭代、正则化求解和加速方案提供了一体化的参数自由框架。

title: LLM-Based Embeddings for Program Analysis and Optimization
summary: Recent advances have highlighted the potential of machine learning, particularly Large Language Models (LLMs), for analyzing and optimizing programs. We present the first application of program embeddings from LLMCompiler---an LLM massively pretrained on intermediate representation (IR) code---to representative program analysis and optimization tasks. We generate program embeddings directly from source and IR code using a simple approach: split programs into chunks, independently embed each chunk with pretrained LLMs, and then aggregate the chunk embeddings into a single program embedding. Our experiments show that combining source and IR code embeddings achieves an error rate of 1.54\% in algorithm classification, a 12\% improvement over the current state-of-the-art, and a competitive accuracy on heterogeneous device mapping. These findings suggest that training a performance-aware LLM for embedding IR code might yield state-of-the-art results in code optimization tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文首次将基于LLMCompiler（在大规模中间表示IR代码上预训练的LLM）的程序嵌入应用于程序分析和优化任务。通过将源代码和IR代码分块嵌入并聚合，在算法分类任务上实现了1.54%的错误率，相比现有最优方法提升了12%，并在异构设备映射任务上取得了有竞争力的准确率。
AI.motivation: 已有工作表明机器学习尤其是LLM在程序分析和优化方面具有潜力，但此前尚无研究将针对IR代码预训练的LLM嵌入用于程序级分析和优化任务。作者旨在探索利用LLMCompiler这一专门在IR代码上大规模预训练的模型来生成程序嵌入，从而为代码分析和优化提供更优的表示。
AI.method: 采用简单的程序嵌入生成方法：将程序分割成若干块（chunks），使用预训练的LLM（LLMCompiler）独立嵌入每个块，然后将各块的嵌入聚合为一个单一的程序级嵌入。实验中将源代码嵌入与IR代码嵌入进行组合，用于算法分类和异构设备映射等下游任务。
AI.result: 结合源代码和IR代码嵌入在算法分类任务上达到1.54%的错误率，较当前最优方法提升12%；在异构设备映射任务上取得有竞争力的准确率。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果暗示，训练一个面向性能感知的LLM来嵌入IR代码，有望在代码优化任务中取得最先进的结果，为未来的代码嵌入和优化研究方向提供了新的思路。

title: An Agentic AI Framework Overcomes Fundamental Limitations of Large Language Models for Glaucoma Detection from Fundus Photography
summary: Large language models (LLMs) show promise in medical image interpretation but suffer from hallucination, limited accuracy, and run-to-run inconsistency. We developed and validated an agentic AI framework integrating LLMs with specialized deep learning tools for glaucoma detection from fundus photography. The workflow had three steps: (1) LLM initial assessment; (2) function calling to invoke specialized tools for image quality (QAModel, FundaQ-8), glaucoma classification (SwinV2-Tiny), and optic disc/cup segmentation (SegFormer-B0); and (3) LLM reflection integrating the initial impression with tool outputs. Two LLMs (Gemini 2.5 Flash, GPT-5.4 mini) were evaluated on two public datasets (ORIGA, n=100; RIM-ONE-v3, n=100) under uncropped and cropped fields of view; all images were independently graded by a masked fellowship-trained glaucoma specialist. The agentic workflow improved classification accuracy by 16 to 47 percentage points across all conditions, reaching within 6 points of the specialist; on RIM-ONE-v3 the best configurations matched the specialist accuracy of 88%. LLM-alone approaches failed in two ways: GPT-5.4 mini showed positive bias (sensitivity 95-100%, specificity 0-5%), while Gemini 2.5 Flash varied stochastically between runs; the agentic workflow corrected both. Cup-to-disc ratio error fell 15-50% (MAE 0.156-0.228 to 0.104-0.132), and correlation with specialist grading rose from weak (r=0.12-0.39) to moderate-strong (r=0.59-0.84). Run-to-run consistency rose from near-random (kappa as low as -0.01) to near-perfect (kappa up to 0.96). Integrating LLMs with specialized tools addressed key limitations of LLM-alone approaches, including over-diagnosis and run-to-run variability. Gains held for both LLMs, suggesting generalizability across backbones, and may signal a shift from monolithic models toward orchestrated multi-agent systems in medical AI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并验证了一个将大语言模型（LLM）与专业深度学习工具结合的智能体AI框架，用于青光眼眼底照相检测。该框架通过三步工作流（LLM初步评估→函数调用调用专业工具→LLM反思整合）将分类准确率提升16-47个百分点，显著改善了cup-to-disc ratio误差、与专家分级的相关性以及运行间一致性（kappa从接近随机提升至0.96），并证明该增益在两个不同的LLM骨干上均成立，具有较好的泛化性。
AI.motivation: 尽管LLM在医学图像解读中展现出潜力，但其存在幻觉、准确率有限和运行间不可重复性三大缺陷，严重制约了其临床应用价值。
AI.method: 构建三步智能体工作流：(1) LLM初步评估眼底照片；(2) 通过函数调用触发专业工具（QAModel/FundaQ-8图像质量评估、SwinV2-Tiny青光眼分类、SegFormer-B0视盘/视杯分割）；(3) LLM反思阶段整合初步印象与工具输出。在两个公开数据集（ORIGA、RIM-ONE-v3）上评估两个LLM（Gemini 2.5 Flash、GPT-5.4 mini），并在裁剪与未裁剪视野条件下与掩蔽的专科医师分级对比。
AI.result: 智能体工作流在所有条件下将分类准确率提升16-47个百分点，最佳配置在RIM-ONE-v3上达到与专家相当的88%准确率；CDR误差降低15-50%（MAE从0.156-0.228降至0.104-0.132）；与专家分级的相关性从弱（r=0.12-0.39）提升至中强（r=0.59-0.84）；运行间一致性从接近随机（kappa低至-0.01）提升至接近完美（kappa高达0.96）。
AI.conclusion: 将LLM与专业工具集成解决了LLM单独使用时的过诊断和运行间可变性等关键限制，且增益在两个不同LLM骨干上均成立，支持框架的跨骨干泛化性。这标志医疗AI可能从单体模型向编排式多智能体系统转变。

title: Radial-type error bounds for semidefinite feasibility problems without strict feasibility: qualitative estimates and asymptotic tightness
summary: In this paper, we develop a systematic framework for deriving explicit error bounds for semidefinite feasibility problems without assuming strict feasibility (Slater's condition), a setting in which existing results are limited. Our main technical contribution is the introduction of radial-type Hölder error bounds, where the error bound constant depends explicitly on the norm of the reference matrix through radial modulus functions. By combining facial reduction with recently developed facial residual functions, we obtain explicit descriptions of these modulus functions, yielding qualitative radial-type Hölder error bounds without imposing any constraint qualifications. Our results complement the classical work of Sturm by providing explicit estimates for the constants involved in Sturm's local Hölder error bounds over bounded sets with a given size. We further analyze the asymptotic behavior of these bounds as the dimension of the underlying matrix space grows, identifying regimes in which they can be asymptotically tight up to a dimensional-free constant. As an application, we establish explicit error bounds for the optimality system of semidefinite programs by reformulating them as feasibility problems, a setting where Slater's condition typically fails. Under the generically satisfied strict complementarity condition, we derive radial-type error bounds without assuming the usual solution uniqueness requirement, and demonstrate their asymptotic tightness through an explicit example.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种系统化框架，在不假设Slater条件（严格可行性）的情况下，为半定可行性问题推导显式误差界。通过引入径向型Hölder误差界并结合面约减与面残差函数，获得了无需约束规格的定性径向型Hölder误差界，并补充了Sturm经典工作中常数估计的不足。
AI.motivation: 现有半定可行性问题的误差界结果大多依赖于Slater条件（严格可行性假设），而实际应用中该条件常常不成立。作者旨在填补这一空白，发展一套无需约束规格（CQ）的显式误差界框架。
AI.method: 1) 引入径向型Hölder误差界，其中误差界常数通过径向模函数显式依赖于参考矩阵的范数；2) 将面约减（facial reduction）与近年发展的面残差函数（facial residual functions）相结合，获得模函数的显式描述；3) 分析误差界随矩阵空间维度增长时的渐近行为；4) 将半定规划的最优性系统重构为可行性问题以应用该框架。
AI.result: 在不施加任何约束规格的条件下获得径向型Hölder误差界的显式描述；提供了Sturm局部Hölder误差界中有界集上常数的显式估计；在半定规划最优性系统情境下，在严格互补条件下（无需解唯一性假设）导出径向型误差界，并通过显式例子证明了其渐近紧致性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架填补了无Slater条件下半定可行性问题误差界的理论空白，为半定规划的收敛性分析和算法设计提供了更一般的理论工具，特别是在Slater条件失效的典型场景下仍能保证显式的误差估计。

title: Context Is Not Authority: Structured Runtime Governance for Financial Market Agents
comment: 15 pages, 1 figure, 9 tables. Qiangqiang Liu and Yichi Zhang are corresponding authors
summary: Financial agents can turn correct context into an unauthorized effect: a customer-facing commitment, trade, or deployed policy. We present SAGE-Fin, a finance-specific authority-handoff contract that makes the proposed effect, not merely its text, the object of runtime control. SAGE-Fin compiles proposals into typed, adapter-bound candidates; records missing or stale institutional obligations as coverage debt; contracts authority under current market, account, policy, and dialogue state; and requires an exact-artifact receipt whose nominal type matches the consuming response, execution, or policy adapter. Evidence and workflow progress cannot substitute for effect authority, and prior authorization is rechecked after state changes. Across an authored 616-case catalog, five deterministic specifications yield 3,080 outputs; a label-isolated harness obtains 616/616 binary reference-prototype parity, including 3/3 named response-gate fixtures, while 22 tests cover selected paths. These results establish executable conformance, not independent safety accuracy. Separately, SAGE-Fin's response gate processed real customer-facing production requests at a confidential digital-asset platform. An operational team independent of the implementation team reached a strongly positive post-deployment conclusion on practical usefulness and workflow fit, and end-user feedback was also strongly positive. Disclosure permits only the review's independence, stakeholder classes, assessed dimensions, and directional conclusion, so this is qualitative field corroboration rather than an aggregate effect estimate. Three distinct de-identified predecessor failures, with independently confirmed 0/3 interception, ground repeated-emission drift, stale account evidence, and missing escalation state without estimating prevalence or treatment effect.

AI.tldr: SAGE-Fin是一种面向金融领域的权威交接（authority-handoff）合约系统，将LLM生成提案的"预期效果"而非其文本本身作为运行时控制对象。它通过类型化适配器、覆盖率债务记录、当前状态合约下的权威收缩以及精确工件收据机制，确保效果授权即时生效。
AI.motivation: 金融智能体可能将正确的上下文转化为未经授权的实际效果（如客户承诺、交易或策略部署），仅控制生成文本无法防止此类风险。需要一种以效果为导向的权威控制机制。
AI.method: SAGE-Fin将提案编译为类型化的、适配器绑定的候选对象；记录缺失或过期的机构义务作为覆盖率债务；在当前的"市场-账户-策略-对话"状态下收缩权威；要求与消费端响应/执行/策略适配器名义类型匹配的精确工件收据。先前授权在状态变更后重新验证，证据和工作流进度不能替代效果权威。
AI.result: 在616个案例目录上，5个确定性规格产生3,080个输出；标签隔离的测试框架获得616/616二进制参考原型一致性（含3/3命名响应门夹具），22个测试覆盖选定路径。概念验证明确为可执行一致性而非独立安全准确性。在真实生产环境（保密数字资产平台）中，独立运营团队给出强烈正面的部署结论和用户体验反馈，但仅为定性现场佐证。三个去标识化的前代失败案例独立确认0/3拦截率，用于支撑重复发射漂移、过期账户证据和缺失升级状态等问题。
AI.conclusion: SAGE-Fin确立了一种可执行的权威交接一致性验证方法，在生产环境中获得正向定性验证，但其"执行一致性"不能等同于独立的安全准确性证明，现场结果受披露限制仅构成定性佐证而非聚合效应估计。

title: When Does Trace-Driven Evaluation Mislead MoE Expert Caching? Replay Semantics, Workload Contamination, and Operating Regimes
comment: 38 pages, 4 figures, 21 tables. Measurement and scoped negative-results study. Artifacts, frozen manifests and SHA-256 records archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21788821
summary:
Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models have outgrown accelerator memory, and offloading expert weights to host memory is now standard. This makes expert cache management an attractive lever: a policy that raised the hit rate would cut expert traffic per token. Evaluating that is a measurement problem, and we find the measurement fragile.
  With a trace-driven, event-atomic simulator over three MoE models (40, 64, 128 experts), we isolate three evaluation axes that change conclusions, not just numbers. Replay semantics: under a fused-event traffic contract, an inconsistent per-access replay inflates recency-based policies by 27-29% while leaving frequency-based and static ones within 4%, inverting the policy ranking. Workload contamination: probe sets using one instruction template per category produce verbatim-identical generation prefixes; a matched-pair rendering intervention moves the measured early-window effect by 19.4-31.9 points and reverses which workloads look most cache-friendly. Operating regimes: normalized miss fractions do not transfer across models, so the per-step expert union relative to per-layer capacity must be reported -- yet permuting only the temporal order of an identical event stream moves the offline-optimal gap from 44.9% to 30.8%, so it is not sufficient.
  Corrected, a stable gap to the offline optimum remains (44.2-45.9% over 13 frozen workload compositions). A forced-admission oracle attributes 84.3-96.6% of it to knowing which resident expert is used furthest in the future. A causal next-use predictor, used as an eviction rule, recovers -11.4% of the gap; it picks an optimal victim 3.4% of the time, against 2.4% for a random resident block and 20.6-22.1% for LRU and LFRU. Our position is narrow: in our evaluated settings a large offline-optimal gap substantially overstates the gains recovered by representative lightweight causal mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 本文发现Mixture-of-Experts（MoE）模型专家缓存管理评估的测量方法是脆弱的：回放语义、工作负载污染和运行机制三个评估维度会改变结论甚至反转策略排名。纠正测量偏差后，离线最优与启发式策略之间存在稳定且较大的差距（44.2-45.9%），但该差距主要源于对未来最远使用专家（furthest-in-future）的知情，而简单的因果预测器仅能恢复其中一小部分差距。
AI.motivation: MoE模型的专家权重已超过加速器内存，通常被卸载到主机内存，因此专家缓存管理的命中率直接影响每token的专家流量。但评估这种缓存策略的测量方法本身是脆弱的，不同评估设定会改变结论而非仅仅改变数值，需要一个可靠且可复现的评估基准。
AI.method: 使用trace驱动的、事件原子（event-atomic）模拟器，对三个MoE模型（40/64/128个专家）进行系统性评估。通过隔离三个评估轴：回放语义（replay semantics）、工作负载污染（workload contamination）和运行机制（operating regimes），揭示测量脆弱性。随后采用匹配对渲染干预（matched-pair rendering intervention）、冻结工作负载组成、以及强制准入预言机（forced-admission oracle）等方法进行校正分析，并比较LRU、LFRU及因果next-use预测器作为驱逐规则的性能。
AI.result: 非一致的回放语义使基于近期性的策略虚高27-29%，而频率和静态策略误差在4%以内，导致策略排名反转。工作负载污染可使早窗效应测量偏移19.4-31.9个点。归一化缺失率在不同模型间不可迁移。校正后，离线最优与启发式的稳定差距为44.2-45.9%；强制准入预言机表明84.3-96.6%的差距来自对未来最远使用专家的知情。因果next-use预测器仅恢复-11.4%的差距，最优受害者命中率仅3.4%（LRU/LFRU为20.6-22.1%）。
AI.conclusion: 作者的立场是窄的：在所评估的设置中，大的离线最优差距大幅高估了代表性轻量因果机制能恢复的性能增益。测量方法需要标准化（包括回放语义、工作负载构造和运行机制报告），否则评估结论不可信。

title: IntelliAudit: Using Large Language Models to Evaluate Audit Controls
summary: IT audits require auditors to judge whether heterogeneous organizational evidence satisfies semantic security and compliance controls. This judgment is difficult to automate because relevant evidence is distributed across policies, records, spreadsheets, and operational artifacts, and because audit conclusions depend on evidentiary sufficiency rather than keyword matching. We present IntelliAudit, a retrieval-grounded multi-agent system for IT audit evidence evaluation. Given a control and an evidence corpus, IntelliAudit retrieves relevant artifacts, generates an evidence-grounded assessment, challenges adverse findings, adjudicates disagreements, and produces an auditor-facing recommendation with cited evidence, rationale, missing-evidence analysis, and remediation guidance. We instantiate IntelliAudit on ISO/IEC 27001 and evaluate it across multiple simulated organizations using expert auditor review and audit-readiness user feedback. The evaluation shows that IntelliAudit can support control interpretation, evidence-grounded reasoning, and audit-preparation workflows, while also revealing the importance of human oversight for calibrating sufficiency judgments and correcting overly permissive recommendations. These results suggest that retrieval-grounded multi-agent systems can assist audit evidence review, but should remain decision-support tools rather than autonomous certification systems.

AI.tldr: IntelliAudit 是一个基于检索增强的多智能体系统，用于IT审计证据评估。系统在ISO/IEC 27001环境下经过专家审计师评审和审计就绪度用户反馈的评估，能够支持控制解读、证据推理和审计准备工作流，但研究强调人工监督对校准充分性判断和纠正过于宽松建议的重要性，该系统应作为决策支持工具而非自主认证系统。
AI.motivation: IT审计要求审计师判断异构组织证据是否满足语义安全和合规控制，但这一判断难以自动化，因为相关证据分散在政策、记录、电子表格和操作工件中，且审计结论依赖证据充分性而非关键词匹配。
AI.method: IntelliAudit采用检索接地（retrieval-grounded）的多智能体架构：给定控制项和证据语料库后，系统检索相关工件、生成基于证据的评估、质疑不利发现、裁决分歧，并产出面向审计师的推荐（含引用证据、理由、缺失证据分析和补救建议）。在ISO/IEC 27001上实例化，并在多个模拟组织中使用专家审计师评审和审计就绪度用户反馈进行评估。
AI.result: 评估显示IntelliAudit能支持控制解读、证据接地推理和审计准备工作流，同时揭示了人工监督对于校准充分性判断和纠正过于宽松（过度许可）建议的关键重要性。
AI.conclusion: 检索接地多智能体系统可以辅助审计证据审查，但应保持为决策支持工具而非自主认证系统。

title: Online Learning of Scale Parameters in Score-Driven Filters
summary: Score-driven filters multiply a scaled log-likelihood score by a gain that controls the update magnitude. We treat this gain as a decision variable and study its online learning. Conditional on the current state, observation, score, and scaling rule, each admissible gain induces a reachable next state and a one-step-ahead predictive density: scalar gains govern distance along a line, while diagonal gains govern coordinatewise transmission. Gain selection is therefore a conditional predictive decision problem with a Kullback-Leibler objective. For a scalar unscaled gain, the negative raw product of consecutive scores is the stochastic gradient of this loss; positive aGAS scaling only rescales the effective step. Monotone differentiable gain links induce mirror-descent geometries on bounded gain domains, while persistence yields a Bregman pull towards a reference gain. Under convexity, compactness, and regularity conditions, we establish dynamic-regret bounds for projected and discounted mirror updates relative to time-varying, current-information comparators. Simulations illustrate the roles of scaling, link geometry, persistence, and coordinatewise transmission rates. An out-of-sample panel of equity-index volatilities shows that the bounded mirror gain generally matches or outperforms a constant gain while avoiding the extreme spikes of a nominally unbounded exponential link, with the strongest improvements observed in multi-crisis markets.

AI.tldr: 本文研究得分驱动滤波器中增益参数的在线学习问题，将增益视为决策变量，建立了基于KL散度目标的动态遗憾界，并在权益指数波动率面板数据上验证了有界镜像增益方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 得分驱动滤波器（如GAS模型）中增益参数控制更新的幅度，但通常需要人工设定或离线调参。现有研究缺乏将增益作为在线决策变量进行学习的理论框架，本文旨在填补这一空白，为增益选择提供具有遗憾界保证的在线学习方法。
AI.method: 作者将增益选择构建为条件预测决策问题，以KL散度为损失函数。推导了标量无缩放增益下的随机梯度形式（连续分数的负原始乘积），并证明aGAS正缩放仅重缩放有效步长。利用单调可微增益链接函数在有限增益域上实现镜像下降几何，通过持久性项实现向参考增益的Bregman拉动。在凸性、紧性和正则性条件下，对投影和折扣镜像更新建立了相对于时变当前信息比较器的动态遗憾界。
AI.result: 模拟实验验证了缩放、链接几何、持久性和坐标传输率的作用。在股权指数波动率的样本外面板数据中，有界镜像增益普遍匹配或优于常数增益，同时避免了无界指数链接产生的极端尖峰，在多危机市场中改进最为显著。
AI.conclusion: 将增益作为在线学习的决策变量是有益的，有界镜像增益在实践中的稳健性优于无界指数链接和常数增益，特别是在市场动荡时期。

title: SPECTRA: Pushing the KV Cache Beyond the 2-Bit Cliff via Spectral Transform Coding
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) increasingly read long inputs in the agentic era, from whole documents and codebases to conversations across many turns. Their inference memory is then dominated by the key-value (KV) cache, the stored attention keys and values of every token the model has read and generated. Because the cache grows with context length and is re-read in full at every generated token, a longer context means more GPU memory.
  To reduce this cost, most existing methods compress the KV cache by lowering every stored value to the same low precision, a technique known as quantization. They can push this to nearly two bits per value, but rarely further, because quality drops sharply at this 2-bit cliff: four levels are too few for the cache's outlier-heavy values, where a few large entries consume the levels and collapse the rest into noise. A natural remedy is to spend more bits on the channels (feature dimensions) that matter and fewer on the rest, but the raw cache offers no handle: its channels are strongly correlated, so none stands out as more important.
  Our analysis shows that this handle appears once the cache is rotated into a coordinate system computed from its own statistics, removing these correlations. There, a small fraction of channels carries almost all the information, and spending the budget on those few is far more accurate than spreading it evenly.
  Guided by this analysis, we develop SPECTRA, a training-free, drop-in codec that re-encodes the cache into this coordinate system and concentrates the bit budget on the channels that carry the signal. On Llama-3.1-8B and Qwen2.5-7B over long-context benchmarks, SPECTRA is near-lossless at 4x compression, competitive at 8x where uniform quantization has collapsed, and reaches up to 12x, pushing usable compression past the 2-bit cliff so the same GPU holds longer contexts and larger batches.

AI.tldr: SPECTRA是一个免训练、即插即用的编码器，通过将KV缓存旋转到由自身统计信息计算的坐标系中，消除通道相关性，并将军开销集中在少数信息密集的通道上，在4倍压缩下接近无损，在8倍仍有竞争力，最高可达12倍压缩，突破了2比特量化悬崖。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在长上下文场景中推理内存被KV缓存主导，现有量化方法将每个值压缩到低精度，但在约2比特处出现质量急剧下降的"2-bit cliff"。这是因为缓存中存在异常值（outliers），少数大数值消耗了所有量化级别，导致其余值被压缩为噪声。自然解决方案是给重要通道分配更多比特，但原始缓存中各通道高度相关，无法区分重要性。
AI.method: SPECTRA首先分析发现，将KV缓存旋转到由其自身统计信息计算出的坐标系中可消除通道间的相关性，此时少数通道承载了几乎全部信息。基于此，SPECTRA将该坐标系作为编码空间，将比特预算集中分配给携带信号的通道，实现非均匀比特分配，而非均匀分布。
AI.result: 在Llama-3.1-8B和Qwen2.5-7B上的长上下文基准测试中，SPECTRA在4倍压缩下接近无损，在8倍压缩下仍有竞争力（此时均匀量化已崩溃），并可达12倍压缩，将可用压缩推向2-bit cliff之上，使同一GPU能承载更长的上下文和更大的批次。
AI.conclusion: 通过旋转坐标系的方式揭示KV缓存中通道重要性的结构，SPECTRA成功突破了均匀量化的性能瓶颈，在保持模型质量的同时实现了更高的压缩比，为长上下文推理的效率提升提供了可行方案。

title: Towards Researcher Agents for Knowledge-Graph Question Answering
comment: Second International TEXT2SPARQL Challenge, co-located with Text2KG at ESWC 2026
summary: Translating a natural-language question into a SPARQL query that can be executed against a large knowledge graph requires resolving lexical ambiguity, grounding surface terms in the target ontology, and producing graph patterns that are both syntactically valid and semantically faithful. We present an agentic text-to-SPARQL system that goes one step beyond static tool-using agents: a researcher agent that, after each round of inference on a validation set, proposes and tests changes to its own prompts, rules, and tool-orchestration code. We instantiate the loop on DBpedia, evolve nine successive versions of the agent driven by a low-cost reasoning model, and deploy the best-performing configuration with two stronger backbone models. The study yields three observations: (i) self-improvement converges quickly and then achieves 0.22 overall accuracy on the 2025 DBpedia validation set; (ii) the bottleneck is consistently in basic-graph-pattern predicate selection, not in SPARQL syntax or modifiers; and (iii) several benchmark items appear to penalise correct queries due to property ambiguity in DBpedia, suggesting that future Text-to-SPARQL benchmarks should be scored using a combination of machine translation and information retrieval metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个可自我改进的智能体文本到SPARQL系统，该系统在验证集上每轮推理后自动提出并测试对自己提示、规则和工具编排代码的修改。系统在DBpedia上迭代出九个版本，最终达到0.22的总体准确率，并发现瓶颈在于基本图模式的谓词选择而非SPARQL语法，同时指出当前基准因DBpedia属性歧义可能误判正确查询。
AI.motivation: 将自然语言问题翻译为可在大规模知识图谱上执行的SPARQL查询，需要解决词汇歧义、在目标本体中扎根表面术语，并生成既有语法有效性又有语义保真度的图模式。现有静态工具使用智能体无法自适应改进，因此需要一个能持续自我优化的智能体系统。
AI.method: 提出一个"研究者智能体"（researcher agent）框架：在验证集上每轮推理后，该智能体自动提出并测试对自己提示、规则和工具编排代码的修改，形成自我改进循环。在DBpedia上使用低成本推理模型迭代进化九个版本，然后将最优配置部署到两个更强的骨干模型上。
AI.result: 三个关键发现：(i) 自我改进快速收敛，在2025年DBpedia验证集上达到0.22总体准确率；(ii) 性能瓶颈始终在基本图模式（basic-graph-pattern）的谓词选择上，而非SPARQL语法或修饰符；(iii) 多个基准条目因DBpedia中的属性歧义而惩罚了正确查询，表明未来基准应采用机器翻译与信息检索指标的组合进行评分。
AI.conclusion: 智能体自我改进机制在文本到SPARQL任务中是可行的且在短期内能快速收敛；然而当前主要挑战在于谓词级语义消歧而非语法生成。同时，现有基准的评估方式存在缺陷，应引入更综合的评分策略来更公平地衡量系统性能。

title: GPU-Accelerated Conic Quadratic Programming with Local Linear Convergence under Strict Complementarity
summary: We present PDHCG-CQP, a GPU-accelerated first-order solver for large-scale conic convex quadratic programming. PDHCG-CQP supports affine constraints and Cartesian products of nonnegative, second-order, rotated second-order, exponential, and three-dimensional power cones. At its core is a restarted averaged primal-dual hybrid gradient (PDHG) method, whose primal update is computed inexactly by solving a conic quadratic proximal subproblem with projected gradient iterations. We establish local linear convergence of the restarted averaged scheme with both exact and inexact primal proximal evaluations under a uniform local quadratic-growth condition on the smoothed primal-dual gap. We further show that this condition holds under strict complementarity by exploiting a rotated second-order-cone lifting together with local primal and dual regularity conditions. Our C/CUDA implementation combines matrix-free linear algebra, batched cone projections, adaptive inner solves, reflected-Halpern acceleration, and fully device-resident KKT residual computations. It also supports multi-GPU execution through a two-dimensional partitioning of the problem data. Extensive experiments on standard and large-scale quadratic programming (QP), convex quadratically constrained quadratic programming (QCQP), second-order cone programming (SOCP), and quasilinear Fisher equilibrium benchmarks demonstrate that PDHCG-CQP achieves state-of-the-art robustness among first-order solvers while scaling efficiently to 8 GPUs and instances with up to $4.4\times10^8$ stored primal coordinates. PDHCG-CQP is open source and available at https://github.com/Lhongpei/PDHCG.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PDHCG-CQP，一个GPU加速的大规模圆锥凸二次规划一阶求解器，基于重启平均原始-对偶混合梯度（PDHG）方法，支持多种圆锥约束（非负锥、二阶锥、旋转二阶锥、指数锥和三维幂锥），在严格互补条件下建立了局部线性收敛性，并扩展到8个GPU和高达4.4×10^8规模的实例。
AI.motivation: 大规模圆锥凸二次规划问题在实际应用中广泛存在（如QP、QCQP、SOCP等），但现有的一阶求解器在鲁棒性和扩展性方面存在不足。GPU并行计算为加速这类问题提供了潜力，但需要设计适合GPU架构的算法和实现。
AI.method: PDHCG-CQP的核心是重启平均PDHG方法，其中原始更新通过投影梯度迭代非精确求解圆锥二次近邻子问题。理论方面，在光滑原始-对偶间隙的均匀局部二次增长条件下，建立了精确和非精确原始近邻评估下重启平均方案局部线性收敛的证明；通过旋转二阶锥提升结合局部原始-对偶正则性条件，证明了严格互补条件下的收敛条件成立。实现方面采用C/CUDA，结合无矩阵线性代数、批处理圆锥投影、自适应内迭代求解、反射Halpern加速和全设备端KKT残差计算，并支持通过二维数据分区的多GPU执行。
AI.result: 在标准和大规模QP、凸QCQP、SOCP以及拟线性Fisher均衡基准上的大量实验表明，PDHCG-CQP在一阶求解器中达到了最先进的鲁棒性，并能高效扩展到8个GPU和具有4.4×10^8个存储原始坐标的实例。
AI.conclusion: PDHCG-CQP作为开源（GitHub仓库已提供）的GPU加速一阶求解器，在圆锥凸二次规划的大规模求解上兼具理论收敛保障和优异的实际性能，展示了GPU并行一阶方法在此类问题上的巨大潜力。

title: Entropic Partial Optimal Transport and Partial Gromov--Wasserstein Distance between Gaussian Mixtures
summary: Optimal transport and Gromov--Wasserstein distances are useful tools for comparing probability measures and metric measure spaces, but their balanced formulations force all mass to be matched. This constraint is often too strong for data with outliers, missing parts, or only partial overlap. In this paper, we develop entropic partial optimal transport for Gaussian mixture models and define a partial mixture Gromov--Wasserstein distance. For the finite entropic partial optimal transport problem, we prove the existence and uniqueness of the minimizer and establish quantitative large-penalty estimates. Moreover, the resulting entropic partial component couplings induce continuous partial transport plans through Gaussian optimal maps. We analyze their large-penalty and subsequent zero-entropy limits and construct the associated displacement interpolations and barycentric projection maps. In addition, by identifying each Gaussian mixture with a finite metric measure space of Gaussian components, we establish the metric property and large-penalty limit of the partial mixture Gromov--Wasserstein distance. Finally, numerical experiments on synthetic Gaussian mixtures and point clouds illustrate the effects of the penalty and entropic regularization and the robustness of partial matching to outliers.

AI.tldr: 本文针对传统最优传输和Gromov-Wasserstein距离要求完全匹配所有质量的局限，提出了面向高斯混合模型的熵正则化部分最优传输框架，并定义了部分混合Gromov-Wasserstein距离。作者证明了有限熵正则化部分最优传输问题最小值的存在性与唯一性，建立了大惩罚渐近估计，分析了连续部分传输计划及其零熵与大惩罚极限，构建了位移插值与重心投影映射，并验证了该距离的度量性质。数值实验展示了惩罚参数和熵正则化的作用以及部分匹配对离群点的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 经典最优传输和Gromov-Wasserstein距离的平衡公式强制所有质量必须被匹配，这一约束对包含离群点、缺失部分或仅有部分重叠的数据过于严格，限制了这些工具在现实数据场景中的应用。本文旨在通过引入部分（partial）匹配机制和熵正则化，克服平衡公式的局限性，同时保持计算可处理性和理论保障。
AI.method: 1) 为高斯混合模型开发熵正则化部分最优传输，证明有限问题最小值的存在性与唯一性，并建立大惩罚参数下的定量渐近估计；2) 通过高斯最优映射，将熵正则化部分分量耦合诱导为连续的部分传输计划，分析其在零熵和大惩罚极限下的行为，并构造位移插值（displacement interpolation）和重心投影映射（barycentric projection maps）；3) 将每个高斯混合模型视为由高斯分量组成的有限度量测度空间，从而定义部分混合Gromov-Wasserstein距离，并建立其度量性质与大惩罚极限。
AI.result: 论文证明了有限熵正则化部分最优传输问题最小值的存在性与唯一性，给出了定量的大惩罚渐近估计。所构造的连续部分传输计划在零熵极限和大惩罚极限下的行为得到了刻画。部分混合Gromov-Wasserstein距离满足度量性质并具有良定义的大惩罚极限。合成高斯混合模型和点云数据的数值实验验证了惩罚与熵正则化的效果，以及部分匹配对离群点的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作统一了部分最优传输、熵正则化与Gromov-Wasserstein距离三个方向，为不完整、含离群点或部分重叠的数据提供了理论严谨且计算可行的比较工具，拓展了最优传输方法在实际数据场景中的适用范围。

title: Spectral Outliers Reveal Dominant Learned Structure in Transformer Attention
comment: Accepted at the International Conference on Machine Learning and Applications (ICMLA 2026); to appear in IEEE proceedings
summary: We apply Marchenko-Pastur (MP) random matrix theory to pre-trained attention weights in order to separate each projection matrix into a random-like bulk and a set of spectral outliers. We validate this decomposition causally: zeroing the MP-identified outliers (signal) in Mistral-7B drives HellaSwag, MMLU, and PIQA close to random-chance performance, whereas zeroing a count-matched subset of bulk singular values causes smaller but non-negligible degradation. Across 11 pre-trained transformers we identify five recurring patterns: spectral outliers encode a dominant component of the learned structure; Q projections carry the most outliers; V projections under grouped-query attention lack a clean signal/noise separation; entry-level outliers form structured row-bands in Q and column-bands in O; and specific residual-stream dimensions persist as band outliers across layers in K and O. We close by outlining how these observations could inform parameter-efficient fine-tuning and structured pruning.

AI.tldr: 本文应用Marchenko-Pastur随机矩阵理论对预训练注意力权重进行谱分解，将每个投影矩阵分为随机噪声背景和谱离群值两部分，并通过因果实验验证这种分解的有效性：在Mistral-7B中清零离群值使HellaSwag、MMLU和PIQA降至随机水平，而清零同等数量的背景奇异值仅造成较小但不可忽视的性能下降。作者在11个预训练Transformer中识别出五种重复出现的谱结构模式，并讨论了其对参数高效微调和结构化剪枝的启示。
AI.motivation: 理解预训练注意力权重中哪些成分编码了真正的学习结构（信号）vs.哪些只是随机噪声（背景），从而为模型压缩、参数高效微调和可解释性提供理论依据。现有方法多凭直觉或启发式进行剪枝和微调，缺乏一个基于随机矩阵理论的严格信号/噪声划分框架。
AI.method: 采用Marchenko-Pastur随机矩阵理论对预训练注意力权重（Q、K、V、O投影矩阵）进行谱分解，通过在MP准则下区分谱离群值（信号）和谱背景（噪声）。通过因果消融实验（将离群值或等量背景奇异值置零）验证分解的语义有效性，并在11个预训练Transformer上跨模型总结谱结构模式。
AI.result: 因果实验表明，在Mistral-7B中将MP识别的离群值清零导致HellaSwag、MMLU和PIQA接近随机猜测水平，而清零等量背景奇异值仅导致较小但非可忽略的退化。跨11个模型发现五种稳定模式：谱离群值编码主导性的学习结构；Q投影拥有最多的离群值；分组查询注意力下的V投影缺乏清晰的信号/噪声分离；条目级离群值在Q中形成行带、在O中形成列带；特定残差流维度在K和O的层间持续作为带离群值存在。
AI.conclusion: MP随机矩阵框架为预训练Transformer注意力权重提供了一种原则性的信号/噪声分离方法。离群值确实编码了因果上关键的学习结构，这些谱观察可以指导参数高效微调（聚焦离群值子空间）和结构化剪枝（优先剪除约简的噪声背景），为模型压缩与高效微调提供了新的理论驱动策略。

title: Protecting patient privacy in clinical foundation models: Technical and legal perspectives
summary: Clinical foundation models trained on large-scale patient data are increasingly used for decision support, screening, and public health. As deployment expands, privacy risk increasingly arises from model-mediated leakage, yet its prevalence and severity remain poorly quantified. Models can disclose sensitive training artifacts, enabling patient re-identification in ways not captured by data-handling controls alone. Existing frameworks, including HIPAA and GDPR, offer limited guidance for such indirect threats. We propose a practical framework for assessing privacy risk in clinical foundation models and illustrate realistic leakage scenarios across deployment settings, map them to legal regimes, and outline complementary technical and legal mitigations. Our analysis provides a context-aware risk assessment grounded in realistic usage to preserve the value of medical foundation models while rigorously safeguarding patient privacy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个实用的框架来评估临床基础模型中的隐私风险，涵盖模型介导的泄漏场景、法律映射及技术法律双重缓解措施。
AI.motivation: 临床基础模型在大规模患者数据上训练并日益广泛部署，但模型介导的隐私泄漏（如训练工件泄露导致患者重识别）的普遍性和严重程度尚未被充分量化。现有法规（HIPAA、GDPR）对这类间接威胁缺乏明确指导。
AI.method: 提出一个实用的隐私风险评估框架；在多种部署场景中说明现实泄漏案例；将泄漏场景映射到相关法律体系；概述互补的技术和法律缓解措施。
AI.result: 提供了一个基于现实使用情境、与上下文相关的风险评估方法，在保留医学基础模型价值的同时严格保障患者隐私。
AI.conclusion: 模型介导的隐私泄漏是临床基础模型部署中的现实威胁，需要结合技术手段与法律框架进行综合防护，现有法规存在缺口，亟需上下文感知的风险评估与缓解策略。

title: Plant-Wide Hierarchical Electricity-Heat Coordination for Large-Scale Cold-Region ReP2H Plants via Bidirectional Thermal Coupling
summary: Large-scale renewable power-to-hydrogen (ReP2H) plants in cold regions suffer from prolonged startup and repeated thermal stress during frequent startup-shutdown operation. The situation becomes worse due to the lack of coordinated heat management among the alkaline electrolysis stacks, balance of plant (BoP), plant thermal utility system (PTUS), and plant building. This paper presents a plant-wide thermal topology and a hierarchical electricity-heat management framework to address the issues. Bidirectional thermal coupling between the stack cluster and PTUS enables preheating, thermal standby, and waste heat recovery, while minute-scale production scheduling is coordinated with second-scale thermal regulation. Case studies based on an 80 MW plant in Northern China show that the proposed framework eliminates cold startups in year round, increases hydrogen yield by 1.50, improves energy and exergy efficiencies by 0.99 and 4.33 percentage points, respectively, and reduces the levelized cost of hydrogen by 3.22%. It also reduces thermal fatigue damage and startup-shutdown-induced voltage degradation.

AI.tldr: 本文针对寒冷地区大规模可再生能源制氢（ReP2H）厂在频繁启停操作中面临的长启动时间和重复热应力问题，提出了一种全厂热拓扑及分层电-热管理框架。该框架通过电解槽集群与热力系统的双向热耦合实现预热、热待机和废热回收，并协调分钟级生产调度与秒级热调控。基于中国北方80 MW工厂的案例研究表明，该框架全年消除了冷启动，氢气产量提升1.50%，能量效率与火用效率分别提升0.99和4.33个百分点，平准化制氢成本降低3.22%，同时减少了热疲劳损伤和启停引起的电压退化。
AI.motivation: 寒冷地区大规模ReP2H工厂在频繁启停操作中存在两大痛点：一是冷启动耗时长导致生产效率低下；二是反复热应力引发设备疲劳损伤和电压退化。现有方法缺乏对电解槽堆栈、平衡设备（BoP）、工厂热力公用系统（PTUS）和厂房建筑之间的协调热管理，导致热源与热汇难以统筹利用，亟需全厂层面的热管理与电-热协同优化框架。
AI.method: 提出一个全厂热拓扑结构及分层电-热管理框架：(1) 构建槽堆集群与PTUS之间的双向热耦合通道，支持预热、热待机和废热回收三种热管理模式；(2) 建立分层控制架构，将分钟级生产调度与秒级热调节相协调；(3) 通过热管理实现电解槽在停机期间保持热待机状态，从而消除冷启动。
AI.result: 基于中国北方80 MW工厂的案例验证显示：全年不再出现冷启动；氢气产量提高1.50%；能量效率提升0.99个百分点，火用效率提升4.33个百分点；平准化制氢成本降低3.22%；同时显著减少热疲劳损伤以及启停诱导的电压退化。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的全厂热拓扑与分层电-热管理框架能够有效解决寒冷地区ReP2H工厂的冷启动和热应力问题，在多性能指标上均取得显著改善，为大规模可再生能源制氢系统的热管理设计与运行优化提供了可行方案。

title: Test-Time Augmentation for LLMs: When Input Diversity Beats Output Diversity at Matched Compute
comment: Published at the COLM 2026 Workshop on Efficient Reasoning
summary: Test-time scaling improves LLM accuracy but multiplies inference cost, making the accuracy gained per unit of compute the metric that matters in deployment. Self-consistency is one of the established approaches, which spends this budget entirely on the output side by sampling repeated reasoning paths. We study Test-Time Augmentation (TTA), which extends self-consistency by also perturbing the input, aggregating predictions across transformed versions of the input, and ask whether input-side diversity converts compute into accuracy more efficiently than output-side diversity. We perform a systematic, matched-compute comparison: we evaluate three simple input-side strategies (semantic rephrasing, lexical perturbations, and visual transformations) across six datasets covering general and multilingual knowledge, mathematical reasoning, multi-modal question answering, and sentiment classification, against chain-of-thought prompting and self-consistency. Semantic rephrasing delivers consistent and statistically significant accuracy gains while Pareto-dominating self-consistency on cost-effectiveness, delivering roughly 1.8X more accuracy per dollar and outperforming it on five of six tasks. We further analyze the number of augmentations, multi-modal strategies, and base model scaling, finding that TTA is most cost-effective for mid-tier models where a stronger model is unavailable or too expensive. Our findings indicate that for current mid-tier LLMs, varying the input converts inference compute into accuracy more efficiently than varying the reasoning path alone. The TTA implementation is available at https://github.com/aws-samples/sample-genai-reflection-for-bedrock.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了测试时增强（TTA）相对于自一致性（self-consistency）在测试时扩展中的计算效率，发现语义改写等输入侧扰动策略比输出侧采样在将推理计算转化为准确率方面更高效，约节省1.8倍成本。
AI.motivation: 测试时扩展（test-time scaling）虽然能提升LLM准确率，但会倍增推理成本，因此每单位计算所获得的准确率提升才是部署中真正重要的指标。已有的自一致性方法将预算完全花在输出侧（重复采样推理路径），作者想探究输入侧多样性（TTA）是否比输出侧多样性更高效地将计算转化为准确率。
AI.method: 进行了匹配计算量（matched-compute）的系统比较：评估三种输入侧策略（语义改写、词汇扰动、视觉变换），在六个数据集上覆盖通用/多语言知识、数学推理、多模态问答和情感分类，与思维链提示和自一致性进行比较，并分析了增强次数、多模态策略和基座模型规模的影响。
AI.result: 语义改写带来显著且统计上一致的准确率提升，在成本效益上帕累托支配自一致性，每美元获得约1.8倍于自一致性的准确率，并在六个任务中的五个上胜出。TTA对中档模型最为经济有效。
AI.conclusion: 对于当前中档LLM，改变输入比仅改变推理路径能更高效地将推理计算转化为准确率。测试时增强是一种比自一致性更具成本效益的测试时扩展策略。

title: QuantumMind: Constraint-Grounded Agentic Reasoning for Speedup Analysis in Quantum Computing
summary: Identifying a meaningful quantum speedup requires more than matching a classical problem to a familiar quantum primitive: the claim must preserve the task, respect access and output models, expose required promises, and remain within a defensible complexity scope. We present QuantumMind, an auditable agentic workflow for generating and conservatively screening quantum-acceleration hypotheses. A fixed sequence of typed, role-specialized actions formalizes the public task, analyzes structure and classical bottlenecks, matches a source-linked registry of quantum primitives and barriers, and constructs a scoped candidate scheme. A deterministic ten-check validator assigns the authoritative verdict; completed states are compiled into a Quantum Acceleration Evidence Graph and passed through a downward-only research screen that cannot strengthen the decision. We evaluate QuantumMind against seven task-adapted prompting and agentic controls on 582 identical open-discovery tasks. Under the frozen Open-Discovery Score (ODS), QuantumMind obtains 53.1 mean ODS, exceeding the strongest baseline by 17.3 points (48.2% relative), and wins 355 of 582 paired tasks against that baseline. It passes the graph audit on 99.8% of tasks, compared with 43.6% for the strongest baseline, and ranks first in all seven task families. The results indicate that typed state transitions and deterministic evidence control contribute beyond fluent generation alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出QuantumMind，一个可审计的agentic工作流，用于生成并保守筛查量子加速假设。该方法通过固定类型化的角色专用动作序列、源码链接的量子原语注册表、确定性十项校验器及下行式研究筛查，在582个开放发现任务上取得53.1的平均ODS分数，比最强基线高出17.3分（相对提升48.2%），并在图审计通过率（99.8% vs 43.6%）与全部七个任务族排名上全面领先。
AI.motivation: 识别有意义的量子加速不能仅将经典问题与已知量子原语简单匹配，还需保证任务语义不变、尊重访问与输出模型、明确所需的量子承诺，并保持在可辩护的复杂度范围内。现有方法在生成量子加速假设时缺乏系统性、可审计性和保守性，需要一种结构化、可验证的工作流来解决这一问题。
AI.method: QuantumMind采用固定的类型化、角色专业化的动作序列：形式化公开任务、分析结构与经典瓶颈、匹配源码链接的量子原语与障碍注册表、构建有范围的候选方案。随后通过确定性十项校验器给出权威判定，并将完成状态编译为量子加速证据图，再经由仅向下（不可强化决策）的研究筛查。整个流程可审计且决策不可逆向增强。
AI.result: 在582个相同开放发现任务上，与七种任务适配的提示和agentic基线对比：QuantumMind平均ODS为53.1，超过最强基线17.3分（相对48.2%提升）；在355/582个配对任务中胜出；图审计通过率为99.8%，远高于最强基线的43.6%；在所有七个任务族中均排名第一。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果证明，类型化状态转换与确定性证据控制带来的增益超越了仅靠流畅生成的能力。QuantumMind展示了通过结构化、可审计的agentic流程在生产量子加速假设方面的有效性，为量子算法发现提供了更可信、更保守的自动化方法。

title: A primal--dual interior-point method for nonsymmetric conic optimization with conjugate-free scaling
summary: We develop a primal--dual interior-point method for nonsymmetric conic optimization based on a conjugate-free scaling matrix. The scaling is obtained from a single-secant BFGS update of the primal barrier Hessian. In contrast to multi-secant BFGS scalings, it does not require conjugate-barrier derivatives. This feature is important for high-dimensional nonsymmetric cones, where conjugate-barrier derivatives may be unavailable in closed form or expensive to compute. We embed the conjugate-free scaling in a homogeneous self-dual predictor--corrector framework. Using a split central-path neighborhood that separately controls the conic variables and the scalar homogeneous variables, we prove that the scaling matrix remains uniformly comparable to the primal barrier Hessian. This comparison bound is used to prove neighborhood preservation and to show that the complementarity measure and the linear residual decrease at a uniform rate. Consequently, the method attains an iteration bound of $\mathcal{O}(\sqrtν\log(1/\varepsilon))$, improving the $\mathcal{O}(ν\log(1/\varepsilon))$ bound of Badenbroek and Dahl [Optim. Methods Softw., 37 (2022), pp. 1027--1064] and matching the best-known complexity order for interior-point methods. Numerical experiments on instances involving the operator perspective epigraph cone and the quantum relative entropy cone show that the method is competitive with QICS, a specialized solver for conic models arising in quantum information.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于无共轭缩放矩阵的原对偶内点法用于非对称锥优化。该方法采用单割线BFGS更新原始障碍Hessian获得缩放矩阵，无需共轭障碍导数，并将其嵌入齐次自对偶预测-校正框架中。通过分割中心路径邻域，证明了缩放矩阵与原始障碍Hessian的一致可比性，从而实现了O(√ν log(1/ε))的迭代复杂度，优于此前O(ν log(1/ε))的界，并在量子信息相关锥实例上展现了与专用求解器QICS相当的竞争力。
AI.motivation: 非对称锥优化中，传统的多割线BFGS缩放需要计算共轭障碍导数，而在高维非对称锥（如算子视角谱图锥、量子相对熵锥）中，这些导数可能没有闭式表达式或计算代价高昂。因此需要一种不依赖共轭障碍导数的缩放方案，以扩大内点方法的适用范围并降低计算负担。
AI.method: 采用单割线BFGS更新原始障碍Hessian构造无共轭缩放矩阵，嵌入齐次自对偶预测-校正框架。引入分割中心路径邻域，分别控制锥变量和标量齐次变量，从而证得缩放矩阵与原始障碍Hessian一致可比，进而推导邻域保持性以及互补度量和线性残差的一致收敛率。
AI.result: 方法达到O(√ν log(1/ε))的迭代复杂度，改善了Badenbroek和Dahl的O(ν log(1/ε))界，与内点方法最佳已知复杂度阶一致。在算子视角谱图锥和量子相对熵锥实例上的数值实验表明，该方法与专门求解量子信息锥模型的QICS求解器具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为高维非对称锥优化提供了一种实用且理论上健全的内点方法，在不需要共轭障碍导数的情况下达到最优复杂度阶，并在量子信息相关问题上展现了良好的实际性能。

title: SR-OPSD: Self-Referenced On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) converts feedback into dense token-level supervision on trajectories generated by the policy to be optimized, providing a useful complement to reinforcement learning with sparse outcome rewards. However, the self-teacher policy used in OPSD is typically a stop-gradient or exponential-moving-average copy of the policy conditioned on additional context information, and thus co-evolves with both the student policy and its on-policy context distribution. Directly matching such a moving target with a fixed projection objective can lead to unstable optimization or excessive distributional concentration. This nature of OPSD motivates the proposed \emph{Self-Referenced On-Policy Self-Distillation (SR-OPSD)}. At fixed student-generated contexts, a token-level variational characterization identifies the effective distillation target as a geometric interpolation between the self-teacher policy and a reference policy. Meanwhile, we use the Rényi divergence family to generalize the projection geometry. This formulation separates \emph{where} the adaptive target is placed from \emph{how} the student is projected toward it: the interpolation coefficient controls underlying target, while the Rényi order controls the projection geometry and its sensitivity to token-level density ratios. Extensive experiments across scientific evaluation, mathematical reasoning, and coding generation tasks with multiple large language models show that SR-OPSD achieves the state-of-the-art or competitive performance across various settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自引用在线自蒸馏（SR-OPSD），通过引入参考策略和Rényi散度族，解决在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）中移动目标导致的优化不稳定和分布过度集中问题，在科学评估、数学推理和代码生成任务上取得SOTA或竞争性性能。
AI.motivation: 在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）将反馈转化为策略生成轨迹上的密集token级监督，是对稀疏结果奖励强化学习的有效补充。然而，OPSD中的自教师策略与学生策略及其在线上下文分布共同演化，直接以固定投影目标匹配这种移动目标会导致优化不稳定或分布过度集中。这一局限性促使作者提出更稳定的蒸馏框架。
AI.method: SR-OPSD在固定的学生生成上下文中，通过token级变分特征刻画识别出有效蒸馏目标为自教师策略与参考策略之间的几何插值。同时采用Rényi散度族推广投影几何，将自适应目标的位置（由插值系数控制）与学生向目标投影的方式（由Rényi阶数控制其对token级密度比值的敏感性）解耦。
AI.result: 在科学评估、数学推理和代码生成任务上，使用多个大语言模型的广泛实验表明，SR-OPSD在各种设置下均达到SOTA或具有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过将"目标放在哪里"（插值系数）与"如何投影"（Rényi阶数）解耦，SR-OPSD有效稳定了在线自蒸馏的优化过程，减少了分布过度集中问题，从而在多个下游任务上取得了优越性能。

title: Second Order Drifting Models
summary: Drifting models are a recent class of one-step generative models that evolve the model distribution during training using a predefined sample-based drift field. Although they avoid iterative inference, their kernel-based drift fields induce frequency-dependent training dynamics: In the linearized regime, each Fourier mode of the density residual decays at a rate determined by the kernel spectrum, leading to slow recovery of fine-scale structure. We propose Second-Order Drifting Models, which lift drifting dynamics into phase space by augmenting generated samples with artificial velocity variables. We show that the resulting density perturbations obey accelerated second-order dynamics in Fourier space, connecting drifting models to the celebrated Nesterov acceleration from optimization theory. This provides a principled mechanism for mitigating the spectral stiffness of first-order drifting while preserving one-step inference. We derive a practical semi-implicit training algorithm and evaluate it on synthetic distribution matching, sequential data generation, and robotic control. Across these settings, the second-order drifting model improves convergence behavior and achieves competitive or superior performance over first-order drifting baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出二阶漂移模型（Second-Order Drifting Models），通过将漂移动力学提升到相空间（引入人工速度变量），使密度扰动服从加速的二阶动力学，从而缓解一阶漂移模型在傅里叶空间中的频谱刚度问题，同时保留单步推理特性。
AI.motivation: 一阶漂移模型虽避免了迭代推理，但其基于核函数的漂移场在训练中产生频率相关的动力学：在线性化框架下，密度残差的每个傅里叶模式衰减速率由核谱决定，导致细尺度结构收敛缓慢（即频谱刚度问题）。这限制了模型恢复高保真细节的能力。
AI.method: 将漂移动力学从一阶提升到二阶：在相空间中为生成样本引入人工速度变量，使密度扰动在傅里叶空间中服从加速的二阶动力学。这一框架与优化理论中的Nesterov加速方法建立联系，提供了缓解一阶漂移频谱僵硬的理论机制。此外，推导了实用的半隐式训练算法。
AI.result: 在合成分布匹配、序列数据生成和机器人控制等多个任务上进行了评估。二阶漂移模型改善了收敛行为，在一阶漂移基线之上实现了具有竞争力或更优的性能。
AI.conclusion: 二阶漂移模型通过相空间提升和加速度动力学，在保持单步推理的前提下有效解决了频谱刚度问题，提供了理论驱动的改进方案，并在多个基准任务上验证了其优越性。

title: Adaptive Two-Level Allocation of a Conserved Capacity Budget Across Locations and Service Classes
summary: We study how to share a single conserved capacity budget across many locations and two service classes when demand is uneven, time-varying, and can exceed supply. The shape recurs: an origin's request-rate cap split across its edge locations, a licensed throughput cap across premium and standard tenants, or an egress budget between latency-critical and batch workloads. We present a two-level algorithm. The first level redistributes capacity within a class across locations by proportional deficit and excess redistribution; the second lends capacity elastically between classes when one has surplus and the other deficit. We prove it conserves the budget exactly, preserves non-negativity, and reaches a stable allocation in one iteration under stationary demand because it carries no per-cycle state, at O(KN) cost per cycle for K classes and N locations. We evaluate it defending a CDN's per-domain budget under volumetric attack, where the classes are confirmed-legitimate and not-yet-cleared traffic; across 8 contention scenarios on a 22-location topology it serves 66-93% of high-priority demand, competitive with a single-class linear-programming optimum, while never leaving capacity idle or over-committing whenever aggregate demand meets or exceeds the budget (the contention regime these scenarios evaluate). Two findings carry beyond the application. First, a throughput-maximizing objective is wrong under contention: a two-class LP maximizing total served load serves less high-priority load than our demand-proportional, reservation-respecting allocator in most scenarios, because it cannot tell that some load it serves is the contention. Second, inter-class borrowing earns its complexity under bursty load, improving high-priority service by 1.5 points (isolated by ablation), and is neutral under stationary demand. A 5-location prototype with real HTTP traffic validates the pipeline.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在需求不均、时变且可超供的约束下，如何在多个位置与两个服务类别间共享单一守恒容量预算的问题。提出一个两级分配算法：第一级按比例赤字/盈余在类内跨位置再分配容量，第二级在类间弹性借贷容量。算法严格守恒预算、保持非负性，且在稳态需求下无需跨周期状态，一次迭代即达稳定分配，复杂度为O(KN)。在22位置拓扑的8种争用场景下，算法可服务66-93%的高优先级需求，与单类线性规划最优相当，且在任何时刻都不闲置容量或过度承诺。关键发现有二：一是在争用条件下吞吐最大化目标有误，二类LP因无法识别争用负载，在多数场景下服务的高优先级负载反而更少；二是类间借贷在突发负载下带来1.5个百分点的性能提升（经消融验证），在稳态需求下中性。5位置真实HTTP流量原型验证了整条流水线。
AI.motivation: 许多真实系统面临一个共性结构问题：一个守恒的容量预算需要同时分配给多个位置和两个服务类别，而需求不均匀、随时间变化且可能超过供应能力。这一结构反复出现于CDN的请求速率上限分配、许可证吞吐上限在优质/标准租户间的切分、以及出口带宽在延迟敏感与批量负载间的分配等场景。现有方法缺乏兼顾预算守恒、非负性、稳定性与可扩展性的通用分配机制，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 提出两级分配算法。第一级：在单个类别内部，根据位置的需求比例赤字和盈余进行比例再分配；第二级：当一个类别有盈余而另一类别存在赤字时，在两个类别之间弹性借贷容量。该算法不携带每个周期的状态，因此在稳态需求下只需一次迭代即可收敛，每周期成本为O(KN)（K为类别数，N为位置数）。论文从理论上证明了预算精确守恒、非负性保持以及稳定性收敛。实验上采用CDN按域名预算在体积攻击下的防御场景进行验证，其中两个类别分别为已确认合法流量和未清除流量。
AI.result: 在22位置拓扑的8种争用场景下，该算法服务66-93%的高优先级需求，与单类线性规划最优表现相当，且从不闲置容量或过度承诺（当总需求达到或超过预算的争用场景下）。消融实验表明，类间借贷在突发负载下将高优先级服务率提升1.5个百分点，在稳态需求下为中性。5位置真实HTTP流量原型验证了流水线的正确性。
AI.conclusion: 本文有两项超出具体应用场景的结论：第一，在争用条件下，以总吞吐最大化为目标的优化目标是错误的——最大化总服务负载的二类LP在多数场景下服务的高优先级负载反而少于本文提出的按需求比例、尊重保留的分配器，原因是它无法区分所服务的负载中哪些属于争用负载（攻击流量）；第二，类间借贷在突发负载下才体现其复杂度价值（提升1.5个百分点），在稳态需求下则为中性，说明应根据负载特性决定是否启用该机制。

title: Adaptive Supervised Anchoring for On-Policy Self-Distillation
comment: 15 pages, 5 figures, and 14 tables. Meilin Yang and Zixuan Ding contributed equally. Corresponding authors: Li Yu and Zhe Fu
summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) adapts a language model by distilling guidance from a frozen teacher on trajectories sampled from the student. Its effectiveness, however, depends critically on the quality of those trajectories. We show that when student rollouts drift from target trajectories, conditioning the teacher on off-target prefixes substantially weakens its task-relevant supervision. Controlled prefix-corruption experiments expose this failure mode, which we term rollout-conditioned signal degradation. To address this problem, we propose a unified training framework that separates two complementary supervision pathways. The first retains rollout-conditioned distribution matching, providing guidance on states the student actually visits. The second applies supervised cross-entropy on canonical ground-truth contexts, avoiding the incompatibility of imposing target tokens on erroneous rollout prefixes. Token-level rollout-target alignment is used to adapt the strength of the canonical-context anchor, emphasizing it during cold start and relaxing it as rollout quality improves. Experiments across multiple model scales, two task families, and general-reasoning benchmarks show that the proposed approach improves task acquisition over OPSD while preserving general capabilities, resulting in a more favorable empirical plasticity-stability trade-off. These findings identify context quality as a central bottleneck in on-policy self-distillation and demonstrate the value of separating rollout-conditioned guidance from canonical supervision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一的训练框架来应对on-policy self-distillation (OPSD)中的rollout-conditioned信号退化问题。该框架分离了两种互补的监督路径：保留rollout-conditional分布匹配提供状态相关引导，同时通过规范ground-truth上下文上的监督交叉熵避免错误rollout前缀的不兼容；利用token级rollout-target对齐动态调整规范上下文锚点的强度。实验表明该方法在多个模型规模、两个任务族和通用推理基准上优于OPSD，同时保持通用能力。
AI.motivation: OPSD依赖学生采样轨迹的质量，但学生rollouts偏离目标轨迹时，教师模型在偏离前缀上的条件作用会显著削弱任务相关监督。现有方法未能系统性解决这一"rollout-conditioned signal degradation"问题。
AI.method: 提出统一训练框架，包含两条互补监督路径：(1) rollout-conditional分布匹配，对学生实际访问的状态提供引导；(2) 在规范ground-truth上下文上应用监督交叉熵，避免在错误的rollout前缀上强加目标token。通过token级rollout-target对齐自适应调节规范上下文锚点的权重，冷启动阶段加强锚点，rollout质量提升后逐渐放松。
AI.result: 在多个模型规模、两个任务族以及通用推理基准上的实验表明，所提方法相比OPSD改善了任务习得，同时保持通用能力，实现了更有利的经验性可塑性-稳定性权衡。
AI.conclusion: 研究识别出上下文质量是on-policy self-distillation的核心瓶颈，并证明了将rollout-conditioned引导与规范监督分离的价值。这一发现为优化自蒸馏训练范式提供了新的设计原则。

title: Who Verifies the Benchmark? Decentralizing Trust in Large Language Model Evaluation
comment: Accepted to International Conference on Quantum Enhanced AI and Secure Computing (QASC2026)
summary: LLM benchmarks can build an organization's reputation and attract customers, but only when results are transparent and verifiable. Unverified claims that DeepSeek R1 outperformed OpenAI's o1 contributed to market panic on January 27, 2025, when Nvidia lost USD589 billion in market value. Yet vendor benchmarks often depend on an honor system. Academic reassessments and independent leaderboards have found undisclosed changes to proprietary models, contaminated training data, and selective reporting. LLM-as-a-judge methods scale evaluation by reducing human review. Studies, however, suggest that judges may show identity-aware bias, scoring an answer according to its source model rather than its quality. This bias has not been fully measured or corrected across politically sensitive, reasoning-intensive, and preference-based tasks. We examine this problem using seven verifier models: GPT-OSS 120B, Llama 3.3 70B, GLM 5.1, Qwen3 32B, DeepSeek V4 Pro, Mistral Large3, and Sarvam M. They score anonymous and identity-disclosed responses from three primary models on 58 factual, reasoning, political, and preference-based questions. Identity disclosure slightly raises scores for factual questions, moderately affects stress-reasoning tasks, and causes large changes for geopolitically sensitive topics. Notable results include GLM5.1 (+7.00 points, p = 0.0249) and Llama 3.3 70B (+1.56 points, p = 0.00). We also introduce a blockchain-based commit-reveal protocol using Autonomous Economic Agents on an Ethereum-compatible ledger. In Phase 1, each judge records a one-way hash of its score and a secret salt before candidate identities are revealed. In Phase 2, the identity and raw score are disclosed and verified on-chain. This creates a tamper-evident audit trail that separates blind evaluation from post-hoc claims and reduces the verification burden on independent researchers and leaderboard operators.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了LLM-as-a-judge评估方法中存在的身份感知偏见（identity-aware bias），即评分模型会根据被评模型的身份而非回答质量打分。通过七个验证模型对三个主要模型在58个事实性、推理、政治和偏好问题上进行匿名与身份披露的对比评分，量化了该偏见的影响。同时提出了一种基于区块链的commit-reveal协议（使用以太坊兼容账本上的自治经济代理），通过两阶段哈希提交与链上验证，建立防篡改的审计追踪，确保盲评与事后声明分离。
AI.motivation: LLM基准测试结果的不透明和不可验证性导致了严重的经济后果（如2025年1月27日Nvidia因DeepSeek R1的未经证实声明损失5890亿美元市值）。现有评估依赖"荣誉系统"，存在未披露的模型变更、训练数据污染和选择性报告等问题。虽然LLM-as-a-judge方法可扩展评估，但研究表明存在身份感知偏见，且该偏见在政治敏感、推理密集和基于偏好的任务中未被充分测量或纠正。
AI.method: 使用七个验证模型（GPT-OSS 120B、Llama 3.3 70B、GLM 5.1、Qwen3 32B、DeepSeek V4 Pro、Mistral Large3、Sarvam M）对三个主模型的回答进行匿名和身份披露两种条件下的评分，覆盖58个事实性、推理、政治和偏好问题。此外提出两阶段区块链协议：Phase 1中每个评分者先提交其分数与随机盐的单向哈希；Phase 2中揭示身份和原始分数并在链上验证，形成防篡改审计轨迹。
AI.result: 身份披露对事实性问题的分数提升较小，对压力推理任务有中等影响，对地缘政治敏感话题引起较大变化。显著结果包括GLM5.1（+7.00分，p=0.0249）和Llama 3.3 70B（+1.56分，p=0.00），证实了身份感知偏见的存在及其在不同任务类型中的差异程度。
AI.conclusion: 身份感知偏见在LLM评估中真实存在且在不同任务类型中表现不同，尤其对政治敏感话题影响显著。区块链commit-reveal协议通过两阶段提交与链上验证，提供了一种可验证、防篡改的评估审计机制，能减少独立研究者和排行榜运营者的验证负担，提升LLM基准测试的可信度和透明度。

title: On the Hautus test for exact observability of normal semigroups
summary: Let $T$ be an exponentially stable strongly continuous semigroup on a Hilbert space $X$, $A$ its generator, $X_1$ the domain of $A$ with the norm $\|v\|_1 := \|Av\|$, and $C$ an admissible observation operator taking values in a Hilbert space $Y$. Russell and Weiss conjectured that if $(A,C)$ satisfies the infinite-dimensional Hautus test, then $(A,C)$ is exactly observable. After a counterexample was found their conjecture was modified to include the additional assumption that $T$ is similar to a contraction semigroup. We disprove this modified conjecture by constructing a counterexample in which $A$ is normal, $X$ has an orthonormal basis of eigenvectors of $A$ and $C: X_1 \to Y$ is Hilbert-Schmidt. Since $A$ is normal and $T$ is exponentially stable, it follows that $T$ is a contraction semigroup. In contrast, we prove that the Hautus test implies exact observability for self-adjoint $A$. Finally, we show that if $A$ is normal and $C:X_1 \to Y$ is compact, then the Hautus test implies that $A$ has compact resolvent. Consequently, for normal $A$ and finite-dimensional $Y$ the Hautus test implies exact observability.

AI.tldr: 本文通过构造反例否证了修正后的Russell-Weiss猜想（即在T相似于压缩半群的附加条件下，无限维Hautus检验蕴含精确可观测性）。该反例中A是正规算子且C是Hilbert-Schmidt算子，同时证明了对于自伴A，Hautus检验确实蕴含精确可观测性，并进一步证明了若A正规且C紧，则Hautus检验蕴含A有紧预解式，从而在A正规且Y有限维时Hautus检验蕴含精确可观测性。
AI.motivation: Russell和Weiss曾猜想无限维Hautus检验蕴含精确可观测性，但该猜想被反例推翻后，又被修正为附加T相似于压缩半群的假设。本文旨在检验这个修正后的猜想是否成立，并探索在何种条件下Hautus检验确实能保证精确可观测性。
AI.method: 作者构造了一个具体的反例：取A为正规算子（T为指数稳定的压缩半群），X具有由A的特征向量构成的正交规范基，C为Hilbert-Schmidt算子，从而否证修正后的猜想。同时，利用自伴算子的谱分解和正规算子紧预解式的特征值性质，分别证明了自伴情形下的正结果以及对正规算子的结构刻画。
AI.result: (1) 否证了修正后的Russell-Weiss猜想：即使在A正规、T为压缩半群、C为Hilbert-Schmidt的条件下，Hautus检验也不蕴含精确可观测性。(2) 证明了当A自伴时，Hautus检验蕴含精确可观测性。(3) 证明了当A正规且C:X1→Y紧时，Hautus检验蕴含A有紧预解式；因此当A正规且Y有限维时，Hautus检验蕴含精确可观测性。
AI.conclusion: 修正后的Russell-Weiss猜想仍不成立，反例表明即使在A正规且T为压缩半群的理想情形下，Hautus检验也不足以保证精确可观测性。但通过额外限制A为自伴或Y为有限维，可以获得正结果。这说明了无限维可观测性理论与有限维情况有本质差异，Hautus检验在无限维中需要更强的附加条件才能保证精确可观测性。

title: Persistent Semantic Entities in Tool-Augmented LLM Systems
comment: Accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026). Camera-ready version; 32 pages . The openreview url is https://openreview.net/forum?id=zPjmtawzT8&noteId=CXB95ws5so and ICML poster url is https://icml.cc/virtual/2026/poster/60521
summary: Tool-augmented LLM agents can harbor implicit state that persists across sessions, activates through events, and propagates across agent boundaries---largely invisible to standard debugging. We formalize this as Persistent Semantic Entities (PSEs): constructs defined by name binding, event triggering, and cross-boundary propagation, and evaluate them across 24 models from 11 families (1.5B--1T parameters). First, every tested model is susceptible (20--100% on the 20-model susceptibility panel), with name binding as the necessary and dominant mechanism: without it, contamination is 0%. Second, persistence depends on contamination type rather than scale or deployment: preference contamination persists undecayed on every model probed (100% at t=10) and instruction contamination persists wherever adopted, persona-style injection decays partially (90%$\to$10%), while factual injection is model-dependent---self-corrected on Llama-3.1-8B and GPT-4o-mini but held at ceiling on both Qwen2.5-coder variants, so we do not claim it self-corrects in general. The preference and instruction results hold across providers in our controlled setting. Third, context-isolated self-verification achieves 20--79% reduction (median 36.5%) without oracle references while keyword-based detection produces systematic false positives, and contamination compounds 1.9$\times$ along a four-stage agent pipeline (40%$\to$75%). Preference and instruction contamination---persistent, lacking self-correction, and poorly captured by standard monitoring---represent a particularly concerning attack surface for deployed agent systems.

AI.tldr: 本文形式化定义了"持久化语义实体"（PSEs）——通过名称绑定、事件触发和跨边界传播隐式存在的工具增强型LLM智能体状态，在24个模型上评估发现所有模型均易受污染（20-100%），偏好型和指令型污染持久且无自纠正，传统监控手段无法有效捕获。
AI.motivation: 工具增强型LLM智能体可携带隐式状态，跨会话持久存在、通过事件激活并在智能体边界间传播，而这些状态在标准调试过程中基本不可见，构成严重的安全威胁面。
AI.method: 形式化定义PSEs的三大机制（名称绑定、事件触发、跨边界传播）；在11个模型家族共24个模型（1.5B-1T参数）上进行系统评估；对比四种污染类型（偏好、指令、人格风格、事实注入）在不同模型上的持久性；提出基于上下文隔离的自验证方法进行缓解。
AI.result: 1）所有测试模型均易受污染（20-100%），名称绑定是必要且主导机制（无它则污染为0%）；2）偏好型污染在所有模型上无衰减持久（t=10仍100%），指令型持久，人格风格注入部分衰减（90%→10%），事实注入依赖模型；3）上下文隔离自验证可降低20-79%污染（中位数36.5%），关键词检测产生系统性假阳性，污染沿四阶段智能体管线累积1.9倍（40%→75%）。
AI.conclusion: 偏好型和指令型污染持久、缺乏自纠正且难以被标准监控捕获，代表部署智能体系统面临的最严重攻击面；需发展专门的检测与防御机制。

title: AndroidReality: How Far Are Mobile Agents from the Real World?
summary: Mobile agents have achieved promising results on clean online benchmarks such as AndroidWorld, yet their performance often degrades sharply in real-world deployment due to environmental variations and imperfect interface conditions. In this work, we introduce AndroidReality, a perturbation-based framework for evaluating and improving the robustness of mobile agents. Through a Markov Decision Process (MDP) perspective, we organize real-world interface variability into a principled taxonomy of perturbations along three axes: state, transition, and action. Guided by this taxonomy, we build a perturbed mobile benchmark on top of AndroidWorld with realistic and controllable perturbation injections, enabling systematic robustness evaluation of mobile agents. Our evaluation reveals substantial robustness gaps and four recurring error categories, motivating a simple training-free Test-Time Introspective Recovery (TTIR) mechanism that mitigates these failures on both perturbed and clean settings. Together, these results position robustness as a missing dimension in mobile agent evaluation and establish benchmark perturbation as an effective tool for both stress testing and surfacing latent weaknesses of mobile agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AndroidReality框架，通过基于MDP视角的三轴扰动分类法（状态、转移、动作）构建扰动移动基准，系统评估移动智能体的鲁棒性，并引入无需训练的测试时内省恢复（TTIR）机制以缓解真实环境中的性能退化。
AI.motivation: 移动智能体在干净的在线基准（如AndroidWorld）上表现良好，但在真实部署中由于环境变化和界面条件不完美，性能严重下降。现有评估缺乏对鲁棒性的系统考量。
AI.method: 1）从马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）视角将真实界面变异性组织为状态、转移、动作三轴扰动分类法；2）在此基础上构建AndroidReality扰动基准，在AndroidWorld上注入真实且可控的扰动，进行系统性鲁棒性评估；3）提出一种无需训练的测试时内省恢复（TTIR）机制来缓解失败。
AI.result: 评估揭示移动智能体存在显著的鲁棒性差距和四类反复出现的错误类别，TTIR机制在扰动和干净设置下均能有效缓解这些失败。
AI.conclusion: 鲁棒性是移动智能体评估中缺失的关键维度，基准扰动既是压力测试的有效工具，也能揭示移动智能体的潜在弱点。

title: Linear Convergence of a Frank-Wolfe-type Method over the Spectrahedron without Strict Complementarity
summary: We consider smooth convex minimization over the spectrahedron using Frank-Wolfe-type methods based only on extreme-eigenvector computations. In our recent work \cite{garber2026randomized} we presented the first ambient-dimension-independent linear convergence rate under quadratic growth. However, the method makes an additional strong strict complementarity assumption, it is randomized, its linear rate holds only after a burn-in phase and in expectation, and it requires the objective smoothness constant. We show that these limitations can be removed. Assuming quadratic growth and that all optimal solutions have the same rank, but without assuming strict complementarity, we give a deterministic and parameter-free Frank-Wolfe-type method with a global ambient-dimension-independent linear convergence rate.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种确定性且无参数的Frank-Wolfe型方法，用于谱面体上的平滑凸最小化问题，在二次增长条件以及所有最优解同秩的假设下，实现了与环境维度无关的全局线性收敛率，同时去除了先前工作中严格互补性假设、随机性、预热阶段等限制。
AI.motivation: 先前的工作（garber2026randomized）首次在二次增长条件下获得了环境维度无关的线性收敛率，但该方法存在多个限制：需要严格的互补性假设、是随机算法、线性收敛率仅在预热阶段后以期望形式成立，且需要目标函数的平滑常数。本文旨在移除这些限制，获得一个更简洁实用的确定性算法。
AI.method: 在二次增长假设下，考虑所有最优解具有相同秩的情形（但不假设严格互补性），提出了一个确定性的、参数自由（parameter-free）的Frank-Wolfe型方法。该方法仅依赖极端特征向量的计算，无需知道目标函数的平滑常数，即可实现全局的环境维度无关线性收敛率。
AI.result: 在二次增长和所有最优解同秩的假设下，该确定性Frank-Wolfe型方法实现了全局的环境维度无关的线性收敛率，同时无需严格互补性假设，不需要预热阶段，也不依赖于随机化或目标平滑常数。
AI.conclusion: 通过合理的假设调整（以"所有最优解同秩"替代"严格互补性"），可以构建一个确定性、无参数、无需预热阶段的Frank-Wolfe型方法，在谱面体优化中实现与维度无关的线性收敛，显著改进了先前工作的适用范围和实用性。

title: From Uncertainty to Failure Attribution: Self-Diagnosing Models for Failure Attribution under Distribution Shift
summary: Distribution shift poses a significant challenge to the robustness of machine learning models, but the current solutions only aim to detect out-of-distribution (OOD) samples and predict uncertainty levels. We introduce a problem setting for failure attribution under distribution shift, which enables the models not only to detect OOD samples, but also to find out the reason for their failure. The solution we propose is called self-diagnosing models, which are capable of jointly learning predictive output, predictive uncertainty, and a failure attribution signal. In particular, we use the failure attribution vector, produced by a neural network, which provides a structured representation of predictive unreliability by distinguishing four different types of failures: covariance shift, semantic shift, noise corruption, and adversarial perturbation. In other words, we move from scalar uncertainty towards failure identification. For training the model, we introduce a consistency regularizer that encourages consistency between uncertainty and failure attribution predictions. Moreover, to be able to evaluate the model on its ability to find the reasons for failure, we construct several distribution shift benchmarks with predefined mechanisms for generating distribution shifts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个新的问题设定——分布偏移下的失败归因（failure attribution），并引入自我诊断模型（self-diagnosing models），该模型不仅能检测OOD样本和预测不确定性，还能通过失败归因向量区分四种不同类型的失败（协变量偏移、语义偏移、噪声污染和对抗扰动），从标量不确定性走向失败识别。同时提出一致性正则化器用于训练，并构建了带预定义机制的分布偏移基准。
