On LongMemEval-S, our store-of-record configuration reaches 92.8% accuracy (464/500; best of N=3) at mean $0.00161/question (approximately 18.3k tokens; median $0.00111 / approximately 14.6k) with deepseek-v4-flash. We compile public systems with estimable API cost into a cost table and cost-accuracy map; under these estimates SodaMem sits near the accuracy frontier at Flash-tier spend and strictly dominates several higher-cost, lower-accuracy points. Accuracy uses the same Flash model as reader and judge (self-grading); costs exclude ingest/judge and cross-system comparisons are compiled estimates rather than a single-harness bake-off.Our code is available at https://github.com/SodaMem/SodaMem

AI.tldr: SodaMem 是一种基于证据的时间图记忆系统，用于增强长期交互场景下 LLM 代理的记忆能力。它通过提取带有出处跨度（provenance spans）的类型化事实事件，持久化提及时间、发生时间和有效性，并使用 SUPERSEDES/CONTRADICTS/UPDATES 边在混合词汇-稠密索引下组织记忆，最终通过规划器-阅读器循环收集可引用证据后生成回答。在 LongMemEval-S 上达到 92.8% 准确率，平均每问成本 0.00161 美元。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 RAG 的扁平记忆（如 Markdown 日志或向量库）虽擅长检索特定信息（needle retrieval），但在支撑信息的时效性（currency）、出处可追溯性（provenance）以及有序时间推理方面存在不足。长期对话中代理需要记住"当前真实的情况"而非"曾经说过的话"，因此需要更结构化的记忆机制。
AI.method: SodaMem 采用三阶段设计：(1) 提取带强制出处跨度的类型化 FactEvents；(2) 持久化提及时间、发生时间与有效性，并通过 SUPERSEDES/CONTRADICTS/UPDATES 边建立事实间的时序关系，配合混合词汇-稠密索引；(3) 通过规划器-阅读器（planner-reader）循环先收集可引用证据，再生成最终回答。
AI.result: 在 LongMemEval-S 基准上，SodaMem 的 store-of-record 配置达到 92.8% 准确率（464/500，N=3 最优），平均每问成本 0.00161 美元（约 18.3k tokens，中位数 0.00111 美元/约 14.6k tokens），使用 deepseek-v4-flash 模型。在成本-准确率映射图上，SodaMem 位于 Flash 档位的准确率前沿附近，并严格支配了多个更高成本但更低准确率的系统。
AI.conclusion: SodaMem 证明了证据驱动的时序图记忆能够在低成本（Flash 档位）下达到高准确率，优于或严格支配更昂贵的对比系统。但需要说明的是：准确率评测使用同一 Flash 模型作为读者与裁判（自评分），成本估算不包含入库与判定开销，且跨系统对比是基于估算而非同平台统一直测。

title: H2: A Dual Hybrid Semantic Data Lake Architecture for Medical Data Harmonization with Human-In-the-Loop verified, LLM Driven Metadata Annotation System
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: Medical data, by its nature, exhibit a high degree of heterogeneity on multiple levels ranging from (a) different modalities like images, text and time series, (b) diverse tabular schemata introduced by institutions and (c) completely unstructured textual information data provided by healthcare professionals. Data lakes are often used in medical data storage to consolidate all heterogeneous diverse data in a single, central location, where it can be saved "as is", without the need to impose a schema like a data warehouse does. Despite their flexibility, though, data lakes are notorious for the "data swamp" failure. Thus, providing a reliable data harmonization mechanism through metadata, without compromising integrity or flexibility, is a real challenge. To this end, knowledge graphs have attracted attention since they provide a dynamic way to depict relationships without a rigid schema-on-write approach. Additionally, another rigorous task relies on the interoperability of data: application of appropriate ML techniques on such a diverse nature of data is not an easy task, as a domain expert must decide the efficacy of a method to a specific data type or dataset. Metadata annotation can aid by tagging applicable operations, however this requires manual intervention, not to mention the plethora of existing datasets which lack such information. To tackle both challenges, in this paper, we propose a semantic data lake architecture that promotes data harmonization and incorporates a generative annotation process (i.e. LLMs) of non-labeled metadata collections to support the application of meaningful ML techniques. Building on top of this approach, we create a higher level of knowledge, identifying suitability of data with respect to applicable ML operations based on their data nature...

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种语义数据湖架构，通过知识图谱促进医学数据的统一协调，并利用大语言模型（LLMs）对未标注的元数据集合进行生成式标注，以支持有意义的机器学习技术应用。该架构在数据调和的基础上构建更高层次的知识，识别数据与适用ML操作之间的适配性。
AI.motivation: 医学数据在多个层面呈现高度异质性（模态、表格模式、非结构化文本），数据湖虽灵活但容易退化为"数据沼泽"。同时，在多样化数据上应用合适的ML技术需要领域专家的手动判断，且大量现有数据集缺乏元数据信息。因此需要一种既能保持数据湖灵活性，又能通过元数据实现数据调和与ML技术适配的自动化机制。
AI.method: 1) 提出语义数据湖架构，利用知识图谱在不施加刚性schema-on-write约束的前提下动态刻画数据间关系，促进数据调和；2) 引入基于LLMs的生成式标注过程，自动为未打标签的元数据集合生成注释；3) 在数据调和基础上构建更高层次的知识层，根据数据性质判断其与特定ML操作的适用性。
AI.result: 该架构同时解决两个核心挑战：(a) 通过知识图谱驱动的语义数据湖实现可靠的数据调和机制，不牺牲数据的完整性或灵活性；(b) 通过LLM驱动的生成式标注过程，自动化地为缺乏元数据的医疗数据集标注适用的ML操作，减少对手动干预的依赖。
AI.conclusion: 提出的语义数据湖架构通过知识图谱与LLM生成式标注相结合的方式，为医学异质数据的调和与ML技术适配提供了可行的自动化方案，有效应对了数据沼泽问题及缺乏元数据标注的挑战。

title: Rethinking Learning-Based Influence Maximization: Simple Neural Surrogates and Native Discrete Search
summary: Existing learning-based influence maximization frameworks rely heavily on complex neural architectures and continuous optimization over seed representations. We challenge this paradigm with SIMBA, a diffusion-model-agnostic framework pairing a lightweight neural surrogate with direct discrete search. SIMBA introduces three key components: 1) uniformly anchored node embeddings that eliminate initialization noise and encourage learning driven by graph topology and diffusion pattern, 2) a shallow two-layer graph neural network surrogate predicting final infection states, and 3) batched multi-swap simulated annealing that explores combinatorial seed space without gradients or continuous relaxation. By shifting compute from complex representation learning to effective discrete search, SIMBA drastically cuts time-to-solution while achieving superior influence spread and data efficiency. Our code is available at https://github.com/yl489/rethink-IM.

AI.tldr: SIMBA是一个与扩散模型无关的影响力最大化框架，通过轻量级神经网络代理配合直接离散搜索，替代了复杂的神经架构和连续优化方法。它采用均匀锚定节点嵌入、浅层两层GNN代理和批处理多交换模拟退火三大核心组件，大幅降低求解时间的同时提升影响力传播效果和数据效率。
AI.motivation: 现有基于学习的影响力最大化框架过度依赖复杂的神经架构和对种子表示的连续优化，导致计算开销大且效率低下。作者旨在挑战这一范式，探索是否可以通过轻量级代理模型与直接离散搜索相结合的方式，在降低计算成本的同时获得更优的性能。
AI.method: SIMBA包含三个关键组件：1) 均匀锚定节点嵌入，消除初始化噪声并促使学习由图拓扑和扩散模式驱动；2) 浅层两层GNN代理模型，用于预测最终感染状态；3) 批处理多交换模拟退火算法，在组合种子空间中进行无梯度的直接离散搜索。该方法将计算重心从复杂表示学习转移到高效的离散搜索上。
AI.result: SIMBA在时间-解决方案上大幅缩短，同时实现了更优的影响力传播效果和更高的数据效率，证明了轻量级代理加离散搜索范式在影响力最大化任务中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究重新思考了影响力最大化的范式，表明无需复杂的神经架构和连续优化即可达到甚至超越现有方法的性能，为影响力最大化问题提供了一种更高效、更简单且与扩散模型无关的替代方案。

title: CORDA: A Benchmark for Hierarchical Harm-Centric Moral Reasoning in Large Language Models
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures. Accepted at the Fourth International Workshop on Value Engineering in AI (VALE 2026), affiliated with IJCAI-ECAI 2026
summary: The key question in moral judgement is not simply whether someone chooses the "right" answer, but how they decide what matters most when moral principles conflict. Current evaluations of large language models (LLMs) remain limited: most test whether models give morally acceptable answers, match human preferences, or avoid obvious violations, rather than whether they can prioritise between competing principles when no option is morally cost-free. We introduce CORDA (Conditioned Ordering and Ranked Directive Adherence), a benchmark for evaluating hierarchical, harm-centred moral reasoning in LLMs. Building on the morality chains formalism, CORDA tests 90 moral dilemmas involving trolley-style cases, medical trade-offs, resource allocation, and human-animal-robot conflicts across four ordered ethical frameworks: Utility, Utility + Agent Harm, Dual-Process, and Dual-Process + Agent Harm. Together, these frameworks test whether models can adapt their decisions when moral priorities change. Across ten instruction-tuned models from seven providers, we find a strong deontological default, with 9 of 10 prioritising avoidance of direct personal harm over reducing overall harm. Models also perform more reliably on categorical harm-avoidance rules, such as avoiding killing, than on outcome-based comparisons, such as minimising total harm, suggesting that they recognise moral red lines more easily than they reason through competing harms. Although all models respond to explicit chain conditioning, several fail to consistently follow specified priority orderings, such as humans over animals and animals over robots. CORDA addresses a central gap in LLM moral evaluation by testing whether models can move beyond default harm-avoidant responses and apply context-specified moral priorities. Moral reliability requires more than default restraint; it requires controllability under conflict.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CORDA基准，用于评估大语言模型在道德原则冲突时的分层道德推理能力，发现模型普遍存在道义论默认倾向（优先避免直接伤害而非减少总体伤害），且对明确的优先级排序遵循能力不足。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM道德评估主要测试模型是否给出道德上可接受的答案、是否匹配人类偏好或避免明显违规，但没有测试模型在面对无道德代价选择的冲突情景时，能否在相互竞争的原则之间进行优先级排序。道德判断的关键不仅在于选择"正确"答案，还在于当道德原则冲突时如何决定什么最重要。
AI.method: 作者提出CORDA（Conditioned Ordering and Ranked Directive Adherence）基准，基于morality chains形式化方法，构建90个道德困境（电车难题、医疗权衡、资源分配、人-动物-机器人冲突），涵盖四种有序伦理框架：效用主义、效用+代理伤害、双过程、双过程+代理伤害，对来自7个提供商的10个指令微调模型进行评估。
AI.result: 发现：1）10个模型中有9个表现出强烈的道义论默认倾向，优先避免直接个人伤害而非减少整体伤害；2）模型在分类性伤害避免规则（如避免杀戮）上表现更可靠，优于结果导向的比较（如最小化总体伤害）；3）所有模型能响应显式链式条件化，但多个模型无法一致遵循指定的优先级顺序（如人类优于动物、动物优于机器人）。
AI.conclusion: 道德可靠性不仅需要默认的克制（道德红线识别），更需要冲突情境下的可控性。CORDA填补了LLM道德评估中关于"上下文指定道德优先级应用能力"的关键空白，表明当前模型在需要超越默认伤害回避行为并以特定优先级推理方面仍存在不足。

title: Explore, Map, Remember, Decide: Are Embodied VLMs Ready for Safety-Critical Scenarios?
summary: Theory of Space framework (ToS) assesses the spatial understanding of curiosity-driven Vision-Language Models (VLMs) under partial observability. As AI techniques are increasingly applied to safety-critical scenarios, it is crucial to understand whether VLMs possess robust spatial memory and make reliable decisions. In this paper, we assess whether VLMs' decisions are based on physical evidence or are corrupted by visual-language biases, if their memory processes align with human cognitive patterns, and how they respond to environmental hazards. We extend the ToS framework into a safety-critical, goal-driven pipeline, named Explore, Map, Remember, and Decide (EMRD). We then quantify Exploration Competence (Explore) through metrics of environmental coverage and temporal efficiency, assess Spatial Fidelity (Map), evaluate, with a suite of psychological metrics, Memory Persistence (Remember), and measure, using focal-point metrics, Cognitive Decision-Making (Decide). Our results show that in terms of decision-making capabilities, VLMs frequently select evacuation points based on pre-trained textual priors while lacking the spatial grounding to justify their choices. We also show that spatial reasoning degrades in low-light conditions, but it is not affected by texture and colour tampering. Our findings suggest that VLM memory fundamentally diverges from human cognition, creating unpredictable risks of misalignment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EMRD框架（Explore, Map, Remember, Decide），基于Theory of Space (ToS)框架，在部分可观测条件下评估好奇驱动的视觉语言模型（VLMs）的空间理解能力，包括探索能力、空间保真度、记忆持久性和认知决策。研究发现VLMs常基于预训练文本先验选择疏散点而缺乏空间依据，空间推理在低光条件下退化但不受纹理和颜色篡改影响，且VLM记忆与人类认知存在根本性分歧。
AI.motivation: 随着AI技术越来越多地应用于安全关键场景，需要理解VLM是否具备稳健的空间记忆并做出可靠决策，以及它们的决策是基于物理证据还是被视觉-语言偏差所破坏。
AI.method: 将ToS框架扩展为安全关键、目标驱动的管道EMRD：通过环境覆盖率和时间效率量化探索能力（Explore），通过空间保真度指标评估空间映射（Map），通过一套心理学指标评估记忆持久性（Remember），并通过焦点指标测量认知决策（Decide）。
AI.result: VLMs在决策时频繁基于预训练文本先验选择疏散点而缺乏空间依据；空间推理在低光条件下显著退化，但不受纹理和颜色篡改影响。
AI.conclusion: VLM的记忆过程与人类认知模式存在根本性分歧，这可能在安全关键应用中造成不可预测的对齐风险（misalignment）。

title: Optimal Learning Under Tsybakov Noise
summary:
Probably Approximately Correct (PAC) learning [Val84] is a fundamental learning model that has been extensively investigated. In this model, $\mathcal{H} \subseteq \{0,1\}^{\mathcal{X}}$ is a concept class, and $h^*\in\mathcal{H}$ is the target concept to be learned. Having access to i.i.d. labeled examples from a distribution $\mathcal{D}$ over $\mathcal{X}\times\{0,1\}$, which admits $h^*$ as the best concept in $\mathcal{H}$, the goal is to design a learning algorithm that outputs a hypothesis having low error competitive to $h^{*}$ with high probability.
  This model was initially studied under the realizable setting, which assumes that $h^*$ has no error. A natural relaxation is to allow label noise, that is, the true label can be flipped with probability $η\in(0,1/2)$. In reality, certain labels might be extremely noisy, especially for those points near the decision boundary. Hence, it is natural to allow very noisy points, though only rarely. This is quantified by a noise model introduced by [MT99] and [Tsy04], now known as Tsybakov noise. For learning general concept classes, [MN06] gave the general upper and lower bounds for error guarantees under Tsybakov noise. However, their upper and lower bounds differ by a logarithmic factor. Resolving this gap has remained a well-known open question for the past twenty years.
  In this work, we resolve this open question by improving the upper bound to match the best known lower bound, thus establishing the optimal error guarantee for learning under Tsybakov noise. Our learning algorithm operates by adaptively partitioning the instance space into regions, roughly corresponding to different noise levels, and returning a hypothesis in the concept class satisfying a specific error constraint for each region. Our technique shares a conceptual foundation with several recent advances in non-realizable learning, such as [HLZ24] and [Han25].

AI.tldr: 本文解决了PAC学习在Tsybakov噪声下误差保证的开放问题，通过改进上界使其匹配已知最优下界，从而确立最优误差保证。算法通过自适应划分实例空间为不同噪声水平的区域，并在每个区域满足特定误差约束。
AI.motivation: PAC学习是可学习理论的基石，但此前MN06在Tsybakov噪声下的上下界存在一个对数因子的差距，这一问题悬而未决二十年，需要填补。
AI.method: 算法自适应地将实例空间划分为对应不同噪声水平的区域，并在每个区域内返回满足特定误差约束的概念类假设，其技术基础与HLZ24和Han25等非实可学习的最新进展共享概念基础。
AI.result: 将上界改进至与最佳已知下界匹配，建立了Tsybakov噪声下学习的最优误差保证，闭合了MN06遗留的二十年开放问题。
AI.conclusion: 通过将上界优化至与下界匹配，确立了Tsybakov噪声设置下PAC学习的最优误差保证，解决了一个长期开放的经典问题。

title: PATH: Next-Interval Prediction via Autoregressive Tree Hierarchy on Tabular Data
summary: Interval prediction aims to achieve a target coverage level while producing intervals that are as short as possible. Many conformal regression pipelines first predict an uncertainty surrogate and then convert it into an interval through calibration or selection. This separation supports coverage calibration, but post hoc rules largely determine the final interval and do not fully use the learned output distribution. We observe that the resulting intervals have inherently hierarchical geometry: an interval can be recursively refined into nested subintervals, and binary trees naturally represent this structure. We formulate this hierarchy as next-interval prediction and propose PATH, which learns how probability mass flows from each interval to its next nested subintervals. PATH predicts a base leaf distribution and uses an autoregressive decoder to refine branch probabilities. Matching the distribution to the interval hierarchy aligns learning with extraction: PATH accumulates probability over adjacent output intervals and returns the shortest contiguous range reaching a selected mass. We compare PATH with 24 baselines for interval prediction on PATHBench, comprising 56 OpenML regression datasets. PATH substantially shortens the resulting intervals, achieving the lowest mean normalized length, 0.1473, while maintaining mean coverage of 0.9144. These results establish hierarchical output modeling as an effective approach for compact interval prediction on tabular data. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/pxcai/PATH.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PATH方法，将区间预测建模为下一区间预测的层次化问题，通过自回归解码器学习区间间概率流，在56个OpenML数据集上以0.1473的平均归一化长度（保持0.9144覆盖率）显著优于24个基线方法。
AI.motivation: 传统共形回归管线将不确定性代理与区间转换分离，事后规则决定最终区间，未能充分利用学习的输出分布，导致区间不够紧凑。作者观察到区间具有内在层次几何结构（可递归细分为嵌套子区间，可用二叉树表示），并希望利用这一结构来生成更短的预测区间。
AI.method: PATH将区间预测转化为next-interval预测问题：预测基础叶分布，使用自回归解码器细化分支概率，学习概率质量从每个区间向其嵌套子区间的流动方式。通过将分布与区间层次对齐，PATH在相邻输出区间上累积概率，返回达到选定质量的最短连续范围。
AI.result: 在PATHBench（含56个OpenML回归数据集）上对比24个基线，PATH取得最低平均归一化长度0.1473，同时维持平均覆盖率0.9144，大幅缩短预测区间。
AI.conclusion: 层次化输出建模是表格数据紧凑区间预测的有效方法，代码已公开。

title: FSTC-Encoder: Feature--Spatial--Temporal Correlation Learning for Generalizable RF Sensing
comment: 9 pages, 2 figures, and 6 tables. Submitted to the 41st AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence (AAAI 2027)
summary: Heterogeneous RF sensing differs substantially in feature structure, spatial layout, and temporal scale, making existing models difficult to reuse across devices, environments, and RF modalities. We propose FSTC-Encoder, which unifies heterogeneous RF representation learning through feature, spatial, and temporal correlation modeling. Structure-aware feature encoding accommodates different signal structures, set-based spatial encoding aggregates variable observations, and hierarchical temporal encoding jointly captures local variations and long-range dependencies. Across sensing tasks and modalities, FSTC-Encoder retains the same spatial--temporal backbone architecture while varying only the feature configuration and task head. Across Widar3.0, CSI-Bench, and XRF55, FSTC-Encoder achieves 92.15% mean Accuracy under multi-factor cross-domain protocols, ranks first on three of four additional sensing tasks, remains consistently strong across WiFi, millimeter-wave radar, and RFID, and reduces the cross-modality performance gap from 18.85% to 12.93% through cross-RF learning. These results demonstrate that FSTC-Encoder achieves high domain robustness, task generality, and modality extensibility.

AI.tldr: 提出FSTC-Encoder，通过特征、空间、时间三个维度的相关性建模来统一异构RF感知任务，在多个跨域协议下达到92.15%平均准确率，并显著缩小跨模态性能差距。
AI.motivation: 异构RF感知在特征结构、空间布局和时间尺度上差异显著，现有模型难以在不同设备、环境和RF模态之间复用，缺乏统一的表征学习框架。
AI.method: FSTC-Encoder包含三个核心组件：结构感知特征编码（适配不同信号结构）、基于集合的空间编码（聚合可变观测）、层次化时间编码（同时捕获局部变化和长程依赖）。整个框架在不同传感任务和模态下保持相同的时空骨干架构，仅变化特征配置和任务头。
AI.result: 在Widar3.0、CSI-Bench和XRF55上，多因子跨域协议下平均准确率达92.15%；在四个附加感知任务中有三个排名第一；在WiFi、毫米波雷达和RFID上保持一致强性能；通过跨RF学习将跨模态性能差距从18.85%降至12.93%。
AI.conclusion: FSTC-Encoder展现出高领域鲁棒性、任务通用性和模态可扩展性，验证了统一异构RF表征学习的有效性。

title: Generative Models: Principles, Architectures, and Applications
summary: Generative AI has emerged as one of the most transformative forces in modern artificial intelligence, reshaping how we create, imagine, and interact with digital content. From photorealistic images to coherent text, from immersive videos to novel molecular structures, generative models now power applications that were once confined to science fiction. This book is designed to guide readers through the foundational principles, mathematical underpinnings, and practical architectures that underpin this revolution.

AI.tldr: 本书系统介绍生成式人工智能的基础原理、数学基础及实际架构，覆盖从图像、文本、视频到分子结构等多种生成应用，旨在为读者提供理解生成式AI革命的全面指南。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI已成为现代人工智能中最具变革性的力量之一，重塑了数字内容的创作、想象与交互方式，因此需要一系统性的指南帮助读者掌握其核心原理。
AI.method: 通过组织内容涵盖生成模型的三个关键层面：基础原理（foundational principles）、数学支撑（mathematical underpinnings）以及实用架构（practical architectures），系统性地引导读者理解生成式AI的核心概念。
AI.result: 本书涵盖从照片级真实图像、连贯文本、沉浸式视频到新型分子结构等多类生成模型应用场景，展现了生成模型从科幻走向现实的演进过程。
AI.conclusion: 生成式AI已深刻改变数字内容生产范式，本书旨在为读者提供理解这一技术革命所需的完整知识框架与学习路径。

title: MGMCL: Multi-Granularity Manifold Contrastive Learning With Neural ODEs for Cross-Subject EEG Emotion Recognition
summary: Cross-subject electroencephalogram (EEG)-based emotion recognition remains challenging due to substantial inter-individual variability and discrete formulation that overlooks affective continuity. Existing methods operate in Euclidean space and focus on marginal distribution alignment, failing to preserve the semantic structure of emotions across subjects. This article proposes MGMCL, reconceptualizing emotion recognition as learning continuous representations on symmetric positive definite (SPD) Riemannian manifolds. The frame?work introduces multi-granularity manifold contrastive learning at instance, emotion, and trajectory levels while preserving semantic ordering. Neural ordinary differential equations on manifolds model continuous emotion dynamics. Cross-subject generalization employs Gromov-Wasserstein manifold alignment. Weakly-supervised learning enables continuous valence-arousal-dominance prediction from discrete labels. Extensive experiments on three public datasets demonstrate state-of-the-art performance: 91.23% accuracy on SEED, 73.82% on SEED-IV, and 76.38% on DEAP, achieving consistent improvements of 1.89%, 1.66%, and 1.28% over previous best methods, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MGMCL框架，将跨被试EEG情绪识别重新概念化为在对称正定（SPD）黎曼流形上学习连续表示。通过多粒度流形对比学习（实例、情绪、轨迹三个层级）保留语义排序，利用流形上的神经常微分方程建模连续情绪动态，采用Gromov-Wasserstein流形对齐实现跨被试泛化，并在弱监督下从离散标签预测连续的效价-唤醒-支配度。在SEED、SEED-IV和DEAP三个公开数据集上分别达到91.23%、73.82%和76.38%的准确率，相比此前最优方法分别提升1.89%、1.66%和1.28%。
AI.motivation: 跨被试EEG情绪识别面临两大挑战：一是个体间差异大导致的泛化困难；二是现有方法将情绪识别视为离散分类问题，忽略了情绪在时间上的连续性和语义结构。已有方法在欧氏空间中操作且仅关注边际分布对齐，无法保持不同被试间情绪的语义结构，亟需一种能够建模情绪连续动态并保持语义顺序的新框架。
AI.method: MGMCL框架的核心包括：(1) 将EEG协方差特征映射到SPD黎曼流形上学习连续表示；(2) 在实例、情绪和轨迹三个粒度上设计多粒度流形对比学习，同时保持情绪的语义排序（例如效价从负到正的单调顺序）；(3) 在流形上使用神经常微分方程（Neural ODE）建模情绪的连续时间动态；(4) 采用Gromov-Wasserstein距离进行流形对齐，实现跨被试泛化；(5) 通过弱监督学习，从离散标签中预测连续的效价-唤醒-支配度（VAD）三维情绪模型。
AI.result: 在SEED、SEED-IV和DEAP三个公开数据集上进行广泛实验，MGMCL分别取得91.23%、73.82%和76.38%的准确率，相较此前最优方法分别取得1.89%、1.66%和1.28%的一致性提升，达到最先进水平（SOTA）。
AI.conclusion: MGMCL通过将情绪识别从欧氏空间离散分类范式拓展到SPD流形上的连续表示学习范式，有效解决了跨被试差异和情绪连续性问题。多粒度对比学习与流形对齐策略共同保障了语义结构在不同被试间的迁移，为EEG情绪识别提供了新的理论框架和实用方法。

title: Think Deep, Speak Once: Relit, A Recursive Latent Implicit Transformer Framework
summary: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting has become the dominant paradigm for eliciting reasoning in Large Language Models (LLMs), yet it creates substantial computational overhead by forcing models to externalize intermediate reasoning steps as discrete tokens. Recent latent reasoning approaches attempt to internalize this process within continuous hidden states. One of the latest advancements in the field of latent reasoning, Tiny Recursive Models (TRMs) excel at symbolic reasoning but struggle to preserve semantic coherence in natural language settings. To bridge this gap, we introduce ReLIT (Recursive Latent Implicit Transformer), a hybrid framework that grounds deep recursive reasoning within the rich semantic representations of a foundational model. ReLIT augments a frozen LLM backbone (TinyLlama-1.1B) with a lightweight, trainable recursive block that iteratively refines its latent thinking (z) before committing to a final output, structurally solving linguistic intuition from algorithmic processing and enabling "deep thinking" via gradient-isolated recurrent loops without the latency of explicit token generation. Empirically, ReLIT achieves high parameter efficiency on the GLoRE logical reasoning benchmark, matching or outperforming significantly larger models on challenging tasks such as ProofWriter and RuleTaker despite minimal supervision. These results demonstrate that reasoning capability can be scaled efficiently through recurrent depth rather than parameter width, offering a principled framework for semantically grounded implicit reasoning.

AI.tldr: ReLIT是一个混合框架，将深度递归推理嵌入冻结的LLM骨干网络（TinyLlama-1.1B）中，通过轻量级可训练递归块在连续隐空间中迭代优化潜在思考，以无显式token生成的方式实现高效隐式推理，在GLoRE逻辑推理基准上以极少参数匹敌或超越更大模型。
AI.motivation: CoT提示迫使模型将中间推理步骤外化为离散token，带来巨大计算开销。现有潜在推理方法（如TRMs）在符号推理上表现出色，但在自然语言环境中难以保持语义连贯性，需要一种兼顾符号推理能力与语义理解能力的隐式推理框架。
AI.method: ReLIT在冻结的LLM骨干（TinyLlama-1.1B）上附加一个轻量级可训练递归块，该块在连续隐空间中迭代优化潜在思考向量z，通过梯度隔离的循环结构实现"深度思考"，将深层递归推理锚定在基础模型的丰富语义表征之上，最终才提交输出。
AI.result: ReLIT在GLoRE逻辑推理基准上实现了高参数效率，在ProofWriter和RuleTaker等具有挑战性的任务上，以极少的监督匹敌或超越了显著更大的模型。
AI.conclusion: 推理能力可以通过递归深度而非参数宽度进行高效扩展，该框架为语义支撑的隐式推理提供了原则性方案。

title: Neurosymbolic Discovery of Algebraic Graph Constructions
summary:
There are several methods for searching for graphs with prescribed properties, such as SAT solvers and specialized generators. These methods return the result as raw data: an adjacency matrix or a string encoding. The raw data certifies that the graph exists, but it does not reveal any structural properties of the graph. We ask whether one can automatically discover a short algebraic description if only this raw data is provided. We look for a description such as a Cayley graph $\mathrm{Cay}(Γ, S)$ or a lexicographic product $C_5[K_3]$.
  We address this question with a neurosymbolic approach. We propose an agent that runs on a general-purpose large language model with no fine-tuning or per-target training. The model interleaves reasoning with calls to the computer algebra system SageMath: it analyzes the target graph, proposes and tests candidate constructions, and revises them until the output matches the target. The agent communicates with SageMath through a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, which we release as a general-purpose bridge. Whether a construction matches the target is checked by a single exact isomorphism test, and therefore rests on the symbolic side and not on the model. We test the approach on a benchmark of 100 highly symmetric graphs, namely two-orbit graphs on up to 25 vertices; the benchmark was fixed in advance. Our agent could find verified algebraic constructions for all of them, without falling back to raw encodings. A strong template-enumeration baseline reaches only about $20\%$, and a catalog lookup could not identify any of these graphs. However, construction quality declines when symmetry is removed.
  As a concrete application, we identify the smallest known counterexample to the Bernhart-Kainen dispersability conjecture, a $16$-vertex graph that enumeration found as raw data. For this graph, our agent found an explicit algebraic construction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种神经符号方法，利用通用大语言模型与计算机代数系统SageMath交互，自动从原始图数据中发现图的代数描述（如Cayley图或词典积构造）。在100个高对称二轨道图基准上全部成功，并识别出Bernhart-Kainen可散布性猜想的最小反例的显式代数构造。
AI.motivation: 现有的图搜索方法（如SAT求解器和专用生成器）只能返回原始数据（邻接矩阵或字符串编码），虽然能证明图的存在性，但无法揭示图的结构性质。作者希望从原始数据出发，自动发现图的简短代数描述，以获取对图结构的深层理解。
AI.method: 采用神经符号方法：构建一个基于通用大语言模型的智能体，无需微调或针对目标的训练。该模型推理与调用计算机代数系统SageMath交替进行：分析目标图、提出并测试候选构造、修订方案直至输出与目标匹配。通过模型上下文协议（MCP）服务器实现智能体与SageMath的通信，匹配验证由精确同构测试完成，依赖符号计算而非模型输出。
AI.result: 在100个高对称二轨道图（最多25个顶点）的预先固定基准上，智能体为所有图找到了经过验证的代数构造。模板枚举基线仅达到约20%，目录查找无法识别任何图。但在去除对称性后构造质量下降。作为具体应用，找到了Bernhart-Kainen可散布性猜想最小反例（16顶点图）的显式代数构造。
AI.conclusion: 神经符号方法能够从原始图数据中自动发现可验证的代数描述，在高度对称图上表现优异，远超传统模板枚举和目录查找方法。该方法为图的构造性理解提供了新途径，但其局限性在于对低对称性图的构造能力会显著下降。

title: Out-of-Distribution Federated Distillation with Domain-Aware Proxy
summary: Federated Learning is a distributed machine learning paradigm that trains a global model by aggregating local clients without sharing private data of each client. Federated Distillation (FD) builds upon this paradigm by leveraging knowledge distillation to exchange soft predictions on proxy data instead of model parameters, enabling more efficient communication and supporting heterogeneous model collaboration. However, FD models trained on In-Distribution data are hardly adapted to Out-of-Distribution (OOD) scenarios. In this paper, we propose a domain-aware proxy selection framework to better adopt proxy data for OOD problems. The experimental results show that the proposed models effectively address the challenges of distribution shifts under OOD with and without proxy data by achieving average 82.9\% and 80.6\% over existing works on standard benchmarks. The codes and data are released in https://anonymous.4open.science/r/DPS-FD-8596.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种域感知代理数据选择框架（DPS-FD），用于解决联邦蒸馏（FD）模型在分布外（OOD）场景下性能退化的问题，通过改进代理数据的选取来提升模型在分布偏移条件下的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 联邦蒸馏（FD）作为一种基于知识蒸馏的联邦学习范式，虽然比传统联邦学习更高效且支持异构模型协作，但现有FD模型在分布内（In-Distribution）数据上训练后，难以适应分布外（OOD）场景。代理数据的选择对OOD鲁棒性有重要影响，而现有方法缺乏对这一问题的系统性考虑。
AI.method: 提出一个域感知的代理数据选择框架（Domain-Aware Proxy Selection Framework），在联邦蒸馏过程中通过感知域信息来选择更合适的代理数据，从而增强模型对分布偏移的适应能力。
AI.result: 在标准基准测试上，该方法在有代理数据和无可代理数据的OOD场景下分别取得了82.9%和80.6%的平均性能，优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 实验验证了所提出的域感知代理选择框架能有效应对OOD分布偏移的挑战，代码和数据已开源供进一步研究。

title: Constraining ontology mappings using metaphysical choices
summary: In this paper we discuss the foundations behind a novel methodology for the validation of semantic mappings between different data sources based upon different foundation ontologies, where the methodology builds a framework based upon the metaphysical commitments of the ontologies. We provide as example the test case of mappings between IES and BFO, and we especially focused on providing cardinality constraints on the mappings between the two ontologies. In order to demonstrate the applicability of our method, we showcased how these principles can be operationalized through SPARQL queries validating the results of a mapping pipeline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于本体论形而上学承诺的新方法，用于验证基于不同基础本体的数据源之间的语义映射，并以IES与BFO之间的映射为测试案例，重点提供基数约束，并通过SPARQL查询验证映射管道的结果。
AI.motivation: 不同数据源基于不同的基础本体，这使得它们之间的语义映射验证具有挑战性。现有方法缺乏基于本体论形而上学承诺的系统性验证框架，需要一个方法论来确保映射的有效性和一致性。
AI.method: 构建一个基于本体形而上学承诺的验证框架，在IES和BFO两个本体之间的映射上应用该方法，特别关注映射的基数约束。通过SPARQL查询将这些原则操作化，以验证映射管道的输出结果。
AI.result: 以IES和BFO之间的映射为测试用例，展示了所提出的方法论如何在实际中应用，并通过SPARQL查询证明了该方法的可操作性，能够有效验证映射管道的结果。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为跨不同基础本体的语义映射验证提供了基于形而上学承诺的系统性方法论基础，并通过具体案例和SPARQL实现证明了其实用性和可操作性。

title: Task-to-Model Optimization for Enterprise LLM Coding Assistants: A Data-Driven Framework for Cost-Optimal Routing
summary: Enterprise AI coding assistants incur substantial inference spend, and naive token-cost minimization often fails to reduce end-to-end cost once retries, escalations, and developer wait time are included. We present Task-to-Model Optimization (T2MO), a data-driven methodology for optimizing model selection in production coding workflows. We treat each developer session as a task that can be discovered, classified, graded for difficulty, benchmarked in a production-like harness, and routed to the cheapest model able to complete it within quality and latency constraints. The framework is a nine-stage pipeline spanning telemetry instrumentation, taxonomy discovery, difficulty grading, benchmark construction, candidate evaluation, optimal mix derivation, forecasting and version planning, staged routing deployment, and continuous governance. Unlike token-centric routing rules, our objective is cost per completed task, with failure escalation priced in explicitly. We show that this expected-completion-cost objective weakly dominates token-cost minimization under escalation, and we derive the routing boundary, the minimum pass rate a cheaper model must reach on a given cell to be worth deploying. Decisions are organized as a two-level hierarchy of task category difficulty tier, and per-cell displacement opportunities are aggregated into a traffic-weighted savings waterfall that ranks replacement candidates by realized dollar impact. The framework supports developer guidance, spend forecasting, and a staged transition from static policies to shadow-mode classifiers, verified cascades, and ultimately an intelligent router. We describe the methodology, optimization objective, evaluation protocol, and governance loop in a form suitable for production deployment and future empirical study.

AI.tldr: 提出Task-to-Model Optimization (T2MO)，一个数据驱动的模型选择优化方法，将开发会话视为可分类、分级、评测并路由的任务，以"每完成任务的期望成本"为目标进行模型路由，取代传统基于token的单纯成本最小化。
AI.motivation: 企业级AI编程助手产生大量推理成本，而简单的token成本最小化往往会失败——因为未考虑重试、升级（escalation）和开发者等待时间等端到端的隐性成本。现有的路由规则过于token中心化，无法真正降低端到端的完成成本。
AI.method: T2MO是一条九阶段流水线：遥测数据采集、任务分类法发现、难度分级、基准构建、候选模型评估、最优模型组合推导、成本预测与版本规划、分阶段路由部署、持续治理。核心优化目标为"每完成任务的期望成本"，显式纳入失败升级代价，推导路由边界和低成本模型的最小通过率阈值。决策采用任务类别-难度层级两级层次结构，通过交通加权节省瀑布图聚合单元级替换机会并按实际美元影响排序。
AI.result: 理论上证明期望完成成本目标在存在升级场景下弱支配（weakly dominates）token成本最小化；推导出路由决策边界及低成本模型在某单元中值得部署所需达到的最小通过率。支持开发者指导、成本预测，以及从静态策略到影子模式分类器、验证级联、最终智能路由器的分阶段演进。
AI.conclusion: T2MO提供了一个适合生产部署的方法论框架，将模型选择从token成本视角转向任务完成成本视角，为后续实证研究奠定基础。作者将其定位为生产就绪的方法论与评估协议，而非实证结果报告。

title: Improving Constraint Models with LLM Agents
summary: The runtime of Constraint Programming (CP) solvers is highly sensitive to modeling choices, such as symmetry breaking, implied constraints, global constraints, constraint reformulation, and variable representation. Improving these constraint models has traditionally required human expertise, and existing automated reformulation systems are restricted to a predefined library of hand-crafted transformation rules. We introduce an agentic framework that instead reformulates a constraint model from an open-ended space and establishes correctness empirically rather than by construction: a Large Language Model (LLM) agent, given a model and three training instances, proposes alternative formulations, validates each by injecting its solution back into the original model, and diagnoses and repairs failures, returning the best variant it finds in a median of about fifteen minutes. The models are expressed in the CPMpy modeling library, and each proposed model is evaluated on three larger test instances. Across nine combinatorial optimization problems, the generated models outperform the originals on 21 of 27 test instances, and on some problems solve more than two orders of magnitude faster. A comparison against non-agentic baselines that reuse the same validation and selection tools indicates that the gains stem from the agent's iterative diagnosis and repair, not merely from sampling several candidates. These results demonstrate that autonomous agentic methods can support the improvement of constraint models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体框架，用于自动重构约束编程（CP）模型。该智能体在给定模型和三个训练实例后，能够从开放空间中提出替代方案，通过注入回原始模型进行验证，并迭代诊断和修复失败，最终在约15分钟内返回最佳变体。在9个组合优化问题上，生成的模型在27个测试实例中的21个上优于原始模型，部分问题加速超过两个数量级。
AI.motivation: 约束编程求解器的运行时高度依赖于建模选择（如对称性破除、隐含约束、全局约束等），但改进约束模型传统上依赖于人类专家，现有的自动重构系统局限于预定义的手工转换规则库，缺乏开放性和灵活性。
AI.method: 提出一个智能体框架：LLM智能体接收模型和三个训练实例，提出替代模型方案；通过将方案的解注入原始模型来经验性地验证正确性（而非构造性证明）；诊断和修复失败；在三个较大的测试实例上评估每个方案；最终返回最佳变体。模型使用CPMpy建模库表达。
AI.result: 在9个组合优化问题上，生成的模型在27个测试实例中的21个优于原始模型；部分问题求解速度提升超过两个数量级。与非智能体基线（复用相同的验证和选择工具）的对比表明，性能提升源自智能体的迭代诊断和修复过程，而非简单采样多个候选方案。
AI.conclusion: 自主智能体方法可以有效支持约束模型的改进，以经验性验证替代构造性正确性证明，为约束编程社区的模型优化提供了新的自动化途径。

title: Can Graph Learning Learn Circuits?
summary: Circuit localization is a mechanistic interpretability task whose goal is to identify a sparse subgraph of a transformer's computation graph sufficient to reproduce a particular behavior. Most established methods localize circuits independently for each model--task pair. We instead frame circuit localization as a graph machine learning problem in which the edges of a computation graph represent computational pathways, and graph neural networks (GNNs) model interactions among these pathways. We introduce Graph Circuit Learning (GCL), a supervised, amortized framework that trains a GNN across multiple model--task pairs and applies it to unseen cases. To provide sufficient data, we augment the InterpBench benchmark with additional cases derived from the TracrBench programs. Of the 14 evaluated GCL configurations, the highest scored a median edge AUROC of $0.902$ (interquartile interval $[0.861, 0.942]$) on the 16 original held-out InterpBench cases. This is close to the published InterpBench median of $0.910$ for EAP-IG while remaining below ACDC's $0.959$. Removing all message-passing edges reduces the median to $0.825$. We also adapt PGExplainer, a GNN explainability method, to circuit localization, obtaining a median edge AUROC of $0.858$ on the same cases. These preliminary results suggest that graph machine learning offers a natural and potentially powerful perspective on circuit localization, and we hope this perspective encourages closer exchange between the two communities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出图电路学习（GCL）框架，将电路定位视为图机器学习问题，用GNN在多个模型-任务对上训练，并对未见案例进行摊销式的电路定位。在InterpBench基准上达到0.902的中位边AUROC，接近EAP-IG的0.910但低于ACDC的0.959。
AI.motivation: 传统电路定位方法通常针对每个模型-任务对独立进行，缺乏跨任务泛化能力，成本高且效率低。作者希望利用图学习来建模计算图中边的交互，实现可摊销的、可迁移的电路定位。
AI.method: 1) 将计算图的边视为计算通路，用GNN建模边之间的交互关系；2) 构建GCL监督式摊销框架，在多个（模型,任务）对上训练，应用于未见案例；3) 通过TracrBench程序扩展InterpBench数据集以提供充足训练数据；4) 评估14种GCL配置，并适配PGExplainer作为基线对比。
AI.result: 最优GCL配置在16个原始留出InterpBench案例上取得0.902的中位边AUROC（IQR [0.861, 0.942]），接近EAP-IG的0.910，低于ACDC的0.959；移除消息传递边后降至0.825；适配后的PGExplainer取得0.858。
AI.conclusion: 初步结果表明图机器学习为电路定位提供了自然且有潜力的视角，有望促进机制可解释性与图学习两个社区之间的交流合作。

title: TokenPrint: A Calibrated Token-Space Fingerprint for Language-Model Provenance
summary: Establishing the provenance of a language model---including its base checkpoint and possible overlap in training distributions---is a governance challenge that metadata alone cannot resolve. We introduce a training-free fingerprint based on the top-$k$ vocabulary projections of late hidden states elicited by 250 fixed knowledge probes, compared using Jaccard overlap over decoded token strings. We evaluate the method on 32 open-weight models from nine families (0.6B--32B) with documented relationships. (1)~A \emph{similarity ladder} broadly follows model relatedness: independently trained models on identical data score 0.48 raw (0.35 vocabulary-corrected), followed by shared-base fine-tunes (0.39/0.33), same-developer relatives (0.38/0.28), and models with no documented relationship (0.22/0.17). This identical-data signal persists across three organizations, two tokenizer families, and two architecture classes, and emerges within the first 1\% of training before measurable task competence, suggesting a contribution from shared training data beyond capability convergence. (2)~As a nearest-neighbor \emph{lineage-retrieval} method, the fingerprint ranks the exact documented base among the top two candidates for all five R1 distillations (mean rank 1.8, MRR 0.60), including a math-specialized base not identifiable from coarse metadata. (3)~A \emph{depth ablation} shows that lineage group discrimination strengthens toward the output distribution, with AUC increasing from 0.72 at quarter depth to 0.90 at the output; using only the top 5 output tokens retains AUC 0.87. (4)~The fingerprint remains stable under quantization, with Jaccard similarity of 0.92 under int8 and 0.82--0.85 under int4, compared with a maximum cross-model similarity of 0.81 in the calibration pool. We release the probes, code, and fingerprints.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需训练的模型指纹方法，基于固定知识探针的late hidden states top-k词表投影，通过Jaccard重叠度比较解码token字符串，用于建立语言模型的来源溯源（provenance），在32个开源模型上验证了其能区分相同的训练数据来源、识别血缘关系、对量化和深度变化保持稳定性。
AI.motivation: 语言模型的来源溯源（包括基座检查点和训练分布重叠）是治理层面的关键挑战，仅靠元数据无法解决。现有方法无法有效回答"模型是否基于同一基座微调"或"训练数据是否重叠"等溯源问题，因此需要一种不依赖元数据的、稳健的指纹方法来建立模型间的血缘关系。
AI.method: 提出训练免费的指纹方法：用250个固定知识探针提取晚期隐藏状态，取top-k词表投影，对解码后的token字符串计算Jaccard重叠度作为模型间相似度指标。在32个开源模型（9个家族，0.6B-32B）上评估，并通过相似度阶梯、最近邻血缘检索、深度消融和量化稳定性四个方面验证。
AI.result: (1) 相似度阶梯遵循模型血缘关系：相同训练数据的独立训练模型得0.48（词表校正后0.35），共享基座的微调模型0.39/0.33，同开发者亲属0.38/0.28，无记录关系模型仅0.22/0.17；该信号跨3个组织、2类分词器、2类架构一致出现，并在训练前1%即出现。(2) 作为最近邻血缘检索，5个R1蒸馏模型的平均排位1.8，MRR 0.60，能识别粗粒度元数据无法识别的数学专用基座。(3) 深度消融显示血缘判别力随深度增强，AUC从四分之一深度0.72升至输出层0.90，仅用top-5输出token仍达0.87。(4) 量化下保持稳定：int8下Jaccard相似度0.92，int4下0.82-0.85，而校准池最大跨模型相似度为0.81。
AI.conclusion: 基于固定知识探针的top-k词表投影指纹是一种有效、训练免费、稳定且可解释的模型溯源方法，能够回答元数据无法解决的血缘关系问题。实验结果支持共享训练数据信号来源于数据本身而非能力收敛，且方法在量化等实际场景下保持鲁棒性。作者发布了探针、代码和指纹资源。

title: When Skills Meet Safety: Benchmarking and Characterizing the Adaptive Jailbreak Robustness of Skill-Merged LLMs
summary: Model merging has become the default way to give an aligned language model new skills without retraining: a practitioner folds task vectors from math, code, or domain specialists into a safety-aligned base using task arithmetic, TIES, or DARE. This convenience is known to carry a safety cost, but almost all of that evidence rests on static refusal tests: fixed harmful prompts scored for compliance. We argue this is misleading. Because safety alignment is "shallow," concentrated in the first few generated tokens, a merged model's static refusal can stay clean while a real adaptive attack still breaks it. We introduce SkillSafe-Bench, a controlled benchmark that scores skill-merged models on static refusal, adaptive jailbreak robustness, and capability retention under a conservative two-judge AND rule. Across six open-weight bases (five families, two scales), static safety does not predict robustness to attack: under a semantic template attack, safe-looking merges on the fragile bases (both Qwen scales and Gemma) are jailbroken 60-76% of the time while others (Llama, Phi-4) stay robust. We further show the static effect of merging is base-conditional, characterize same-recipe abliteration-style safety erosion through a data-free geometric signal (the overlap of a task vector with a safety subspace), and outline SubSafe-Merge, which projects this overlap away to remove that erosion at held capability. Adaptive evaluation is not optional for merged LLMs: the models that most need it look safe under static screening.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SkillSafe-Bench基准，通过静态拒绝测试、自适应越狱鲁棒性和能力保留三个维度评估技能合并模型的安全性，发现静态安全测试无法预测模型对自适应攻击的鲁棒性，并进一步提出SubSafe-Merge方法通过投影消除安全侵蚀。
AI.motivation: 模型合并已成为向对齐模型注入新技能的主流方式，但现有安全评估几乎全部依赖静态拒绝测试（固定有害提示的服从度评分）。作者认为这种评估具有误导性，因为安全对齐是"浅层"的，集中在模型生成的前几个token中，静态拒绝测试表现正常的模型仍可能被自适应攻击攻破。
AI.method: 作者构建了SkillSafe-Bench受控基准，采用保守的双裁判AND规则，从静态拒绝、自适应越狱鲁棒性和能力保留三个维度评估技能合并模型。在六个开源基础模型（五个家族、两个规模）上进行实验，并引入数据无关的几何信号——任务向量与安全子空间的重叠度——来表征安全的静态侵蚀。最后提出SubSafe-Merge方法，通过投影将这一重叠度移除。
AI.result: 实验表明：在语义模板攻击下，脆弱基础模型（Qwen两个规模和Gemma）上看似安全的合并模型被越狱的成功率达60-76%，而Llama和Phi-4保持鲁棒。静态安全无法预测对攻击的鲁棒性，合并的静态效果具有基础模型条件性。
AI.conclusion: 对于合并LLM，自适应评估不是可选项：最需要评估的模型在静态筛选下看起来是安全的。模型合并的安全评估必须超越静态拒绝测试，采用自适应攻击测试，并通过几何信号和投影方法（如SubSafe-Merge）来理解和缓解安全侵蚀。

title: Long SKILL Compliance as Logical Reasoning: Closure-Grounded Detection with Scaling-Guided On-Policy Distillation
summary: The increasing complexity of enterprise business scenarios has promoted the widespread adoption of long SKILL documents in agent systems, posing new challenges for compliance detection: large models incur substantial inference costs, while small models may fail to maintain detection accuracy. To address this gap, we propose SkillCDG, a graph-based framework for long SKILL compliance detection. SkillCDG represents complex business policies as a two-layer constraint dependency graph, where the upper layer indexes SKILL descriptions for scenario routing and the lower layer captures dependencies among atomic constraints within each SKILL. During inference, two-level retrieval followed by dependency closure supports compliance judgment and source traceability. We comprehensively evaluate the framework on three enterprise datasets and two controlled public benchmark variants. Experimental results demonstrate that SkillCDG outperforms baseline methods by up to 12.8 percentage points in detection F1 score, while reducing token consumption by a maximum 64.3\%. Moreover, we further investigate the inherent relationships among policy-graph complexity, model scale, and detection performance. Comparative experiments conducted on four checkpoints from a single model family validate a concise and effective scaling trend: end-to-end detection correctness exhibits a complexity-differentiated scaling pattern, and the complexity metric derived from the constraint dependency graph can effectively quantify instance difficulty and the performance improvement potential of models. Leveraging this insightful scaling trend, we conduct adaptive training sample selection and adopt on-policy distillation to efficiently enhance the compliance detection capability of small-scale models.

AI.tldr: 提出SkillCDG框架，将长SKILL文档的合规检测建模为两层约束依赖图，通过两级检索和依赖闭包实现低推理成本、高精度的合规检测，并在三个企业数据集和两个公开基准上验证其优于基线最多12.8个百分点F1、节省最多64.3%的token消耗，同时探索了图复杂度、模型规模与检测性能之间的缩放规律，并据此进行自适应训练样本选择和on-policy蒸馏以提升小模型能力。
AI.motivation: 企业业务场景日益复杂导致长SKILL文档在智能体系统中广泛使用，现有合规检测面临两难：大模型推理成本高，小模型检测精度不足。需要一种既能保持准确率又能控制成本的检测方案。
AI.method: 提出SkillCDG框架：将复杂业务策略构建为两层约束依赖图（上层索引SKILL描述用于场景路由，下层捕捉每个SKILL内原子约束间的依赖关系）；推理时通过两级检索加依赖闭包实现合规判断与来源追溯；并基于图复杂度指标进行自适应训练样本选择和on-policy蒸馏来增强小模型检测能力。
AI.result: 在三个企业数据集和两个受控公开基准变体上，SkillCDG相比基线在检测F1分数上最高提升12.8个百分点，token消耗最多减少64.3%；四个同一模型家族checkpoint的对比实验验证了复杂度差异化缩放的规律，复杂度指标可有效量化实例难度和模型潜在提升空间。
AI.conclusion: SkillCDG通过图建模实现了长SKILL合规检测中精度与效率的平衡，且揭示了策略图复杂度与模型规模间的缩放规律，可指导自适应数据选择和知识蒸馏，以高效增强小规模模型的合规检测能力。

title: Neural Message Passing on Structural Interaction Graphs for Fully-Inductive Graph Neural Networks
comment: 7 pages, 1 figure in the main body. 12 pages, 5 figures in appendix. Submitted to AAAI 2027 (main track) and currently under review
summary: A central obstacle in building graph foundation models is the input heterogeneity in terms of feature space dimensionality, semantics, and structure. Such heterogeneity limits the capability of graph neural networks to generalize to new graphs with unseen feature spaces. We address the transferability challenge with SIGIL, a framework that maps any attributed graph to a unified representation space of fixed dimension. Given a graph, SIGIL lifts it to a structural interaction graph, where nodes are the input feature dimensions and weighted, typed edges encode feature alignment across multiple orders of the graph's connectivity. A relational message-passing network embeds each feature dimension into a shared space, transforming the original node features, of arbitrary dimensionality, into representations transferable to any downstream graph. By construction, SIGIL is equivariant to permutations of nodes, feature dimensions, and labels. Additionally, when the input features are one-hot indicators of discrete relations, SIGIL recovers and strictly generalizes existing foundation models for knowledge graph reasoning. A single SIGIL model, pretrained on one graph, delivers strong fully-inductive link prediction. Also, SIGIL can be used to implement existing knowledge graph foundation models. As such, SIGIL unifies several existing regimes in graph foundation model design under a single framework

AI.tldr: SIGIL是一个统一的图基础模型框架，通过将任意属性图映射到固定维度的统一表示空间，解决了图基础模型中输入异构性（特征空间维度、语义和结构）带来的迁移挑战，实现对不可见图的归纳式链接预测，并统一了现有图基础模型设计范式。
AI.motivation: 图基础模型构建的核心障碍在于输入异构性：不同图的特征空间在维度、语义和结构上差异巨大，导致图神经网络难以泛化到具有不可见特征空间的新图上。现有方法无法有效解决这种跨图迁移问题。
AI.method: SIGIL将任意属性图提升为结构交互图（structural interaction graph），其中节点是输入特征维度，加权、带类型的边编码了多阶图连通性上的特征对齐关系。随后使用关系消息传递网络将每个特征维度嵌入到共享空间中，从而将任意维度的原始节点特征转换为可迁移到任何下游图的表示。SIGIL对节点、特征维度和标签的排列具有等变性。当输入特征为离散关系的一热指示符时，SIGIL可以恢复并严格推广现有的知识图谱推理基础模型。
AI.result: 单个在单一图上预训练的SIGIL模型即可实现强归纳式链接预测性能。此外，SIGIL可用于实现现有的知识图谱基础模型，证明其作为统一框架的能力。
AI.conclusion: SIGIL在单一框架下统一了图基础模型设计中的多种现有范式，解决了图基础模型的输入异构性迁移难题，为构建可跨图泛化的基础模型提供了一致且通用的解决方案。

title: A Unified Framework for Dynamic Reward Shaping in Reinforcement Learning
summary: Sparse, delayed, and weakly informative rewards remain central obstacles to efficient reinforcement learning. Reward shaping addresses these limitations by supplementing the task reward with an auxiliary signal that can accelerate learning while, in the classical setting, the original objective remains the evaluation criterion. Established theory guarantees safety for fixed shaping signals: potential-based reward shaping preserves optimal policies when the auxiliary term is the discounted difference of a time-invariant potential. In contemporary reinforcement learning systems, however, both the learner and the information available for guidance evolve during training: value estimates improve, novelty diminishes, feedback shifts, and predictive models are refined. Adaptive reward mechanisms occur across exploration, Bayesian inference, human-in-the-loop learning, automated reward design, and foundation-model-based approaches. This study introduces a unified analytical framework for comparing dynamic reward shaping and neighbouring adaptive reward mechanisms. The proposed framework distinguishes parametric revision from state-dependent variation, separates additive shaping from reward replacement and reward-adjacent guidance, and organises existing methods along temporal, informational, and theoretical dimensions. Using this framework, twelve method families are comparatively analysed. The framework further highlights the conditions under which optimality guarantees survive contemporary deep reinforcement learning pipelines, replay buffers, bootstrapped critics, and reward normalisation, while exposing the unresolved relationship between adaptation rate and learner stability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个统一的分析框架，用于比较动态奖励塑形及其相邻的自适应奖励机制，将十二个方法家族按时间、信息和理论维度进行组织，并探讨了在当代深度强化学习流水线中最优性保证的存续条件。
AI.motivation: 奖励塑形是缓解稀疏、延迟和弱信息奖励障碍的核心手段，但传统理论仅保证固定整形信号的安全性（如基于势函数的奖励塑形）。当代强化学习系统中，学习者和指导信息在训练过程中持续演化（值估计改善、新奇度降低、反馈变化等），自适应奖励机制已广泛出现在探索、贝叶斯推断、人在回路、自动奖励设计和基于基础模型的方法中，但缺乏统一的分析框架来比较这些机制。
AI.method: 本文提出一个统一分析框架：区分参数修正与状态依赖变化，分离加法塑形与奖励替换及奖励邻近指导，并沿时间、信息和理论三个维度组织现有方法。在该框架下对十二个方法家族进行比较分析。
AI.result: 框架揭示了在当代深度强化学习流水线（回放缓冲区、自举评论家、奖励归一化）中最优性保证得以存续的条件，同时暴露了适应速率与学习者稳定性之间尚未解决的关系。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为动态奖励塑形和相关自适应奖励机制提供了系统化的理论视角，指出了现有最优性保证在深度强化学习实践中的适用边界，并识别了适应速率与稳定性这一关键开放问题。

title: Robust Reputation-Driven Crowdsourced Federated Learning
comment: Accepted for presentation at the HotDiSec Workshop, co-located with ESORICS'26
summary: Crowdsourced Federated Learning (CrowdFL) extends traditional federated learning by enabling open and heterogeneous participation through a crowdsourcing paradigm. In this setting, reputation-driven incentive mechanisms are commonly employed to guide worker selection and enhance trustworthiness. While such approaches improve participant reliability, existing frameworks largely overlook the quantification of their robustness against stealthy adversaries, particularly those capable of evading standard detection mechanisms. To fill this gap, this paper proposes R2CFL, a robust reputation-driven CrowdFL framework. R2CFL introduces a robust reputation model coupled with a nearest neighbor mixing (R2-NNM) defense mechanism that links reputation evolution with the filtering of updates during aggregation. The proposed mechanism prevents stealthy attackers from gradually accumulating trust and influencing future tasks. Experimental results demonstrate that R2-NNM matches or surpasses state-of-the-art Byzantine-robust and backdoor defense mechanisms against adaptive attackers. Furthermore, when integrated with existing detect-and-filter defenses, the proposed reputation model faithfully captures the statistical robustness of the underlying defense by producing reputation scores that closely reflect its true positive and false positive characteristics.

AI.tldr: 提出R2CFL框架，通过鲁棒声誉模型与最近邻混合（R2-NNM）防御机制相结合，解决众包联邦学习（CrowdFL）中声誉驱动激励机制对隐蔽对抗攻击者鲁棒性不足的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有众包联邦学习中的声誉驱动激励机制虽然能提升参与者可靠性，但缺乏对隐蔽对抗攻击者（尤其是能规避标准检测机制的对手）鲁棒性的量化评估，存在信任积累与投毒攻击的漏洞。
AI.method: R2CFL框架包括两部分：(1) 鲁棒声誉模型，用于可靠地追踪参与者可信度；(2) 最近邻混合（R2-NNM）防御机制，将声誉演化与聚合阶段的更新过滤相耦合，防止隐蔽攻击者逐步积累信任并影响后续任务。
AI.result: 实验表明R2-NNM在对抗自适应攻击者时匹配或超越现有最先进的拜占庭鲁棒与后门防御机制；当与现有的检测-过滤防御集成时，所提出的声誉模型能通过产生与其真实阳性率和假阳性率密切对应的声誉分数，忠实捕获底层防御的统计鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: R2CFL有效填补了众包联邦学习中声誉驱动机制对隐蔽攻击鲁棒性研究的空白，通过将声誉演化与防御机制耦合，实现了对自适应隐蔽攻击者的鲁棒防护，同时声誉模型还能作为底层防御效力的忠实统计指示器。

title: When Is a Steerable Concept Representation Real? Measurement Confounds in a Cross-Family Audit of Neuroscience Parallels in LLMs
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly reported to exhibit human-like neural and cognitive signatures, including concept cells, mental number lines, and cognitive maps. These claims often rely on linear probing and activation steering applied to a single model, yet both methods are highly sensitive to measurement choices. A reported parallel may therefore reflect the model, the measurement procedure, or both. We audit four representative neuroscience-inspired paradigms across 17 models from five families, spanning $0.6$B to $72$B parameters. Our main experiment examines the causal steerability of concept directions. With raw activation units and a fixed layer and coefficient, steerability appears to increase with model scale, resembling an emergent capability. However, this pattern is produced by an uncalibrated pipeline rather than by a claim established in the steering literature. The trend depends jointly on raw units, the readout metric, and the operating point; correcting any one of these removes it. With residual-norm-comparable interventions and held-out operating-point selection, concept steering remains significant at every scale, but shows no significant trend across the Qwen3 series, although the confidence interval does not rule out a moderate positive slope. The remaining results are mixed. A linear geographic world map is consistently decodable in every tested checkpoint up to $72$B. Number magnitude is strongly encoded, but whether individual neurons appear bell-shaped or monotonic depends on the selection criterion. Language-specific structure is localizable, but the direction of the cross-lingual asymmetry reverses under a different attribution method. These results suggest that the main constraint on AI neuroscience is not a lack of phenomena, but a lack of comparable measurements and adequate controls. We release the protocol, stimuli, and code.

AI.tldr: 本文对4种神经科学启发的LLM范式（概念细胞、心理数字线、认知地图等）进行了系统性审计，覆盖5个家族17个模型（0.6B-72B参数）。核心发现：概念方向的因果可引导性看似随模型规模涌现，但该趋势源于未校准的测量流程（原始激活单位、固定层和系数）。修正测量方法后，概念引导在各级别都显著但无规模趋势；世界地图可解码性一致；数字编码存在但神经元形态取决于选择标准；跨语言不对称方向在前归因方法下反转。结论：AI神经科学的主要瓶颈不是缺乏现象，而是缺乏可比测量与充分对照。
AI.motivation: 近年来大量研究声称LLM表现出类人神经与认知特征，但这些主张多依赖线性探针和激活引导等方法，且往往只对单一模型进行测试。这些方法对测量选择高度敏感，"发现的平行"可能反映模型本身、测量过程或两者兼有。因此需要跨模型、跨规模、跨测量方法的多维审计，以区分真实的涌现能力与测量伪影。
AI.method: 对17个模型（5个家族，0.6B-72B参数）实施4种神经科学启发范式的系统审计。核心实验考察概念方向的因果可引导性：先在原始激活单位+固定层与系数下测量（发现随规模增长的趋势），再通过残差范数可比干预和held-out操作点选择进行修正。同时测试线性地理世界地图的可解码性、数字幅度的神经编码（对比bell-shaped vs monotonic选择标准）以及语言特异性结构的前归因方法敏感性。
AI.result: 1) 概念引导的"涌现"趋势是由未校准管线产生的伪影，纠正原始单位、读取指标或操作点中任一项即消除趋势；修正后引导在各规模均显著但Qwen3系列内无显著趋势（置信区间不排除中等正斜率）。2) 线性世界地图在所有检查节点（至72B）均可一致解码。3) 数字幅度强编码，但单个神经元形态（bell-shaped vs monotonic）取决于选择标准。4) 语言特异性结构可定位，但跨语言不对称方向在前归因方法下反转。
AI.conclusion: AI神经科学领域面临的核心制约不是现象本身的匮乏，而是缺乏跨模型可比的测量协议和充分的对照设置。研究呼吁将测量校准和操作点选择作为标准实践，并提供完整协议、刺激和代码以促进可复现的比较研究。

title: Agentic AI-driven Immersive Simulation: A Knowledge-Aware Virtual Training Platform forHigh Dose Rate (HDR) Brachytherapy
summary: The convergence of the Metaverse and Large Language Model (LLM)-based AI agent is catalyzing a shift toward autonomous, immersive, and personalized pedagogical frameworks in medical education. This paper presents a novel agentic AI-driven immersive simulation specifically designed for High Dose Rate (HDR) vaginal cylinder (VC) brachytherapy in cancer care. By integrating Virtual Reality (VR) and mobile computing, the system establishes a high-fidelity, risk-free environment that allows trainees to master complex procedural skills without the facility or safety constraints posed by physical anatomy or live radioactive sources. A core contribution of this work is the seamless integration of a knowledge-aware assistant leveraging Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to ground agent interactions in authoritative clinical guidelines. This architecture also enables an interactive agent to provide natural language interfaces and hands-free, real-time guidance during intricate medical maneuvers. We validate the proposed system through a prototype deployment comprising a Meta Quest 3 interface linked to a local GPU-accelerated AI backend, demonstrating a feasible architecture for HDR brachytherapy simulation. Experimental results indicate that the system maintains suitable end-to-end latency and high context precision, answer completeness, and relevance in the RAG-enhanced pedagogical support.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种由智能体驱动的AI沉浸式模拟系统，专用于癌症治疗中的高剂量率（HDR）阴道圆柱体（VC）近距离放疗培训。系统集成VR和移动计算构建高保真无风险训练环境，并通过基于检索增强生成（RAG）的知识感知助手提供自然语言交互和实时指导。原型部署基于Meta Quest 3和本地GPU加速AI后端，实验结果验证了系统在端到端延迟、上下文精度、答案完整性和相关性方面的可行性。
AI.motivation: 医疗教育中HDR近距离放疗等复杂程序性技能的培训受制于物理解剖设施和活体放射源的安全约束，传统培训模式存在高风险、高成本、资源受限等问题。同时，元宇宙与LLM驱动的AI智能体的融合为构建自主、沉浸式、个性化的医学教育框架提供了新契机，但如何将二者有效整合到具象的放疗模拟中仍是研究空白。
AI.method: 本文提出一个agentic AI驱动的沉浸式模拟系统架构：(1) 集成VR（Meta Quest 3）与移动计算，构建高保真无风险的HDR VC近距离放疗训练环境；(2) 设计基于检索增强生成（RAG）的知识感知助手，将智能体交互锚定在权威临床指南上，确保回答的临床准确性；(3) 实现自然语言接口与免手持实时指导机制，支持复杂医学操作中的便捷交互；(4) 采用本地GPU加速AI后端支撑系统运行，并通过原型部署验证整体架构的可行性。
AI.result: 原型系统由Meta Quest 3头显与本地GPU加速AI后端联动构成。实验结果显示：系统端到端延迟保持在适宜范围内，RAG增强的教学支持在上下文精度、答案完整性和相关性方面均达到较高水准，证明该架构在HDR近距离放疗模拟中具备实际可行性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究验证了将LLM智能体、RAG与VR/MR技术融合用于医学程序性技能培训的可行路径，为远程、个体化、循证驱动的医学模拟教育提供了新的架构范本，也为后续扩展到其他复杂放疗或外科手术培训场景奠定了基础。

title: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning via Agent-Specific Preference
comment: This article has been accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Automation Science and Engineering. This is the author's version, which has not been fully edited, and the content may change prior to final publication. \c{opyright} 2026 IEEE. All rights reserved, including rights for text and data mining and training of artificial intelligence and similar technologies
summary: Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) is a powerful framework for solving complex collaborative tasks, but it relies heavily on well-defined global reward functions. Designing such rewards is challenging, especially in systems with heterogeneous agents, where a single scalar objective may fail to capture diverse behaviors. In this paper, we introduce Multi-AGent Preference-Integrated lEarning (MAGPIE), which addresses these challenges through agent-specific preference modeling. Each agent is evaluated by a dedicated expert through preference signals, eliminating the need for global evaluation. We theoretically prove that optimizing these decentralized preferences converges to a Nash equilibrium policy. To integrate local preferences into a coherent global objective, we construct agent-specific reward models from preference data and combine them via a monotonic aggregation mechanism. We further prove that optimizing this aggregate reward model is equivalent to training the Nash equilibrium policy. Extensive experiments on benchmark multi-agent tasks and a sequential production line task show that MAGPIE achieves performance comparable to reward-engineered baselines, demonstrating its potential to facilitate policy learning in scenarios where precise reward engineering is impractical.

AI.tldr: MAGPIE是一种通过agent特定的偏好建模来替代全局奖励函数设计的多智能体强化学习框架，利用专家偏好信号构建奖励模型，并通过单调聚合机制融合局部偏好，理论上证明可收敛到纳什均衡策略。
AI.motivation: 多智能体强化学习依赖定义良好的全局奖励函数，但在异构智能体系统中设计统一的全局奖励尤为困难，单一标量目标难以捕捉多样化的行为需求。
AI.method: 为每个智能体分配专属专家通过偏好信号进行评估（无需全局评估）；从偏好数据构建agent特定的奖励模型，并通过单调聚合机制将其组合为全局目标；理论证明优化分散偏好可收敛到纳什均衡策略，且优化聚合奖励模型等价于训练纳什均衡策略。
AI.result: 在基准多智能体任务和序贯生产线任务上的大量实验表明，MAGPIE达到了与经过奖励工程化的基线方法相当的性能。
AI.conclusion: MAGPIE展示了在精确奖励工程不可行场景下促进策略学习的潜力，为多智能体系统中的奖励设计提供了替代方案。

title: Matching Supervision to the Student's Learning Capacity: A Unified Framework for On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary:
On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) improves the reasoning abilities of LLMs by internalizing privileged context into model parameters through self-distillation.
  Two recent research lines promote vanilla OPSD by choosing which tokens to learn from and by controlling how much privileged information the teacher receives, respectively.
  However, we show that each line optimizes one variable while holding the other fixed, which leads to a suboptimal solution.
  We argue that the two variables are coupled through the student's learning capacity: the privileged information sets the per-token divergence the teacher prescribes, while token weighting selects which of these the student must absorb.
  We formalize the two lines of work into a unified optimization framework, which maximizes the aggregate teacher--student divergence, subject to a budget on the aggregate learning difficulty the student can absorb.
  Under this modelling, we propose Unified On-Policy Self-Distillation (USD), a lightweight online algorithm to solve the Lagrangian.
  USD reveals that a single dual variable governs both decisions: at one price for learning difficulty, it simultaneously sets the token-selection threshold and the direction of privileged-information adjustment, keeping supervision matched to the student's evolving capacity.
  Through extensive experiments, USD consistently demonstrates superior performance over OPSD and token- and PI-side baselines across various model scales on various reasoning benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/lauvlalala/USD.

AI.tldr: 本文提出统一在线策略自蒸馏框架（USD），通过拉格朗日优化同时求解token选择与特权信息控制两个耦合变量，发现单一对偶变量即可协调两者，显著提升LLM推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的两条OPSD研究路线分别优化token选择或特权信息（PI）控制，但各自固定另一个变量，导致次优解。作者认为这两个变量通过学生的学习能力耦合：特权信息决定教师指定的逐token散度，而token加权决定学生需吸收的散度，因此需要统一优化。
AI.method: 将两条研究方向形式化为统一的优化框架，目标是在学生可吸收的聚合学习难度预算约束下最大化聚合师生散度。提出USD（Unified On-Policy Self-Distillation）轻量在线算法求解该拉格朗日问题。该算法利用单一的拉格朗日对偶变量同时控制token选择阈值和特权信息调整方向，使监督信号与学生不断变化的学习能力相匹配。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，USD在各种模型规模和推理基准上的一致性能表现优于OPSD及token侧与PI侧基线方法。
AI.conclusion: token选择与特权信息控制并非独立变量，而是通过学生能力耦合；统一优化的USD以单一对偶变量同时治理两个决策维度，为在线策略自蒸馏提供了更优的解决方案。

title: Domain-Aware Pruning: Sparsity and Domain Generalization via Regularized Probabilistic Masking
summary: Domain generalization (DG) and neural network pruning are conventionally treated as distinct objectives, targeting out-of-distribution (OOD) robustness and model efficiency, respectively. In this work, we bridge this gap by introducing Domain-Aware Pruning (DAP), a framework that leverages network sparsity as a mechanism to implicitly enhance generalization to unseen domains. Diverging from standard binary mask optimization, DAP learns a continuous parameter retention probability $p \in [0, 1]$, framing network compression as a continuous probabilistic masking problem. By introducing a regularization objective that actively penalizes the retention of domain-sensitive weights during the mask training, DAP identifies a domain-invariant subnetwork. Empirical results across five DG benchmark datasets demonstrate that DAP achieves significant sparsity while consistently matching or exceeding the OOD performance of its dense counterparts. Crucially, DAP is an algorithm-agnostic framework that integrates seamlessly with existing DG pipelines without necessitating post-hoc fine-tuning. Beyond efficiency and generalization, we show that DAP natively provides increased robustness to adversarial perturbations and yields highly interpretable models, where the retained weights reliably encapsulate the most domain-invariant and task-critical representations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出领域感知剪枝（DAP）框架，首次将网络剪枝与域泛化（DG）目标统一起来。与传统的二元掩码优化不同，DAP学习连续的参数保留概率p∈[0,1]，将网络压缩建模为连续概率掩码问题，并通过正则化目标惩罚域敏感权重的保留，从而识别出域不变子网络。
AI.motivation: 域泛化（DG）和神经网络剪枝通常被视为两个独立的目标，分别关注分布外（OOD）鲁棒性和模型效率。现有工作未能利用网络稀疏性来隐式增强对未知域的泛化能力，这一空白促使作者构建两者之间的桥梁。
AI.method: DAP框架的核心创新在于：1) 用连续参数保留概率p∈[0,1]替代标准二元掩码优化，将网络压缩问题重构为连续概率掩码问题；2) 引入正则化目标，在掩码训练过程中主动惩罚域敏感权重的保留，从而识别域不变子网络；3) 该框架是算法无关的，可与现有DG流水线无缝集成，无需后处理微调。
AI.result: 在五个DG基准数据集上的实验结果表明，DAP在实现显著稀疏性的同时，其OOD性能持续匹配或超越稠密对应模型。此外，DAP还天然提供对对抗扰动的增强鲁棒性，并产生高度可解释的模型，保留的权重可靠地封装了最域不变且任务关键的表示。
AI.conclusion: DAP证明了网络稀疏性可以作为一种隐式机制来增强域泛化能力，在效率与鲁棒性之间取得了双赢。该框架不仅实现了高效压缩，还额外提供了对抗鲁棒性和模型可解释性，为DG与模型压缩领域的交叉研究开辟了新方向。

title: Large Multimodal Agents for Intelligent Transportation Systems: Architectures, Evidence, and Deployment Challenges
summary: Large multimodal agents (LMAs) are increasingly proposed for intelligent transportation systems (ITS), but existing studies often conflate multimodality, agency, empirical performance, and deployment readiness. This review provides an auditable evidence map of 42 primary study families released between January 2023 and 3 August 2026 within a corpus of 91 mapped sources. It distinguishes model-level, system-level, and hybrid multimodality and classifies each family by system architecture and action authority. Evidence is assessed independently through functional capability (C0-C3), validation setting (E0-E4), three evidence propositions (P1-P3), and eight methodological-concern domains (Q1-Q8). Transportation semantics (P1) are directly evaluated in 23 families and multidimensional integration (P3) in 24; 19 families directly evaluate both. Evidence reconciliation (P2) remains unresolved because no family demonstrates the complete provenance-challenge-handling-comparison-outcome chain. Fourteen families reach C3, but 13 remain at E2; only one reaches E3 and none reaches E4. Across ITS domains, LMAs are best supported for semantic interpretation, intent translation, evidence organisation, scenario authoring, explanation, and specialist-tool coordination. Numerical forecasting, optimisation, simulation fidelity, hard constraints, low-level control, safety fallback, and final authority should remain with independently verifiable specialist systems or accountable humans. The review therefore supports bounded orchestration rather than replacement and provides a matched comparative evaluation protocol and staged roadmap for accountable deployment. The living evidence repository is available at https://github.com/pangjunbiao/ITS-LMA-Review.

AI.tldr: 本文对2023年1月至2026年8月间发布的42个大型多模态智能体（LMA）主研究族进行了可审计的证据映射综述，系统区分了模型级、系统级和混合级多模态，并基于功能能力（C0-C3）、验证设置（E0-E4）、三条证据命题（P1-P3）及八个方法论关注域（Q1-Q8）独立评估了证据质量。核心发现是：LMA在语义解释、意图转换等上层任务上证据最充分，但数值预测、低层控制、安全回退等关键任务仍应由专家系统或人类主导，支持"有界编排"而非完全替代。该综述提供了一套匹配的比较评估协议和分阶段部署路线图。
AI.motivation: 现有大型多模态智能体在智能交通系统中的应用研究常混淆多模态、智能体属性、实证表现与部署就绪度四个不同概念，缺乏系统性的证据评估框架，导致研究结论难以审计、难以转化为实际部署决策。作者旨在通过构建可审计的证据地图，厘清LMA在ITS中的真实能力边界与证据强度。
AI.method: 作者在91个映射来源中系统筛选出42个主研究族（2023年1月至2026年8月），建立分类框架：按多模态类型（模型级/系统级/混合级）、系统架构和行动权限进行分类；再用独立维度评估证据，包括功能能力等级（C0-C3）、验证设置等级（E0-E4）、三条证据命题（P1运输语义、P2证据调和、P3多维集成）和八个方法论关注域（Q1-Q8）。最终构建匹配的比较评估协议和分阶段部署路线图。
AI.result: 23个研究族直接评估了运输语义（P1），24个评估了多维集成（P3），19个同时评估两者。证据调和（P2）在所有研究中均未解决，因为没有任何研究族展示完整的"来源-挑战处理-比较-结果"链条。14个研究族达到C3功能能力，但13个仍停留在E2验证等级，仅1个达到E3，0个达到E4。LMA在语义解释、意图转换、证据组织、场景编写、解释和专家工具协调方面证据最充分；而数值预测、优化、仿真保真度、硬约束、低层控制、安全回退及最终决策权应保留给可独立验证的专家系统或可问责的人类。
AI.conclusion: 大型多模态智能体在智能交通系统中应被定位为"有界编排者"（bounded orchestrator）而非专家系统的替代品。综述提供了审计证据地图、匹配比较评估协议和分阶段部署路线图，并发布了可实时更新的证据知识库，为ITS领域LMA的可问责部署提供了方法论与实证基础。

title: Trajectory Design and Budgeted Querying for Digital Twin Calibration
comment: Accepted at the CDEL 2026 workshop at ECCV 2026 (non-archival)
summary: Digital-twin calibration requires interaction data that is expensive to collect. We study two acquisition decisions: which trajectories to generate, and when to spend a limited budget on privileged parameter measurements. Our framework couples an excitation-oriented reinforcement learning controller, a recurrent parameter estimator with predictive uncertainty, and a budgeted query policy. In Pendulum, a Random Forest diagnostic recovers gravity only weakly from task-oriented trajectories and does not recover mass or length, while a GRU trained on excitation-oriented trajectories reaches a mean absolute error of 0.0066 with no queries. We then withdraw continuous oracle access partway through an episode, so that the twin must run on the estimator's output for the remainder. The estimator-plus-policy pipeline achieves a terminal error of 0.0092 under a three-query budget, against 0.2031 for an uncalibrated twin. In partially observable Waterworld, five controllers produce different observed error profiles across three hidden parameters, and an estimator trained on a five-controller mixture reaches online normalized errors of roughly 4-5%. These exploratory case studies are not controlled ablations, but they motivate treating trajectory design and query allocation as explicit design variables in data-scarce calibration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个数字孪生校准框架，将激励导向的强化学习控制器、带预测不确定性的循环参数估计器和预算受限的查询策略三者耦合，研究在数据稀缺条件下如何决策轨迹生成和参数测量时机，并通过Pendulum和Waterworld两个案例研究验证其可行性。
AI.motivation: 数字孪生校准需要昂贵的交互数据，但在现实中采集轨迹数据和特权参数测量（oracle access）的预算都极其有限。现有工作未将轨迹设计（采集哪些轨迹）和查询分配（何时花费有限预算获取参数真值）作为显式设计变量来系统研究，导致数据稀缺场景下的校准效果不佳。
AI.method: 提出一个三组件耦合框架：(1) 激励导向的强化学习控制器，生成对参数辨识信息量丰富的轨迹；(2) 具有预测不确定性的循环参数估计器（GRU），在无oracle时基于观测推断参数；(3) 预算受限的查询策略，决定在episode中何时消耗有限的参数测量预算。此外在Waterworld中训练多控制器混合数据，以覆盖不同隐藏参数的观测分布。
AI.result: 在Pendulum中，GRU在激励导向轨迹上训练后无需查询即达0.0066的MAE，而基于任务导向轨迹训练的Random Forest仅能弱恢复重力且无法恢复质量和长度。在撤回连续oracle、仅设三次查询预算的场景下，估计器加策略的pipeline终端误差为0.0092，远优于未校准孪生的0.2031。在部分可观测的Waterworld中，五个控制器产生不同的误差剖面，基于五控制器混合训练的估计器达到约4-5%的在线归一化误差。
AI.conclusion: 虽然这些探索性案例研究不是受控消融实验，但结果表明轨迹设计和查询分配在数据稀缺的数字孪生校准中应被视作显式设计变量而非默认选择，激励导向轨迹能显著提升参数可辨识性，而预算化查询策略能在有限测量预算下维持校准精度。

title: Quantization Degradation in Large Language Models: A Signal-Noise Perspective
summary: Post-training quantization reduces the deployment cost of large language models, yet how severely a quantized model degrades is not determined by bit-width alone. We systematically study weight-only post-training quantization across bit-widths, quantization methods, model scales and downstream tasks on multiple model families. We observe that such degradation varies substantially across these factors: 4-bit quantization usually preserves performance, 2-bit often causes broad degradation, and at 3-bit, degradation becomes apparent but varies markedly with task type, quantization method and model scale. To explain this variability, we use the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) to measure how strongly quantization perturbs full-precision representations. We trace degradation back to two linked processes: how quantization errors arise within individual modules, and how they accumulate across layers. First, a source SNR decomposition shows that newly introduced errors depend on three factors: the magnitude of the weight error, the strength of the task-specific signal, and how strongly the quantization error aligns with task-specific activations. Different factors affect these components in distinct ways. Second, a cross-layer propagation analysis shows that these errors can be attenuated, preserved, or amplified as they pass across layers, and that larger models benefit from weaker error amplification. Together, these results establish that quantization degradation is governed by how errors are introduced at the source and how they accumulate across the network.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了大型语言模型的仅权重后训练量化（weight-only PTQ），发现量化性能下降并非仅由位宽决定，而是受位宽、量化方法、模型规模和下游任务等多因素共同影响。作者提出用信噪比（SNR）量化量化扰动，并将性能下降追溯到两个环节：模块内量化误差的产生和跨层误差的累积传播。
AI.motivation: 虽然后训练量化能降低大语言模型的部署成本，但量化模型性能下降的程度不能仅由位宽决定。现有研究缺乏对量化降级影响因素的系统性理解，需要解释为什么不同因素下量化效果差异巨大，从而为量化方法的选择提供理论指导。
AI.method: 作者在多个模型家族上，跨位宽（2/3/4-bit）、量化方法、模型规模和下游任务进行系统实验。方法包括两部分：(1) 源SNR分解——将新引入的量化误差分解为权重误差幅度、任务特定信号强度、量化误差与任务特定激活的对齐程度三个因素；(2) 跨层传播分析——追踪误差在层间传播时被衰减、保留或放大的过程。通过SNR作为统一度量来连接量化扰动与性能下降。
AI.result: 研究发现：4-bit量化通常保持性能，2-bit常导致广泛下降，3-bit时性能下降明显但随任务类型、量化方法和模型规模高度变化。源SNR分解揭示了误差产生受权重误差幅度、信号强度和误差-激活对齐三个因素支配；跨层传播分析表明误差可在层间被衰减、保留或放大，且更大模型具有更弱的误差放大效应。
AI.conclusion: 量化性能下降由两个环节共同决定：误差在源头的产生方式（受权重误差、信号强度和对齐程度影响）以及误差在网络中的跨层累积方式（不同模型规模放大程度不同）。这一框架为理解量化行为、指导量化方法选择和模型设计提供了理论基础。

title: Janus: An Algorithm-Evaluator Co-Evolution Framework for LLM-Driven Discovery under Expensive Evaluation Budgets
summary: LLM-driven program discovery relies on rapid evaluator feedback, but many scientific and engineering tasks require high-fidelity simulations, hardware execution, or physical experiments, making each evaluation expensive. Cheap surrogate evaluators can reduce this cost, yet fixed surrogates are vulnerable to search-induced distribution shift and are difficult to fit reliably from sparse, search-biased labels. We introduce Janus, a framework that uses LLMs to co-evolve target programs and executable proxy evaluators. To address label scarcity, Janus leverages domain knowledge encoded in LLMs to generate task-specific evaluator programs and calibrates them using real outcomes. To mitigate distribution shift, Janus evolves evaluators alongside target programs, selects them using a promotion-aligned objective, and maintains region-conditioned portfolios with online credit updates. Because proxy predictions remain fallible, Janus uses them only to prioritize candidates and requires real validation before candidates can enter the target-program population or update the incumbent. Across five scientific and engineering design tasks, Janus achieves a larger area under the best-so-far improvement curve over the real-evaluation budget and higher final performance than a matched baseline that evolves only target programs. On average, Janus reaches 99/% of the baseline's final improvement with 59.1/% fewer real evaluations. Evolved proxy evaluators also rank promising candidates more accurately than their seed versions. Together, these results extend evaluator-guided LLM discovery from tasks with cheap, scalable feedback to scientific domains where trustworthy evaluation is scarce and expensive.

AI.tldr: Janus是一个利用LLM同时演化目标程序和可执行的代理评估器的框架，显著减少科学和工程设计中昂贵的真实评估次数，平均以59.1%更少的真实评估达到基线99%的最终改进。
AI.motivation: LLM驱动的程序发现依赖快速评估反馈，但许多科学和工程任务需要高保真模拟、硬件执行或物理实验，每次评估代价高昂。虽然廉价的代理评估器可以降低成本，但固定的代理评估器容易受到搜索诱导的分布偏移影响，且难以从稀疏且搜索偏置的标签中可靠拟合。
AI.method: Janus框架通过三个关键设计解决上述问题：(1)利用LLM的领域知识生成任务特定的评估器程序，并用真实结果校准，解决标签稀缺问题；(2)在被评估程序进化的同时演化评估器，使用promotion-aligned目标选择和区域条件化评估器组合（portfolio）及在线信用更新，缓解分布偏移；(3)代理预测仅用于候选排序，真实验证仍然是候选进入目标程序种群或更新当前最优解的必要条件。
AI.result: 在五个科学和工程设计任务上，Janus在真实评估预算下获得了更大的best-so-far改进曲线下面积和更高的最终性能，超过只演化目标程序的匹配基线。平均而言，Janus以59.1%更少的真实评估达到基线最终改进的99%。演化的代理评估器对候选程序的排序准确性也比其种子版本更高。
AI.conclusion: Janus将评估器引导的LLM程序发现从具有廉价可扩展反馈的任务扩展到评估稀缺且昂贵的科学领域。通过协同进化目标程序和代理评估器，并结合promotion-aligned选择与在线信用更新机制，在保持可靠性的同时大幅降低了真实评估的成本，为昂贵的科学和工程设计场景中的自动程序发现提供了可行路径。

title: Path-dependent Discrete Amortized Inference
summary: We consider the problem of sampling compositional and discrete objects from a given unnormalized posterior distribution. Notably, recent studies have shown that this problem can be efficiently solved by learning a deterministic Markov Decision Process (MDP) that progressively builds each object in proportion to the posterior. In this work, however, we demonstrate that the Markovian assumption can both hamper signal propagation during training and catastrophically reduce the learned sampler's expressivity due to state aliasing. To address these issues, we propose lifting the MDP with a learnable latent dynamical system that allows the underlying policy to depend on the entire past trajectory---and not only on the current state. In view of this, we refer to the resulting method as path-dependent discrete amortized inference. Importantly, we provably extend existing learning algorithms for discrete amortized samplers to our setting. In experiments on standard benchmark problems, we also show that our approach often leads to faster learning convergence and improved state space exploration relatively to prior techniques.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种路径依赖的离散摊销推断方法，通过可学习的潜在动力学系统提升MDP，使策略依赖整个历史轨迹而非仅当前状态，解决马尔可夫假设导致的信号传播受阻和状态别名化造成的表达力降低问题。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通过学习确定性MDP逐步构建对象来高效采样未归一化后验分布，但马尔可夫假设存在两个缺陷：训练中阻碍信号传播，且状态别名化严重降低学习采样器的表达力。
AI.method: 通过可学习的潜在动力学系统提升MDP，使底层策略能够依赖完整的历史轨迹而非仅当前状态，并理论证明将现有离散摊销采样器学习算法扩展到该设定。
AI.result: 在标准基准问题上的实验表明，该方法相对于先前技术通常能实现更快的收敛速度和更优的状态空间探索。
AI.conclusion: 路径依赖的潜在动力学提升方式有效克服了马尔可夫假设的实际限制，为离散组合对象的后验采样提供了更高效的框架。

title: A Minimal $κ$--$τ$ Logic for Risk-Sensitive Abduction
comment: 44 pages, 2 figures. Submitted to Neurosymbolic Artificial Intelligence (IOS Press/Sage)
summary: Standard approaches to abductive reasoning can retain multiple candidate explanations, but they do not generally combine explicit compositional cross-hypothesis interaction with an internal, rival-sensitive commitment judgment. This paper argues that in risk-sensitive domains -- where premature commitment carries asymmetric downside costs -- the timing of commitment is itself a governed decision that the inferential apparatus should formally represent. We present a minimal $κ$--$τ$ logical framework built on two primitives: epistemic interaction among hypotheses ($κ$) and a normative commitment threshold ($τ$). Hypotheses may coexist, reinforce or inhibit one another, and form emergent composite explanations, while collapse into committed conclusions is regulated by governance constraints rather than forced by inference alone. The logic is developed in two complementary modes sharing the interaction relation and the governance apparatus: a synthetic mode, in which atomic hypotheses are composed upward into emergent explanations, and an analytic mode, in which complex observed states of affairs are decomposed into causal clusters of latent factors, with commitment governed at both the cluster and the factor level. The framework provides formal machinery for domains in which the distinction between highly likely and commit-worthy is operationally consequential. The $κ$--$τ$ logic is positioned as the symbolic governance layer of a neurosymbolic architecture: its epistemic parameters are naturally estimated by neural components -- semantic embeddings and generative models, as demonstrated in existing computational realizations -- while its normative parameters remain under explicit human governance, yielding transparent and auditable abductive reasoning for deployment in high-stakes settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于两个原始概念的κ-τ逻辑框架，用于在风险敏感领域进行溯因推理。其中κ代表假设间的认知交互（假设可以共存、相互强化或抑制以形成涌现的复合解释），τ代表规范性的承诺阈值（何时从多个竞争假设坍缩为最终结论）。框架支持综合模式（自下而上组合原子假设）和分析模式（自上而下将复杂观测分解为潜在因果簇），承诺在两种模式下都由治理约束而非推理本身强制决定。该逻辑被定位为神经符号架构中的符号治理层：认知参数由神经组件估计，规范性参数由人类显式治理。
AI.motivation: 现有溯因推理方法可以保留多个候选解释，但通常不将显式的跨假设组合交互与内部、对竞争者敏感的判断相结合。在风险敏感领域，过早承诺会带来不对称的下行成本，因此承诺的时机本身就是一个应被推理机制正式表示的治理决策。
AI.method: 构建基于κ（假设间认知交互）和τ（规范性承诺阈值）两个原始概念的κ-τ逻辑框架。该逻辑具有两种互补模式：综合模式（原子假设自下而上组合成涌现解释）和分析模式（复杂观测状态自上而下分解为潜在因果簇，承诺在簇和因子两个层面受到治理）。其交互关系和治理机制在两种模式下共享。
AI.result: 该框架为"高可能性"与"值得承诺"在操作上存在区别的领域提供了形式化机制。作为神经符号架构中的符号治理层，认知参数可由神经组件（语义嵌入和生成模型）自然估计，规范性参数保持显式人工治理，从而实现透明、可审计的高风险场景溯因推理。
AI.conclusion: κ-τ逻辑将承诺时机提升为推理过程中的一等治理决策，为风险敏感领域提供了一种兼具涌现组合推理能力和人工治理透明度的溯因推理框架，适用于高稳健性要求的部署场景。

title: Multi-Relational Knowledge Graph Enhanced Embedding for Trajectory-User Linking
summary: Trajectory-User Linking (TUL) aims to identify the owner of an anonymous trajectory from a set of candidate users, providing a basis for user mobility analysis and personalized location-aware services. Existing methods often learn Point of Interest (POI), temporal, and semantic features independently, make limited use of structural knowledge shared across trajectories, and compress structural and sequential information before classification. To address these issues, we propose Multi-Relational Knowledge Graph Enhanced Embedding for Trajectory-User Linking (MakeTUL), which, to the best of our knowledge, is the first attempt to introduce knowledge graph representation learning into TUL. MakeTUL organizes visit-time, POI-category, and transfer-speed information as typed relations in a multi-relational mobility knowledge graph, allowing heterogeneous mobility semantics to jointly constrain the learned embeddings. The resulting POI representations are further enriched with high-order co-occurrence patterns extracted from the trajectory collection, providing structural prior knowledge for sparse and overlapping trajectories. By integrating these prior-enhanced representations with temporal, category, and transfer information, the trajectory sequence learning module captures ordered mobility patterns, while a dual-branch classification layer preserves and combines global structural evidence and sequential evidence at the decision level.

AI.tldr: MakeTUL是首个将知识图谱表示学习引入轨迹-用户关联（TUL）任务的方法，通过构建多关系移动知识图谱联合约束异构移动语义的嵌入学习，并结合高阶共现模式增强POI表示，最后通过双分支分类层在决策级别保留并融合全局结构证据与序列证据。
AI.motivation: 现有TUL方法通常独立学习POI、时间和语义特征，对跨轨迹共享的结构知识利用有限，且在分类前压缩了结构和序列信息，导致信息丢失。
AI.method: MakeTUL方法包含三个核心模块：1）构建包含访问时间、POI类别、转移速度三种类型关系的多关系移动知识图谱，使异构移动语义联合约束嵌入学习；2）从轨迹集合中提取高阶共现模式增强POI表示，为稀疏和重叠轨迹提供结构先验知识；3）集成时间、类别和转移信息的轨迹序列学习模块捕获有序移动模式，以及双分支分类层在决策级别融合全局结构证据与序列证据。
AI.result: 论文宣称MakeTUL是首个将知识图谱表示学习引入TUL任务的尝试，通过多关系知识图谱和结构先验增强有效解决了现有方法的局限性。
AI.conclusion: MakeTUL通过多关系知识图谱表示学习、高阶共现模式增强以及双分支决策级融合，为轨迹-用户关联任务提供了一种全新的、充分利用异构移动语义和结构知识的解决方案。

title: Persuasive and Compliant Tendencies Predict Group Decision-Making in Humans and Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly involved in group decision-making with other LLMs and humans. Yet it remains unclear whether their influence is driven by persuasion-oriented expression or compliance-oriented accommodation. We introduce DecisionQE, a questionnaire-based framework for measuring each model's persuasive and compliant tendencies across multiple decision scenarios, and use the Werewolf game as an interactive testbed to study their effects on social influence and group outcomes under asymmetric information. Across experiments, stronger persuasive tendency does not significantly improve group outcomes, whereas compliant-oriented models show more stable advantages in cooperation. We further reveal a dual effect of compliance: it supports cooperation in honest roles but improves concealment in adversarial roles.
