AI.tldr: 提出CoRe-UIE，一种面向退化区域的专家协作框架，用于水下图像增强。该框架结合内容保持的共享专家与四个共享骨干路由专家，分别处理颜色校正、散射抑制、纹理恢复和光照保护，并通过HSIC约束减少专家特征间的统计依赖，以应对水下图像中多样且区域共存的退化问题。
AI.motivation: 水下图像常同时遭受颜色失真、散射雾化、纹理衰减和不均匀光照等多种退化，且这些退化在不同区域表现不同、局部共存。传统统一恢复方法难以适应这种多样化的退化模式，因此需要一种能够按区域自适应处理不同退化类型的框架。
AI.method: CoRe-UIE采用退化导向的专家协作框架，由内容保持的共享专家与四个共享骨干路由专家组成。四个路由专家分别负责颜色校正、散射抑制、纹理恢复和光照保护，共享相同架构但具有独立参数。通过输入推导的退化线索和区域自适应Top-k路由将不同区域分配给对应专家。此外引入基于希尔伯特-施密特独立性准则（HSIC）的表征约束，降低专家特征间的统计依赖性，缓解冗余专家响应。
AI.result: 在UIEB、LSUI和U45三个基准数据集上的实验表明，CoRe-UIE在定量指标上取得了有竞争力的性能，并在多种水下退化条件下实现了视觉上均衡的增强效果。
AI.conclusion: CoRe-UIE通过区域自适应的专家路由与HSIC独立性约束，能够有效应对水下图像中不同退化模式在空间上的共存与分布差异，兼顾量化性能与视觉均衡性，为水下图像增强提供了退化感知的自适应解决方案。

title: Training-Free Universal Approximation by Prompting Random Transformers
summary: How expressive is prompting a transformer? Answering this question is important for separating the roles of prompting, architecture, and pretraining in transformer models, and for determining whether task-specific behavior must be stored in model weights or can instead be induced at inference time through the prompt. We show, in an approximation-theoretic sense, that pretraining is optional: a single-layer softmax attention network with random, untrained weights can approximate any Hölder function on a compact manifold when steered by an appropriate soft prompt. Guided by the connection between softmax attention and kernel methods, we construct explicit soft prompts (a prompt per target function, independent of the query) as solutions to linear systems matching attention logits to Gaussian kernel exponents, under which the frozen transformer emulates the classical Nadaraya-Watson kernel estimator. The construction requires only a mild rank condition on the weights, which we show holds almost surely under Gaussian initialization. The prompted network inherits the theoretical guarantees of kernel regression, leading to universal approximation theorems with minimax-optimal rates that depend on the intrinsic dimension. We further quantify the cost of prompting, exposing a tradeoff between the norm of the constructed soft prompt tokens, prompt length, and hidden dimension. Numerical experiments corroborate the constructions and predicted rates.

AI.tldr: 本文从逼近论角度证明，单层softmax注意力网络即使权重是随机且未训练的，也能通过适当的soft prompt逼近任意紧致流形上的Hölder函数。作者将softmax注意力与核方法联系起来，构造显式soft prompt，使冻结的transformer模拟Nadaraya-Watson核估计器，并获得minimax最优的逼近速率。
AI.motivation: 理解transformer中prompting的表达能力，对于区分prompting、架构和预训练三者各自的作用至关重要，同时决定任务特定行为是需要存储在模型权重中还是可以在推理时通过prompt诱导出来。回答"预训练是否是必需的"这一根本性问题。
AI.method: 利用softmax注意力与核方法之间的深层联系，将prompt构造为匹配注意力logits与高斯核指数的线性系统解（每个目标函数对应一个prompt，独立于查询）。作者证明了在权重满足温和的秩条件（在高斯初始化下几乎必然成立）时，冻结的随机权重transformer配合构造的soft prompt即可模拟Nadaraya-Watson核回归估计器，从而继承核回归的理论保证，获得依赖内在维度的minimax最优通用逼近定理，并进一步刻画了prompt代价（prompt token范数、prompt长度与隐藏维度之间的权衡）。
AI.result: 证明了预训练在逼近论意义上是可选的：随机未训练的softmax注意力网络配合显式构造的soft prompt可以通用逼近紧致流形上的Hölder函数，并获得minimax最优速率。数值实验验证了构造方法和预测的逼近速率。
AI.conclusion: Prompting具有强大的表达力，在逼近论意义上足以弥补未训练权重的不足；任务特定行为原则上可以通过精心构造的prompt在推理时诱导，而不必全部存储在模型权重中。这一发现有助于厘清prompting、架构与预训练在transformer中各自的功能边界。

title: Hyperbolic Multimodal Continual Learning
summary: Hyperbolic geometry has recently emerged as a powerful representation space for multimodal learning, as it naturally captures hierarchical semantic structure across modalities. Despite this progress, how such representations behave under continual learning poses fundamentally different challenges that remain underexplored. This work provides a geometric perspective on this problem and establishes a theoretical foundation for representation preservation in hyperbolic space, showing that preventing forgetting requires cross-modal invariance under a shared hyperbolic isometry. We further show that forgetting in hyperbolic continual learning involves both semantic relation drift and hierarchy-related distortion, motivating preservation of both cross-modal relational structure and hierarchical geometry. Guided by these insights, a principled continual learning framework is derived that preserves essential geometric structure while allowing effective adaptation to new tasks. Experiments on continual multimodal benchmarks corroborate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

AI.tldr: 本文首次从几何视角研究多模态持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，提出双曲空间中的表示保持理论，证明防止遗忘需要共享双曲等距下的跨模态不变性，并据此构建了保持跨模态关系结构与层级几何的持续学习框架。
AI.motivation: 双曲几何近期作为多模态学习的强大表示空间而兴起，能自然捕获跨模态的层级语义结构。然而，这些表示在持续学习场景下的行为存在根本性挑战且尚未被充分探索，因此需要从几何角度为这一问题建立理论根基。
AI.method: 首先从理论上证明防止遗忘需要共享双曲等距(isometry)下的跨模态不变性；接着分析指出双曲持续学习中的遗忘涉及语义关系漂移和层级相关失真两类问题，需要同时保持跨模态关系结构与层级几何；基于这些洞见推导出一个保持本质几何结构同时允许有效适应新任务的原则性持续学习框架。
AI.result: 在持续多模态基准上的实验证实了所提出方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为双曲空间中的多模态持续学习奠定了理论基础，证明了表示保持的关键在于共享等距下的跨模态不变性，并通过保留跨模态关系结构与层级几何实现了有效的持续学习。

title: PolicyKG: An Agentic LLM Pipeline for Translating Institutional Policies into SHACL Knowledge Graphs
comment: 23 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Under review at IJCKG 2026, Bangkok, Thailand
summary:
Institutional policies stay in natural language while the systems that check compliance demand machine-readable constraints. Bridging that gap is still done by hand.
  PolicyKG closes the loop. It is an LLM pipeline that reads a policy PDF, classifies each sentence as an obligation, permission, or prohibition, lifts the label into first-order deontic logic, and emits SHACL constraints. Four stages run on a LangGraph state machine with per-stage validators. The piece that matters most is the Corpus Adapter: a YAML vocabulary registry that grounds LLM predicates in a target ontology. Retargeting to a new domain means swapping the registry, not retraining a model.
  On the Asian Institute of Technology Policies and Procedures corpus (1,663 sentences, 443 rules), PolicyKG reaches 86.9% deontic classification accuracy (Cohen's kappa = .709). Three annotators independently re-label a 50-item sample and agree at Fleiss' kappa = .844. SHACL shape correctness on a 69-shape subset is F1 = .866. The FOL path handles 79.2% of rules; the rest go through a direct NL-to-SHACL fallback.
  We audited every one of the 443 rules for second- or higher-order constructs. An automated regex checklist flagged none, and a first-author pass on the 92 FOL-fallback cases confirmed the same. The exact upper 95% Clopper-Pearson bound on the true HOL rate is 0.67%. This is an audit finding for one corpus, not a proof of FOL sufficiency for institutional policy.
  Swapping the AIT registry for a GDPR registry raises exact property alignment from 1/15 to 11/15 (Fisher's exact p < .001; Cohen's h = 1.53). On the LexDeMod lease-contract benchmark (N = 200), Macro F1 drops to .370 because lease English uses "shall be entitled" for permission -- exactly the vocabulary mismatch registry swap is meant to fix. Repeated runs produce hash-identical SHACL outputs.

AI.tldr: PolicyKG是一个LLM管道，自动将机构政策PDF转换为机器可读的SHACL约束，通过四阶段LangGraph状态机实现义务/许可/禁令的分类、一阶谓词逻辑提升和SHACL生成。其核心创新是Corpus Adapter——一个YAML词汇注册表，通过替换注册表即可将系统重新定向到新领域，无需重训模型。
AI.motivation: 机构政策以自然语言编写，而合规检查系统需要机器可读的约束。目前从政策文本到机器可读约束的转换仍依赖人工完成，桥梁缺口显著。需要一个自动化的管道来弥合这一鸿沟。
AI.method: PolicyKG采用四阶段LangGraph状态机流水线：(1) 将政策PDF的每个句子分类为义务、许可或禁令；(2) 将标签提升为一阶道义逻辑（FOL）；(3) 生成SHACL约束；(4) 每阶段配备验证器。核心组件是Corpus Adapter——一个YAML词汇注册表，将LLM谓词锚定到目标本体中，换注册表即可重定向到新领域。
AI.result: 在AIT政策语料库（1,663句、443条规则）上达到86.9%的道义分类准确率（Cohen's kappa = .709）；三位标注者的Fleiss' kappa = .844；69个SHACL形状上的F1 = .866；FOL路径处理79.2%的规则，其余21%通过直接NL-to-SHACL回退处理。对443条规则的高阶结构审计确认HOL率为0.67%（95% Clopper-Pearson上界）。从AIT到GDPR注册表的切换使属性对齐从1/15提升到11/15（p < .001）。在LexDeMod租赁合同基准上Macro F1降至.370，凸显词汇不匹配问题。重复运行产生哈希一致的SHACL输出。
AI.conclusion: PolicyKG证明LLM管道配合词汇注册表可以自动化政策合规转换。注册表可替换性是跨领域重定向的关键机制。但审计发现是一语料库的观测而非FOL充分性的普遍证明，且词汇不匹配（如租赁英语中"shall be entitled"表示许可）仍会显著降低性能，表明该领域仍有改进空间。

title: LEED: Local Embedding Evolution Distance for over-smoothing estimation and virtual node selection in GNN
summary: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) suffer from two fundamental limitations: over-smoothing, where node representations become indistinguishable with depth, and over-squashing, where long-range information is compressed through limited message-passing channels. Existing metrics such as Dirichlet energy provide global characterizations of over-smoothing but lack the resolution to analyze node-level behavior and guide architectural improvements. In this paper, we propose LEED (Local Embedding Evolution Distance), a novel local metric that quantifies over-smoothing by tracking the evolution of individual node embeddings across layers. By operating at the node level, LEED enables fine-grained analysis of representation dynamics during training, revealing heterogeneous over-smoothing patterns that are invisible to global energy-based measures. This locality induces informative node importance scores, interpreted as embedding-driven centrality measures. We leverage LEED to design a more efficient strategy for virtual node selection. Unlike existing approaches that depend on multiple heuristic centrality measures, our method uses LEED as a unique criterion to guide the construction of Local Virtual Nodes to mitigate over-squashing. Experiments show that LEED provides more informative diagnostics than Dirichlet energy while preserving global evaluation, and enables more effective virtual node integration, improving GNN performance across datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出LEED（局部嵌入演化距离）这一节点级局部度量，用于量化GNN中的过平滑问题，并利用该度量设计更高效的虚拟节点选择策略，以缓解过压缩问题。
AI.motivation: GNN面临过平滑和过压缩两大局限。现有度量（如Dirichlet能量）只能全局刻画过平滑，缺乏节点级别的分辨能力，无法分析节点级行为并指导架构改进。
AI.method: 提出LEED局部度量，通过追踪每层中单个节点嵌入的演化来量化过平滑。基于LEED生成节点重要性分数（嵌入驱动中心性），并以LEED作为唯一准则指导局部虚拟节点的构建以缓解过压缩。
AI.result: 实验表明LEED比Dirichlet能量提供更具信息量的诊断，同时保持全局评估能力；基于LEED的虚拟节点集成更有效，在多个数据集上提升了GNN性能。
AI.conclusion: LEED通过节点级别的细粒度分析揭示了全局能量度量无法观测到的异质过平滑模式，并成功地将过平滑诊断与过压缩缓解统一到同一个局部度量框架下。

title: DualCert: A Solver for the Traveling Salesman Problem with Constraint-Coupled Learning
summary: Large traveling salesman problem (TSP) instances require a solver to allocate limited computation while preserving the validity of its outputs. Existing neural--operations-research (OR) hybrids predict guidance without requiring learned transitions to satisfy constraints discovered during search. DualCert introduces \emph{constraint-coupled learning}, in which current degree equations and dynamically separated subtour-elimination constraints (SECs) define each learned transition. At each refinement, the degree equations and selected, strictly satisfied SEC equations, with positive slacks, define an iterate-dependent primal-slack Karush--Kuhn--Tucker (KKT) manifold. Repaired dual variables and violated SEC rows define a local cost field. An exact constrained mirror-descent step maps each finite state to a positive state on the same manifold. Where selected rows and deterministic ties remain fixed, implicit differentiation maps parameter perturbations into the manifold tangent space and reuses the forward constraint operator for the local-cost-field derivative. The terminal edge state allocates computation across Held--Karp ascent, candidate-graph edge tests, and tour construction under a fixed budget. Deterministic verification recomputes original costs and accepts only verified candidate-graph lower bounds and edge decisions. On 1,000 held-out TSP1000 instances, DualCert attains a mean tour-cost gap of \(0.0573\%\) from Lin--Kernighan--Helsgaun version 3 (LKH-3) reference tours in \(9.55\) batch-amortized seconds per instance. It returns a verified candidate-graph lower bound for every instance and achieves \(81.46\%\) edge-decision coverage. The mean gap is \(67.1\%\) smaller than the reported NeuroLKH mean gap. Thus, optimization constraints govern learning, while deterministic verification preserves output validity.

AI.tldr: DualCert提出了一种"约束耦合学习"方法，将当前度约束和动态分离的子环消除约束（SECs）整合到神经求解器的每个学习过渡中。通过迭代相关的原始松弛KKT流形和精确的约束镜像下降步骤，模型在有限的计算预算内求解大规模TSP问题。在1000个TSP1000实例上，平均tour成本差距为0.0573%（相对LKH-3），推理时间9.55秒/实例，且对所有实例都能提供经过验证的候选图下界，边缘决策覆盖率达81.46%，平均差距比NeuroLKH小67.1%。
AI.motivation: 大规模TSP实例需要求解器在有限计算预算内分配资源，同时保持输出有效性。现有的神经-运筹学混合方法虽然能预测引导信息，但无法保证学习到的过渡满足搜索过程中发现的约束，导致输出可能无效或次优。
AI.method: DualCert引入约束耦合学习：1) 用度方程和动态分离的严格满足SEC方程定义迭代依赖的原始松弛KKT流形；2) 修复对偶变量和违规SEC行以定义局部代价场；3) 使用精确约束镜像下降步骤将有限状态映射到同一流形上的正状态；4) 通过隐式微分处理参数扰动到流形切空间；5) 终端边缘状态在固定预算下将计算分配给Held-Karp上升、候选图边缘测试和tour构建；6) 确定性验证重新计算原始成本，仅接受已验证的候选图下界和边缘决策。
AI.result: 在1000个保留的TSP1000实例上，DualCert达到0.0573%的平均tour成本差距（相对LKH-3参考），批归一化推理时间9.55秒/实例；为每个实例返回验证过的候选图下界，实现81.46%的边缘决策覆盖率；平均差距比NeuroLKH报告的平均差距小67.1%。
AI.conclusion: 优化约束制约学习过程，而确定性验证保证了输出有效性。DualCert证明将约束结构直接嵌入神经网络的过渡设计中，能够在保证解有效性的前提下实现高效的大规模TSP求解，显著超越现有神经OR混合方法。

title: Bayesian Symbolic Regression with Entropic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Symbolic regression is the problem of finding an algebraic expression describing a stochastic dependence of a target variable on a set of inputs. Unlike forms of regression that fit parameters assuming a fixed model structure, symbolic regression is a search problem over the space of expressions, represented, for example, as abstract syntax trees using a library of operators. Symbolic regression is typically used in settings with limited, noisy data in the natural sciences. However, searching for a single best-fitting expression fails to capture the epistemic uncertainty about the expression, which motivates a Bayesian perspective that enables uncertainty quantification and specification of natural priors to constrain the search space. In this work, we propose ERRLESS (Entropy-Regularized Reinforcement Learning for Expression Structure Sampling), a scalable approach for sampling from the posterior distribution over expressions given data using maximum-entropy reinforcement learning. ERRLESS learns a neural policy that constructs expressions sequentially by building up their abstract syntax trees. At convergence, the policy samples expressions from the posterior. At test time, expressions can be sampled by rollouts of this policy. We demonstrate that ERRLESS achieves competitive results on the Feynman benchmark while producing short and interpretable expressions. Additionally, we demonstrate that the mean of the posterior predictive approximated by ERRLESS achieves a high coefficient of determination ($R^2$) compared to an SMC baseline, highlighting the benefits of the Bayesian perspective in symbolic regression.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ERRLESS，一种基于最大熵强化学习的方法，从表达式后验分布中采样，用于符号回归中的不确定性量化。
AI.motivation: 传统符号回归只搜索单个最佳拟合表达式，无法捕获表达式空间中的认知不确定性（epistemic uncertainty）。在自然科学中数据有限且噪声大，需要贝叶斯视角来进行不确定性量化并利用自然先验来约束搜索空间。
AI.method: ERRLESS使用最大熵强化学习，学习一个神经策略，通过逐步构建抽象语法树（AST）来顺序构造表达式。策略在收敛时从后验分布中采样表达式，测试时通过策略的rollout进行采样。
AI.result: 在Feynman基准上达到有竞争力的结果，同时产生简短可解释的表达式；与SMC基线相比，ERRLESS近似的后验预测均值取得更高的决定系数（R²），凸显贝叶斯视角的优势。
AI.conclusion: ERRLESS提供了一种可扩展的、贝叶斯视角下的符号回归方法，能够从表达式后验中进行采样，实现不确定性量化，并在预测性能上优于SMC基线。

title: A Multi-Scale Temporal Framework with Dynamic Fusion for EEG-Based Emotion Recognition
comment: The paper has been accepted at: IEEE | 2026 9th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence (PRAI 2026)
summary: Mixed emotions represent a clinically relevant but still underexplored target for automatic emotion recognition. EEG provides millisecond-level access to neural activity, yet most EEG pipelines analyze the signal through a single temporal window, thereby fixing the temporal structure available to the model. This study introduces a multi-scale temporal framework for EEG-based emotion recognition. The EEG waveform is decomposed into windows of one or several durations, processed by a shared attention-based encoder, and integrated through a dynamic fusion module that assigns sample-specific weights across temporal scales. The framework is evaluated under a subject-independent protocol in binary and three-class settings, with the three-class task including the mixed affective category. The best results are 65.22% for the two-class task and 45.43% for the three-class task. Both are obtained with three-scale dynamic-fusion configurations and remain substantially above the full-signal baseline. The best-performing temporal scales differ between the two tasks. Dynamic fusion outperforms concatenation in the highest-scoring two-class configuration and slightly exceeds it in the highest-scoring three-class configuration, although these multi-scale settings require substantially more computation than the full-signal baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于EEG的多尺度时间框架用于情绪识别，将脑电波形分解为不同时长的窗口，通过共享注意力编码器处理并经动态融合模块整合。在受试者无关协议下，二分类任务最佳准确率为65.22%，三分类（含混合情绪类别）为45.43%，均显著优于全信号基线，但计算开销明显增加。
AI.motivation: 混合情绪作为临床相关但尚未被充分探索的情绪识别目标，现有的EEG情感识别流水线大多通过单一时间窗口分析信号，固定了模型可用的时间结构，无法充分利用EEG的毫秒级神经活动信息。
AI.method: 提出多尺度时间框架：将EEG波形分解为一个或多个时长的窗口，各窗口由共享基于注意力的编码器处理，再通过动态融合模块为不同时间尺度分配样本特定的权重进行整合。评估采用受试者无关协议，涵盖二分类和三分类（含混合情感类别）设置。
AI.result: 二分类任务最佳准确率65.22%，三分类任务最佳准确率45.43%，均由三尺度动态融合配置取得，且均显著高于全信号基线。两个任务的最佳时间尺度不同；动态融合在二分类最高配置中优于拼接方法，在三分类最高配置中略优于拼接。多尺度设置的计算量显著高于全信号基线。
AI.conclusion: 多尺度时间框架对EEG情绪识别（包括混合情绪）有效，优于全信号基线；动态融合优于简单拼接；但计算成本较高，且不同任务的最佳时间尺度存在差异。

title: Satellite Trajectory Optimization via Proximal Policy Optimization for Space Debris Avoidance
comment: 18 pages, 16 figures. Published in IEEE Access, vol. 14, pp. 18138-18154, 2026
summary: Collision avoidance systems are commonly used to avoid fragmentation events occurring in Low-Earth Orbit (LEO) and Geosynchronous Equatorial Orbit (GEO). However, these events have been growing in frequency as orbital congestion worsens with the launch of megaconstellations. Consequently, conjunction alerts and collision risks are becoming increasingly common. Current practices, which are commonly manual or rule-based, have difficulty scaling to these worsening dynamic environments. To address this intensifying situation, we propose a reinforcement-learning policy for autonomous collision avoidance, trained via Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) along with an open-source, high-fidelity astrodynamics simulator for training and evaluation. In 1,000 deterministic GEO episodes, our agent achieves a 97.5% collision avoidance success rate, outperforming traditional controllers such as a rule-based baseline (20.7% success) and an impulsive delta-v planner baseline (27.5% success). To achieve these results, we designed a simulator to train and evaluate our agent, using real-world and simulated debris. We simulate Newtonian two-body dynamics using Sun/Moon third-body perturbations, fuel-dependent thrust, and configurable debris fields. The agent is trained with curriculum learning and shaped rewards oriented toward encouraging survival, adequate projected miss distance, and delta-v conservation. Finally, our evaluation consisted of a fully deterministic pipeline, including shared seeds, per-episode logs, and telemetry exports. Our work is a publicly available framework at https://purl.org/sat-trajectory-avoidance

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于强化学习（PPO）的自主航天器防撞策略，在GOES高保真模拟器中训练，在1000次确定性GEO场景中达到97.5%的碰撞避免成功率，远超规则基线和脉冲Δv规划基线（20.7%和27.5%），并开源了训练与评估框架。
AI.motivation: 近地轨道（LEO）和地球同步轨道（GEO）中航天器碰撞事件因巨型星座的发射而日益频繁，传统手动或基于规则的碰撞规避方法难以扩展以应对日益动态和拥挤的轨道环境，亟需可扩展的自主防撞方案。
AI.method: 提出基于Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO)的强化学习防撞策略；构建了开源高保真天体动力学模拟器，包含牛顿二体动力学、日/月三体摄动、燃料相关推力及可配置碎片场；采用课程学习（curriculum learning）和面向存活率、投影交会距离和Δv节约的塑形奖励进行训练；评估采用完全确定性流水线（共享种子、逐集日志和遥测导出）。
AI.result: 在1000次确定性GEO测试场景中，强化学习代理实现97.5%的碰撞避免成功率，显著优于规则基线的20.7%和脉冲Δv规划基线的27.5%。
AI.conclusion: 强化学习方法在自主航天器碰撞规避中展现出相对于传统控制策略的显著优势，且提供了公开可用的开源框架供后续研究使用。

title: Who Bridges Safety? Identifying and Targeting Cross-Lingual Shared Safety Pathways
summary: Uncovering the internal mechanisms underlying the safety capabilities of large language models (LLMs) is crucial for developing trustworthy artificial intelligence. Currently, mechanistic interpretability studies on multilingual safety are largely confined to local components, such as isolated neurons. However, this static and fragmented perspective overlooks the synergy among components and fails to elucidate how safety signals dynamically propagate within the model to drive safety decisions ultimately. In this work, we move beyond isolated neurons to identify and target the cross-layer functional pathways formed during safety signal propagation, thereby uncovering the mechanisms driving the cross-lingual safety gap. Specifically, we first identify monolingual safety pathways and validate their impact on refusing harmful requests. Subsequent cross-lingual analyses reveal a sparse subset of cross-lingual shared safety pathways, confirming that this intersection acts as the internal bridge transferring safety capabilities from high-resource (HR) languages to non-high-resource (NHR) languages. Building on these mechanistic findings, we propose a pathways-targeted alignment method based on the cross-lingual shared safety pathways. Experimental results show that updating only a small fraction of pathway parameters significantly improves safety in NHR languages while largely preserving the model's general capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文超越传统孤立神经元视角，识别并定位跨层功能通路来揭示LLM跨语言安全差距的内部机制，并提出基于跨语言共享安全通路的靶向对齐方法。
AI.motivation: 目前对多语言安全的机制可解释性研究局限于孤立神经元等局部组件，这种静态、碎片化的视角忽视了组件间的协同作用，无法解释安全信号如何在模型内动态传播并最终驱动安全决策。理解LLM安全能力的内部机制对开发可信AI至关重要。
AI.method: 首先识别单语安全通路并验证其对拒绝有害请求的影响；随后进行跨语言分析，发现稀疏的跨语言共享安全通路子集，确认该交集充当从高资源语言向非高资源语言转移安全能力的内部桥梁；基于此提出通路靶向对齐方法。
AI.result: 实验表明，仅更新一小部分通路参数即可显著提升非高资源语言的安全性能，同时基本保持模型的一般能力。
AI.conclusion: 跨语言共享安全通路是安全能力跨语言迁移的内部桥梁，靶向更新这些通路参数能以极低成本有效增强低资源语言的安全性。

title: Deep Learning Imputation of Missing Radius of Maximum Winds (Rmax) Values in Tropical Cyclone Best-Track Data
summary: Probabilistic coastal hazard assessments require accurate characterization of tropical cyclone (TC) parameters, yet datasets often contain missing records for the radius of maximum winds (Rmax), a key variable in Joint Probability Method analyses. This study evaluates data-driven approaches for Rmax imputation, including one-dimensional Convolutional Neural Networks (1DCNNs), Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks, and conventional machine learning models. We examine physics-informed input augmentation, temporal modeling, and transfer learning using synthetic RAFT and STORM datasets for pre-training and observational IBTrACS data for fine-tuning. Including the radius of 34-knot winds (R34) substantially improves performance across all model types. Temporal models achieve higher average correlations than non-temporal models despite using approximately an order of magnitude fewer samples, indicating better preservation of relative Rmax variability across storms. This advantage is more pronounced when R34 is unavailable, suggesting temporal information can partially compensate for missing storm-size predictors. Transfer learning does not improve performance, likely because synthetic datasets have lower and less variable Rmax distributions than IBTrACS. These findings demonstrate the potential of temporal deep learning for reconstructing incomplete TC records and highlight the importance of physics-informed inputs, observational data availability, and distributional consistency in coastal hazard assessment.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了多种数据驱动方法（1DCNN、LSTM及传统机器学习）用于热带气旋最大风速半径（Rmax）缺失记录的插补。结果表明，引入34节风速半径（R34）作为物理信息输入可显著提升所有模型的性能；时序模型（LSTM）在样本量少约一个数量级的情况下仍能获得更高的相关性，特别是在R34缺失时可部分补偿信息不足；迁移学习未能提升性能，因为合成数据集（RAFT/STORM）的Rmax分布与观测数据IBTrACS不一致。
AI.motivation: 概率性海岸灾害评估需要准确的热带气旋参数，但数据集中常常缺失最大风速半径（Rmax）记录，而该变量是联合概率方法分析中的关键变量，缺失会影响灾害评估的准确性。
AI.method: 对比评估多种数据驱动方法进行Rmax插补：一维卷积神经网络（1DCNN）、长短期记忆网络（LSTM）以及传统机器学习模型。研究中包含物理信息输入增强（引入R34）、时序建模，以及利用合成数据集RAFT和STORM进行预训练、利用观测数据IBTrACS进行微调的迁移学习策略。
AI.result: （1）引入R34可显著提升所有模型类型的性能；（2）时序模型在样本量约少一个数量级的情况下仍比非时序模型获得更高的平均相关性，能更好地保存风暴间Rmax相对变异性；（3）R34缺失时序模型的优势更明显，时序信息可部分补偿缺失的风暴大小预测因子；（4）迁移学习未提升性能，原因是合成数据集Rmax分布低于且变异性小于IBTrACS。
AI.conclusion: 时序深度学习在重建不完整的热带气旋记录方面具有潜力，同时强调了物理信息输入、观测数据可用性以及分布一致性在海岸灾害评估中的重要性。

title: Different Feedback, Different Updates: Selective Self-Learning from User Interactions for Large Language Models
summary: User feedback offers natural supervision for persistent LLM improvement, but a single message may support multiple behavioral changes with different scopes of generalization. We introduce SLIFT, a selective self-learning framework built on a task-relative view of user feedback. SLIFT decomposes each feedback message into atomic components and interprets each component relative to the original task as Fix, Spec, or Null: requirements for task validity, compatible condition-specific refinements, or content with no reliable positive update direction. To incorporate each change at the appropriate scope, SLIFT trains two complementary LoRA adapters on a shared frozen backbone: a Generalist that consolidates Fix requirements into default behavior through feedback-conditioned self-distillation, and a Specialist that observes only the task and Generalist response to supply residual guidance for applicable, unmet Spec refinements. Null components induce no positive update. Across backbones, SLIFT achieves strong performance on both MemoryBench and WildFB, with targeted analyses further examining its underlying mechanisms. We release our code at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SLIFT.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SLIFT，一个基于任务相对视角的选择性自学习框架，将用户反馈分解为原子组件并分类为Fix、Spec或Null，通过训练通用适配器和专精适配器在共享冻结骨干上实现不同泛化范围的持续学习。
AI.motivation: 单个用户反馈消息可能支持多种具有不同泛化范围的行为改变，但现有方法难以区分这些变化并选择正确的学习范围，导致无法有效利用自然反馈进行持久的大语言模型改进。
AI.method: SLIFT将每条反馈消息分解为原子组件，并相对原始任务将每个组件解释为三类：Fix（任务有效性要求）、Spec（兼容的条件特定细化）、Null（无可靠正向更新方向的内容）。SLIFT在共享冻结骨干上训练两个互补的LoRA适配器：Generalist通过反馈条件自蒸馏将Fix需求整合为默认行为；Specialist仅观察任务和Generalist响应，为适用的、未被满足的Spec细化提供残差指导。Null组件不诱导任何正向更新。
AI.result: SLIFT在MemoryBench和WildFB基准上均取得了强性能表现，并通过针对性分析进一步验证了其底层机制。
AI.conclusion: SLIFT通过任务相对视角选择性分解用户反馈，以适当的泛化范围整合各类行为改变，为基于自然反馈的LLM持续改进提供了有效框架。

title: FedOrbit: Adaptive Personalized Federated Learning for Non-IID LEO Satellite Constellations
summary: Federated learning (FL) in Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite constellations is affected by non-IID data and irregular ground-station visibility, both driven by orbital geometry. Global aggregation performs poorly when orbit-level class distributions are disjoint, while strong personalisation can be excessive when these distributions overlap. We present FedOrbit, which combines continuous orbit-level training over inter-satellite links, class-aware hierarchical aggregation, quality-weighted feature aggregation with return-rate dampening, and adaptive feature decomposition based on inter-orbit class similarity. Across three remote-sensing benchmarks and two non-IID partitions, FedOrbit achieves the highest accuracy in five of six settings and is within $0.9$ percentage points of the best result in the sixth. The gains over the strongest baseline reach $16.1$ percentage points under Dirichlet partitioning and $8.6$ under pathological partitioning, with the smallest per-orbit accuracy spread in five of six settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FedOrbit，一种针对低地球轨道（LEO）卫星星座中联邦学习（FL）的新方法，通过结合连续轨道级训练、类别感知分层聚合、质量加权特征聚合与自适应特征分解，解决了非IID数据和地面站可见性不规则导致的全局聚合性能差和个性化过度问题。
AI.motivation: LEO卫星星座中的联邦学习受轨道几何驱动的非IID数据和地面站可见性不规则的影响。当轨道级类别分布不重叠时全局聚合表现差，而当分布重叠时强烈的个性化又可能过度。现有方法无法同时应对这两种情况。
AI.method: FedOrbit包含四个关键组成部分：1) 通过星际链路进行连续轨道级训练；2) 类别感知的分层聚合机制；3) 带有返回率阻尼的质量加权特征聚合；4) 基于轨道间类别相似性的自适应特征分解。
AI.result: 在三个遥感基准和两种非IID划分下，FedOrbit在六种设置中的五种达到最高准确率，第六种设置与最佳结果差距在0.9个百分点以内。在Dirichlet划分下比最强基线提升达16.1个百分点，在病理性划分下提升8.6个百分点，并且在六种设置中的五种具有最小的每轨道准确率离散度。
AI.conclusion: FedOrbit通过自适应地根据轨道间类别相似性来决定是进行全局聚合还是局部个性化训练，有效解决了LEO卫星场景中全局聚合与个性化之间的权衡问题，在准确性和稳定性方面均优于现有最强基线。

title: RAVEN-Eval: Rubric-Guided Automatic Evaluation for AI Video Generation Models Based on LMM Preference Judgement
summary: AI video generation has advanced rapidly and entered widespread commercial use. As a result, quality differences among videos produced by state-of-the-art AI video generation models~(AIVGMs) have become increasingly difficult to discern using conventional evaluation criteria, such as visual fidelity and semantic instruction following. Meanwhile, human evaluation now requires more expertise and sustained attention, substantially increasing annotation costs. This calls for automated evaluation that can reliably distinguish fine-grained differences among advanced AIVGMs with minimal human intervention. To address this challenge, we present RAVEN-Eval, a rubric-guided automated evaluation framework for AIVGMs, built primarily on the LMM-as-a-judge paradigm. Through an automatic task curation and quality-filtering pipeline, RAVEN-Eval curates 150 text-to-video~(T2V) tasks and 100 image-to-video~(I2V) tasks, and systematically collects more than 4,500 AIGVs. At its core, RAVEN-Eval adopts rubric-guided automated LMM preference judgement, in which LMM judges conduct pairwise comparisons according to task-specific rubrics. It further introduces an anchor-based model insertion approach to reduce the evaluation cost of incorporating new models. Finally, we evaluate 20 high-performance AIVGMs, as well as the judging capabilities of 13 LMM judges, and establish the RAVEN-Eval Leaderboards. Overall, RAVEN-Eval paves a scalable path for automatic and trustworthy evaluation of rapidly evolving AIVGMs.

AI.tldr: RAVEN-Eval 是一个基于规则引导的自动化评估框架，用于区分先进 AI 视频生成模型（AIVGM）之间的细微质量差异。它通过自动任务策展和质量过滤管线收集了150个文生视频任务和100个图生视频任务，产生超过4500个 AI 生成视频，采用 LMM 评判者结合任务特定规则进行成对比较，并引入锚点模型插入方法降低新模型评估成本，最终评估了20个高性能 AIVGM 和13个 LMM 评判者，建立了 RAVEN-Eval 排行榜。
AI.motivation: 随着 AI 视频生成技术进入大规模商用，顶尖模型之间的质量差异用传统评估标准（如视觉保真度和语义指令遵循）已难以区分；同时人工评估需要更高专业性和持续注意力，标注成本大幅增加，因此亟需一种能可靠区分先进模型细微差异且最小化人工干预的自动化评估方法。
AI.method: RAVEN-Eval 采用 LMM-as-a-judge 范式，核心包括三部分：(1) 自动任务策展与质量过滤管线，策展150个T2V任务和100个I2V任务，收集超过4500个AIGV；(2) 规则引导的自动化LMM偏好判断，让LMM评判者依据任务特定规则进行成对比较；(3) 锚点模型插入方法，通过已有锚点模型降低纳入新模型的评估成本。
AI.result: 评估了20个高性能AIVGM（13个LMM评判者的判断能力），建立了 RAVEN-Eval Leaderboards，证明了该框架能够可靠区分先进AIVGM之间的细微差距。
AI.conclusion: RAVEN-Eval 为快速演进的AIVGM提供了一条可扩展的自动化且可信赖的评估路径，在降低人工干预和标注成本的同时，实现了对模型间细微质量差异的可靠区分。

title: Confusion-Geometry Rebalancing for Long-Tailed Adversarial Training
summary: Adversarial training under long tailed distributions suffers from a dual imbalance: the class imbalance skews the training objective toward head classes, and the adversarial inner maximization may further amplify this bias. Existing methods mitigate this issue by correcting class priors or adapting class wise robust supervision, yet they treat each class in isolation and fail to identify which boundaries drive long tailed collapse. We propose a Confusion Geometry Rebalancing method (CGRm) for long tail adversarial training, a plug in framework that leverages directed robust errors as training signals. CGRm leverages periodic robust evaluations to derive source class loss weights, class wise robust coefficients, and a directed confusion geometry graph. The method then couples feedback weighted robust optimization with graph guided margin correction, thereby boosting the robustness of vulnerable classes and sharpening the critical boundaries that drive long tailed performance degradation. Experiments on long tailed benchmarks show that CGRm achieves consistent robust performance gains over existing methods, with ablations validating the contribution of each component. We provide the code in the supplement.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向长尾分布下对抗训练的混淆几何再平衡方法（CGRm），通过有向鲁棒误差作为训练信号，结合反馈加权鲁棒优化与图引导边际校正，提升脆弱类别的鲁棒性并锐化关键分类边界，在长尾基准上取得一致的鲁棒性能提升。
AI.motivation: 长尾分布下的对抗训练面临双重失衡：类别不平衡使训练目标偏向头部类别，而对抗内层最大化可能进一步放大这一偏差。现有方法将每个类别孤立处理，未识别驱动长尾崩溃的具体分类边界，缺乏对边界层面失衡的建模与纠正。
AI.method: CGRm是一个即插即用的框架，核心包括：(1) 利用周期性鲁棒评估推导源类别损失权重、类别级鲁棒系数和有向混淆几何图；(2) 将反馈加权鲁棒优化与图引导边际校正耦合，从而提升脆弱类别的鲁棒性并锐化驱动长尾性能退化的关键边界。
AI.result: 在长尾基准数据上的实验表明，CGRm相较现有方法取得了持续的鲁棒性能提升，并通过消融实验验证了每个组件的贡献。
AI.conclusion: CGRm通过挖掘类别间有向混淆关系来引导对抗训练再平衡，在长尾对抗鲁棒性上优于现有方法，其即插即用特性也便于集成到已有训练流程中。

title: Motif 3: Technical Report
summary: We introduce Motif 3, a decoder-only Mixture-of-Experts language model with 314 billion total parameters and 13.2 billion activated per token. Each sparse MoE layer contains 384 routed experts, with eight selected per token. This fine-grained sparsity provides substantial expert capacity while limiting computation. Motif 3 is built around Grouped Differential Latent Attention (GDLA), which integrates grouped differential attention with the compressed key-value representation of Multi-head Latent Attention. The architecture further incorporates modified manifold-constrained hyper-connections, Expert Specific PolyNorm activations, and multi-token prediction to improve optimization stability, expert specialization, and inference efficiency. We pretrain Motif 3 on approximately 12.5 trillion tokens spanning web documents, STEM, code, mathematics, multilingual content, and domain-specialized corpora. Expert-balancing and numerical-stabilization techniques support stable training at scale, while selective MXFP8 computation and communication, memory-efficient fused kernels, and window-aware context parallelism enable training with context lengths up to 256K tokens. Our post-training pipeline combines general supervised fine-tuning, six specialist teachers trained with reinforcement learning, a software-engineering teacher trained with supervised fine-tuning, and Multi-teacher On-Policy Distillation. The resulting unified model consolidates complementary capabilities in reasoning, coding, tool use, professional work, long-context understanding, calibrated abstention, and instruction following. Across a broad evaluation suite, Motif 3 demonstrates competitive performance against leading open weight models, including strong results on long-horizon agentic tasks, mathematical reasoning, scientific knowledge, and hallucination-sensitive evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Motif 3，一个拥有3140亿总参数（每token激活132亿参数）的decoder-only MoE语言模型。其核心创新是Grouped Differential Latent Attention (GDLA)架构，结合了分组差分注意力与多头潜在注意力的压缩KV表示，并辅以流形约束超连接、Expert Specific PolyNorm激活和多token预测等技术。模型在约12.5万亿token上预训练，支持256K上下文长度，并通过多教师强化学习蒸馏的后训练管线整合推理、编码、工具使用等综合能力。
AI.motivation: 在语言模型规模持续扩大的背景下，如何在保持计算效率的同时提升模型能力和训练稳定性是关键挑战。研究者希望通过细粒度稀疏MoE架构和新型注意力机制，在不显著增加计算成本的前提下扩展模型容量，并在推理、编码、长上下文等多元任务上达到领先水平。
AI.method: 架构层面：(1) 采用384个路由专家、每token选8个的细粒度稀疏MoE；(2) 提出GDLA注意力，融合分组差分注意力与MLA的压缩KV表示；(3) 引入流形约束超连接和Expert Specific PolyNorm激活；(4) 使用多token预测头。训练层面：在12.5万亿token上预训练，采用专家平衡和数值稳定技术，使用MXFP8计算、融合kernel和窗口感知上下文并行支持256K上下文。后训练：通用SFT + 6个RL训练的专家教师 + 1个SFT软件工程教师 + 多教师在线策略蒸馏。
AI.result: 在广泛的评估套件中，Motif 3在长程智能体任务、数学推理、科学知识和幻觉敏感评估上表现强劲，综合性能与领先开源权重模型具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: Motif 3通过细粒度MoE与新颖的GDLA注意力架构，成功在高效计算条件下实现了大规模模型能力，验证了训练稳定技术和大规模多教师后训练管线的有效性，为构建统一的多能力语言模型提供了可行路径。

title: Recurrent Neural Networks Beyond Time: Learning from Multiple Ordered Projections
summary: Recurrent neural networks (RNNs) are widely used for sequence learning, yet their application is commonly associated with temporal data, although recurrent computation fundamentally operates on ordered sequences rather than on time itself. Building on this observation, we introduce the Ordered Structural Dependency Hypothesis (OSDH), which proposes that multiple admissible orderings of the same observations may reveal complementary structural dependencies inaccessible through a single sequential organization. To operationalize this hypothesis, we propose the Independent Structural Expert Principle (ISEP), whereby projection-specific sequence models are trained independently before their learned representations are integrated through a dedicated fusion model. As a concrete realization, we present Structural Evolution RNNs (SE-RNNs), which employ conventional RNNs as projection-specific structural experts while preserving the underlying recurrent computation unchanged. Proof-of-concept experiments on three synthetic datasets with substantially different levels of structural complexity demonstrate that the proposed architecture consistently benefits from multiple ordered projections when hidden structural dependencies are present, while remaining competitive on simpler datasets. Since OSDH is independent of the underlying sequence-processing model, the proposed framework naturally extends beyond recurrent networks and may be instantiated using alternative architectures. The results suggest a general computational perspective for exploiting complementary ordered representations across diverse structured learning problems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出有序结构依赖假说（OSDH），认为同一观测的多种合法排序能揭示单一序列组织无法捕获的互补结构依赖，并据此提出独立结构专家原则（ISEP）及其实例化——结构进化RNN（SE-RNNs），通过独立训练多个投影特定的序列模型再融合其表示，在合成数据集上验证了多投影在隐藏结构依赖存在时的优势。
AI.motivation: RNN广泛用于序列学习，但通常与时间数据绑定；然而递归计算本质上操作于有序序列而非时间本身。作者观察到这一事实，提出假设：同一观测的多种合法排序可能揭示单一序列组织无法获得的互补结构依赖，从而为结构化学习提供新的计算视角。
AI.method: 提出两个核心概念：(1) 有序结构依赖假说（OSDH）——同一观测的多种合法排序可揭示互补的结构依赖；(2) 独立结构专家原则（ISEP）——投影特定的序列模型独立训练，再通过专门的融合模型整合其学到的表示。以此为基础实现结构进化RNN（SE-RNNs），将传统RNN作为投影特定的结构专家，保持底层递归计算不变。
AI.result: 在三个结构复杂度显著不同的合成数据集上进行概念验证实验，结果表明当存在隐藏结构依赖时，SE-RNNs始终从多有序投影中获益；在更简单的数据集上也能保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: OSDH不依赖于底层序列处理模型，该框架可自然扩展到递归网络之外的多种架构。结果暗示了一种利用互补有序表示来解决多样化结构化学习问题的一般计算视角。

title: MELLON - Multimodal Enhanced LLM for Online Navigation
summary: Web navigation agents are capable of addressing various types of tasks on different websites. Current baselines on web navigation are either unimodal or lack strong reasoning abilities given multimodal inputs. Focusing on the WebShop benchmark, a real-world website simulation, we explore the alignment of text and images, as well as multimodal reasoning and planning abilities, to enhance the performance of web navigation agents. We propose three innovative multimodal enhancements: Multimodal Enhanced LLM for Online Navigation (MELLON), VQAgent, and Multimodal Ranker. MELLON demonstrates a significant improvement in task completion accuracy, with a 9.26% increase after just one epoch of training. Our findings suggest the necessity of further exploration into multimodal approaches, with a focus on more extensive training and alignment strategies to enhance the effectiveness of web navigation agents.

AI.tldr: 本文针对WebShop基准测试，探索了文本与图像的对齐以及多模态推理和规划能力，提出了三种多模态增强方法（MELLON、VQAgent、Multimodal Ranker），其中MELLON仅经过一轮训练即在任务完成准确率上提升了9.26%，表明多模态方法对提升Web导航代理性能具有显著潜力。
AI.motivation: 现有的Web导航代理基线要么是单模态的，要么缺乏针对多模态输入的强大推理能力，限制了其在真实网站模拟环境中的任务完成表现。作者希望弥补这一不足，探索多模态对齐与推理在Web导航任务中的价值。
AI.method: 作者提出了三种多模态增强方案：1) MELLON（面向在线导航的多模态增强LLM），通过多模态输入增强大语言模型的导航决策能力；2) VQAgent，利用视觉-查询机制进行多模态理解；3) Multimodal Ranker，通过多模态排序对候选操作进行打分和选择。所有方法均在WebShop真实网站模拟基准上进行评估。
AI.result: MELLON在仅经过一个epoch的训练后，任务完成准确率显著提升了9.26%，验证了多模态增强在Web导航任务中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果强调了进一步探索多模态方法的必要性，尤其是更充分的训练策略和对齐机制，以进一步提升Web导航代理的效率和鲁棒性。

title: Evaluating Generative Time-Series Models on Data with Point Masses
summary: Many of the series that generative time-series models are benchmarked on place a large probability mass on a single value --- it does not rain, no ride is requested, no part is ordered. We report what happens when such data is evaluated carefully. First, the standard rolling-origin protocol can score a model on a window whose atom structure bears no resemblance to the dataset: on one benchmark the dataset is $42\%$ zeros and the evaluation windows are $13\%$, on another $47\%$ against $5\%$. This is not a cosmetic problem --- it reversed one of our own conclusions, turning the strongest occurrence model in our study into what looked like a cautionary tale. Second, we give a control in which CRPS is invariant \emph{by construction} while the temporal coupling is destroyed, which measures exactly how much that coupling contributes to a chosen statistic. Third, benchmarking seven models on a matched protocol over five seeds, an autoregressive hurdle beats a conditional flow on five of six datasets, by up to a factor of $153$, while the flow's own occurrence statistics vary by up to $62\%$ across training seeds and every baseline is deterministic. Finally, the model ordering is not the same under five different occurrence statistics, and the two that do not share a construction agree with each other least.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了生成式时间序列模型基准测试中"单值高概率"（如零值）数据的评估问题。发现标准滚动原点协议会产生与数据集原子结构严重不匹配的评估窗口，从而误导模型比较结论；提出了CRPS在构造上不变的对照实验来衡量时间耦合的贡献；在匹配协议下对七个模型五个种子的基准测试中，自回归hurdle模型在六个数据集中的五个上以最高153倍的优势胜过条件流模型；不同出现率统计量下模型排序不一致。
AI.motivation: 许多生成式时间序列模型基准数据集中存在大量单值（如零值）概率质量，但现有评估协议未仔细处理这一问题，可能导致模型比较结论被扭曲甚至反转。
AI.method: (1) 揭示标准滚动原点协议中评估窗口与数据集原子（零值）结构的不匹配问题；(2) 设计CRPS在构造上不变的对照实验来隔离时间耦合的贡献；(3) 在匹配协议下对七个模型、五个训练种子、六个数据集进行系统基准测试；(4) 使用五种不同的出现率统计量比较模型排序。
AI.result: 滚动原点协议可将42%零值数据集对应到13%零值的评估窗口（另一例为47%对5%），该问题甚至反转了作者自身的研究结论。在匹配协议下，自回归hurdle模型在六个数据集中的五个上优于条件流模型，优势最高达153倍；条件流模型的出现率统计量在不同训练种子间变化高达62%，而所有基线模型都是确定性的。五个不同出现率统计量下模型排序不一致，且构造不共享的两种统计量之间一致性最低。
AI.conclusion: 生成式时间序列模型的评估必须仔细考虑数据中的单值（如零）结构；标准滚动原点协议在不匹配的窗口上评分会产生误导性结论；模型在不同出现率统计量下的排序不一致，凸显了评估协议和统计量选择的重要性。

title: RISE-RL: Rubric-Informed Selective Exploration for Open-Ended Reinforcement Learning
summary: Aligning Large Language Models (LLMs) for open-ended tasks is challenging because responses must satisfy multidimensional criteria without following a single correct generation trajectory. Existing rubric-based reinforcement learning (RL) methods compress fine-grained criterion-level feedback into scalar rewards, making persistent capability gaps difficult to target under limited on-policy exploration. We propose $\textbf{RISE-RL}$ (Rubric-Informed Selective Exploration), which uses repeatedly missed rubric criteria to elicit privileged trajectories that are difficult to discover through unguided exploration alone. RISE-RL retains only trajectories whose complete-rubric reward exceeds the mean reward of natural rollouts, and then re-evaluates them under the original prompt to emphasize behaviors that remain weakly supported by the natural policy. The resulting guidance signal is optimized through a separate auxiliary objective and removed once its additional benefit diminishes. Experiments with 4B and 14B models across writing, chat, health, and science show that RISE-RL achieves the highest mean score on every evaluated benchmark under guidance-free evaluation. Compared with standard Rubric-RL, it improves the average score by 1.3 points at the 4B scale and $\textbf{3.3 points at the 14B scale}$, including a $\textbf{6.0-point}$ gain on CreativeWriting-V3. It also improves creative-writing diversity and yields gains on objectively scored medical and scientific benchmarks. These results indicate that selective internalization through reward filtering and policy support shaping is effective for open-ended reinforcement learning.

AI.tldr: RISE-RL是一种基于rubric的强化学习方法，通过利用反复错过的rubric标准来引导生成难以通过无引导探索发现的轨迹，并用辅助目标进行优化，在4B和14B规模的模型上，在写作、聊天、健康、科学等开放任务基准上均取得最优平均分。
AI.motivation: 现有基于rubric的强化学习方法将细粒度标准级反馈压缩为标量奖励，导致在有限的在线探索下难以针对持续存在的能力差距进行优化。开放任务要求响应满足多维标准，不能只跟随单一正确的生成轨迹，因此需要更有效的引导信号来发现难以通过无引导探索获得的优质轨迹。
AI.method: RISE-RL提出两个关键机制：(1) 利用反复被错过的rubric标准来引出特权轨迹，仅保留完整rubric奖励超过自然rollout均值的轨迹，并在原始提示下重新评估以强调自然策略中弱支持的行为；(2) 将生成的引导信号通过独立的辅助目标进行优化，当其额外收益消退后移除该信号。
AI.result: 在4B和14B模型上跨越写作、聊天、健康、科学四个领域进行实验，RISE-RL在无引导评估下于所有基准上取得最高平均分。相比标准Rubric-RL，4B规模平均提升1.3分，14B规模提升3.3分（其中CreativeWriting-V3上提升6.0分）。同时提升了创意写作的多样性，并在客观评分的医学和科学基准上取得增益。
AI.conclusion: 通过奖励过滤和策略支持塑形实现的选择性内化对开放任务强化学习是有效的。RISE-RL证明了利用错误rubric标准引导特权轨迹、并通过辅助目标逐步内化后移除引导，是解决开放任务多维标准优化问题的可行范式。

title: PET/CT Radiogenomic Mutation Prediction in Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer Using Multi-Label Learning
summary: Lung cancer remains one of the leading causes of cancer- related mortality worldwide. Although targeted therapies have improved outcomes for patients with non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), they rely on mutation profiling through tissue biopsy, an invasive procedure with several limitations. This study investigates PET/CT-based radio- genomic prediction of epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR), tumour protein 53 (TP53), and Kirsten rat sarcoma viral oncogene (KRAS) mutations using deep learning. We further evaluate whether pairwise multi-label learning improves mutation prediction compared with conventional single-gene classification. To the best of our knowledge, this is among the first studies to systematically investigate multi-label learning for PET/CT radiogenomic mutation prediction in NSCLC. Experiments were conducted on a novel UK-based radiogenomics cohort. Joint pre- diction of KRAS and TP53 improved AUC from 0.58 to 0.64 for KRAS and from 0.69 to 0.71 for TP53. For the EGFR/KRAS pair, only EGFR benefited from joint learning, while no improvement was observed for the EGFR/TP53 pair. These findings demonstrate that the effectiveness of multi-label learning depends on the specific combination of gene mutations being modelled, suggesting that mutation-specific modelling strategies may be preferable for PET/CT radiogenomic prediction.

AI.tldr: 本研究首次系统性地将多标签深度学习应用于PET/CT影像基因组学，用于非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）中EGFR、TP53和KRAS基因突变的无创预测。实验表明多标签联合学习的效果取决于具体基因突变组合，KRAS与TP53的联合预测带来了AUC提升（KRAS 0.58→0.64，TP53 0.69→0.71），但其他组合收益有限或没有改善。
AI.motivation: 肺癌是全球癌症死亡的主要原因之一。虽然靶向治疗改善了NSCLC患者的预后，但目前的基因突变检测依赖于组织活检，这是一种侵入性且具有多种局限性的手段。本研究旨在探索基于PET/CT影像的深度学习放射基因组学方法，实现对关键驱动基因突变（EGFR、TP53、KRAS）的无创预测，并评估多标签学习是否能优于传统的单基因分类。
AI.method: 采用基于PET/CT的放射基因组学方法，利用深度学习模型对NSCLC患者的EGFR、TP53和KRAS基因突变进行预测。研究设计包括两种策略的对比：（1）传统单基因分类；（2）两两配对的多标签联合学习。实验在一个新型英国放射基因组学队列上进行。
AI.result: KRAS和TP53的联合预测使两个基因的AUC均获得提升（KRAS从0.58提高到0.64，TP53从0.69提高到0.71）。对于EGFR/KRAS配对，仅EGFR从联合学习中获益；而EGFR/TP53配对未观察到任何改善。
AI.conclusion: 多标签学习在PET/CT放射基因组学突变预测中的有效性高度依赖于所建模的基因突变组合，并非所有配对都能从联合学习中获益。研究提示，针对具体基因突变量身定制的建模策略可能比统一的联合学习方案更为可取，为放射基因组学的临床转化提供了重要参考。

title: ChronoState: Hidden Elapsed-Time Conditioning for Temporal-State Action Selection in Frozen-Backbone Language Models
comment: Submitted to SPIE Defense and Commercial Sensing 2027
summary: Temporal decisions in language-model systems often depend on both symbolic task state and elapsed wall-clock time, such as cache expiration, job completion, quota resets, deadlines, or stale sessions. We study whether elapsed time can be supplied as a non-token, system-side scalar and composed with visible symbolic state by a frozen-backbone language model. We introduce ChronoState, a compositional temporal-state benchmark in which symbolic state appears in the prompt, elapsed seconds tau are supplied through a hidden chronometric-injection channel, and the model selects a forced-choice temporal action. Here, "hidden" means hidden from the user-visible token sequence, not from model computation. Using Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct as a frozen bf16 backbone with a 31-dimensional sinusoidal-plus-log time encoding, gated FiLM residual modulation, and a rank-8 LoRA action surface, hidden-time CI reaches 0.9305 +/- 0.0134 accuracy and 0.9410 +/- 0.0103 balanced accuracy. No-time and shuffled-time controls fall to 0.5511 +/- 0.0042 and 0.3323 +/- 0.0097, respectively, with high shuffled-time wrong-state consistency supporting causal dependence on the injected scalar within the trained distribution. Generalization remains strong for held-out templates, durations, and multi-constraint compositions, but held-out quota-family transfer is weak at 0.5065 +/- 0.0559, while a fair prompt+LoRA timestamp baseline reaches 0.9893 +/- 0.0052. Thus, ChronoState supports a narrow conclusion: hidden elapsed time can be composed with symbolic task state under direct supervision, but does not establish autonomous time tracking, broad unseen-family abstraction, or superiority over prompt-injected timestamps.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ChronoState基准，研究在冻结骨干语言模型中，能否通过非token的隐藏时间注入通道（chronometric-injection）将经过的墙钟时间作为标量，与可见的符号任务状态进行组合来做出时间决策。在Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct上，隐藏时间通道达到0.9305±0.0134的准确率，显著优于无时间（0.5511）和乱序时间（0.3323）对照组。但方法在未见过的配额族泛化上表现弱（0.5065±0.0559），且不及直接提示+LoRA时间戳基线（0.9893±0.0052），因此结论收窄为：隐藏时间可与符号状态在直接监督下组合，但未建立自主时间追踪或宽泛的未见族抽象能力。
AI.motivation: 语言模型系统中的时间决策通常依赖于符号任务状态与墙钟时间的结合（如缓存过期、任务完成、配额重置、截止日期或过期会话）。然而，现有研究较少探索如何将经过的时间作为非token的系统侧标量注入模型，并与可见的符号状态进行组合。作者希望验证冻结骨干语言模型是否能够利用这种隐藏时间通道进行时间感知决策。
AI.method: 提出ChronoState组合时间状态基准：符号状态显式出现在提示中，经过的秒数tau通过隐藏的计时注入通道（对用户不可见但可用于模型计算）提供。模型使用Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct作为冻结bf16骨干，采用31维正弦加对数时间编码、门控FiLM残差调制和秩8 LoRA行动面作为ci（chronometric-injection）方法。设置无时间和乱序时间对照组，并与提示+LoRA时间戳基线进行比较。
AI.result: 隐藏时间CI达到0.9305±0.0134准确率和0.9410±0.0103平衡准确率；无时间控制组降至0.5511±0.0042，乱序时间控制组降至0.3323±0.0097（乱序组的高错误状态一致性支持对注入标量的因果依赖）。在模板、持续时间和多约束组合上泛化良好，但未见配额族转移仅为0.5065±0.0559，提示+LoRA时间戳基线达到0.9893±0.0052。
AI.conclusion: ChronoState支持一个窄结论：隐藏经过时间可以在直接监督下与符号任务状态组合，但该方法未建立自主时间跟踪能力，无法实现广泛的未见族抽象，且在性能上不优于提示注入时间戳。

title: Rethinking Factor Sharing in Federated LoRA: A Rank-Aware Adaptive Approach
summary: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) represents large language model (LLM) updates with two compact matrix factors, i.e., $A$ and $B$, providing an efficient way to fine-tune large models in federated learning paradigm. Inspired by the asymmetric roles of the LoRA factors, we study whether $A$ should be shared across clients while $B$ remains client-specific (Share-A/Local-B), or whether $B$ should instead be shared while $A$ remains client-specific (Share-B/Local-A). With a least-squares surrogate, we reveal that Share-A/Local-B requires the client-specific LoRA update matrices to use a common rank-$r$ input-side space, whereas Share-B/Local-A requires a common rank-$r$ output-side space. The two strategies therefore incur different projection residuals, indicating that the preferred strategy is the one with the smaller aggregate residual across clients. With this insight, we propose Federated Adaptive Factor Sharing Low-Rank Adaptation (FedAS-LoRA), which selects the sharing side before training to enhance fine-tuning performance. To enable adaptive factor selection before training, we design a Rank-Aware Shared-Subspace Sufficiency (RSS) metric, which effectively assesses whether a shared rank-$r$ input subspace is sufficient for the local data distributions using representations extracted from a frozen LLM backbone. Experiments across different tasks, data distributions, LoRA ranks, and participation settings confirm the effectiveness of RSS and the superior performance of FedAS-LoRA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FedAS-LoRA，一种在联邦学习中自适应选择LoRA因子共享方向的微调方法。通过最小二乘代理分析，揭示Share-A/Local-B与Share-B/Local-A两种策略分别需要共享输入侧或输出侧秩-r子空间，并基于此设计Rank-Aware Shared-Subspace Sufficiency (RSS)指标在训练前评估共享子空间的充分性，从而自适应选择更优的共享方向以提升联邦微调性能。
AI.motivation: LoRA因子A和B在联邦学习微调中扮演着不对称的角色，但目前缺乏对"共享哪个因子"这个问题的理论分析与系统性研究。理解两种共享策略的本质差异（即需要公共的输入侧还是输出侧秩-r子空间），并据此自适应选择更优策略，是提升联邦LoRA微调性能的关键动机。
AI.method: 首先通过最小二乘代理分析揭示两种共享策略的数学本质：Share-A/Local-B要求客户端本地更新矩阵共享公共的输入侧秩-r子空间，Share-B/Local-A则要求共享公共的输出侧秩-r子空间，两种策略产生不同的投影残差。基于此，提出RSS指标，利用冻结的LLM骨干网络提取的特征，在训练前评估共享秩-r输入子空间对本地数据分布的充分性，从而自适应决策选择哪个因子共享。最终形成FedAS-LoRA框架，在训练前选定共享方向后执行联邦微调。
AI.result: 在多种任务、数据分布、LoRA秩和参与设置下的实验表明，RSS指标能有效指导因子共享方向的选取，FedAS-LoRA相比固定共享策略的基线方法取得了更优的微调性能，验证了理论分析的正确性和RSS指标的有效性。
AI.conclusion: LoRA因子共享方向的选择对联邦学习微调性能有显著影响，最优策略取决于投影残差更小的一方。通过RSS指标在训练前预判共享方向的充分性，FedAS-LoRA实现了对共享策略的自适应选择，为联邦场景下的参数高效微调提供了新的理论视角与实用方案。

title: TRACE: TRajectory Attribution for Automated Context Engineering
summary:
Production AI agents fail when their context sources -- system prompts, knowledge bases, tool descriptions, and procedural skills -- contain errors or gaps. Current maintenance relies on manual log review and ad-hoc debugging, creating a scalability bottleneck as interaction volume grows.
  We present TRACE (TRajectory Attribution for Automated Context Engineering), an automated feedback loop that mines historical agent trajectories to diagnose and remediate context failures. Our key insight is that trajectories are rich with implicit dissatisfaction signals -- user corrections, rephrasing, abandonment cues -- that reveal precisely where context sources failed, without explicit feedback collection. Unlike model fine-tuning, TRACE operates on the context layer, enabling rapid iteration without retraining.
  We make four contributions: (1) a trajectory mining framework that systematically extracts diagnostic information from historical agent executions; (2) multi-component causal attribution that extends textual gradients from monolithic prompt optimization to heterogeneous context sources (skills, knowledge bases, tools, prompts); (3) exploratory verification, where agents actively read context sources to distinguish content gaps requiring CREATE from stale content requiring UPDATE, achieving 96% operation accuracy; and (4) a reusable simulation methodology and verifiable benchmark addressing the absence of open datasets for context debugging, with a six-category fault taxonomy, ground truth annotations, and a cross-layer verification protocol.
  On 60 dissatisfaction traces spanning three complexity tiers (up to 16 execution nodes), TRACE achieves 72.7% root cause attribution and 82% end-to-end fix effectiveness, showing that over 80% of context-layer failures can be automatically diagnosed and remediated by mining historical trajectories, an overlooked resource in production systems.

AI.tldr: TRACE是一个自动化反馈循环系统，通过挖掘历史代理轨迹中的隐性不满信号（如用户纠正、重述、放弃行为）来诊断和修复生产AI代理的上下文层故障，在60条不满轨迹上达到72.7%的根因归因和82%的端到端修复有效性。
AI.motivation: 生产AI代理常因上下文源（系统提示、知识库、工具描述、程序技能）中的错误或缺口而失败，但当前维护依赖手动日志审查和临时调试，随着交互量增长形成可扩展性瓶颈，缺乏自动化的上下文故障诊断与修复方案。
AI.method: TRACE包含四个核心贡献：(1)轨迹挖掘框架，系统化提取历史代理执行中的诊断信息；(2)多组件因果归因，将文本梯度从单一提示优化扩展到异构上下文源（技能、知识库、工具、提示词）；(3)探索性验证，通过代理主动阅读上下文源区分内容缺口（需CREATE）与过时内容（需UPDATE），实现96%的操作准确率；(4)可复用的模拟方法和可验证基准，包含六类故障分类学、ground truth标注和跨层验证协议。
AI.result: 在60条跨越三个复杂度层级（最多16个执行节点）的不满轨迹上，TRACE实现72.7%的根因归因准确率和82%的端到端修复有效性，表明超过80%的上下文层故障可以通过挖掘历史轨迹自动诊断和修复。
AI.conclusion: TRACE证明历史轨迹是生产系统中被忽视的宝贵资源，通过自动挖掘不满信号可以在上下文层实现无需重训练的快速迭代修复，优于传统需要重训练模型的微调方法，为解决生产AI代理的上下文工程问题提供了系统化方案。

title: CIDER: A Dataset of Contextual Disclosure Boundaries for Privacy Preference Alignment
summary: Aligning large language models (LLMs) with human privacy preferences requires capturing individuals' disclosure boundaries beyond general privacy norms. However, a gap remains in eliciting such nuanced preferences to evaluate alignment in realistic settings. We introduce CIDER, a dataset of 14,850 human annotations from 169 users, forming 1,650 contextual disclosure boundary sets across 60 interpersonal communication scenarios involving information sharing that violates privacy norms. Each boundary represents a real user's disclosure decisions over 9 sharing variants in a scenario, for a given communication role and AI-mediated condition. We formulate a task in which models predict a user's disclosure decision from historical boundaries, with varying levels of contextual information. Across 12 open and proprietary models, in-context personalization improves prediction accuracy by up to 11.41 percentage points using only 6 historical examples. Larger models such as GPT-5.4 (with medium reasoning effort) and Claude Sonnet 4.6 are better at leveraging semantic context to understand user-specific, context-dependent disclosure preferences for more accurate predictions, while smaller models tend to rely on structured heuristics based on disclosure granularity and identifiability. Personalization generally improves prediction accuracy, but the improvement is often accompanied by imbalanced shifts in false-positive and false-negative rates across models, with only Claude Sonnet 4.6 achieving balanced improvements in both. Our findings reveal both the promise and limitations of inference-time personalization for privacy preference modeling and position CIDER as a resource for advancing personalized privacy alignment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了CIDER数据集，包含14,850条来自169位用户的人工标注，构成60个情境下1,650个上下文相关的隐私披露边界集。研究发现基于上下文的个性化提示能将隐私偏好预测准确率提升最多11.41个百分点，但不同模型在误报率和漏报率上存在不均衡的权衡，仅Claude Sonnet 4.6实现了均衡改善。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM与人类隐私偏好对齐研究主要基于一般性隐私规范，缺乏对个体具体披露边界的细粒度捕捉。作者希望填补这一空白，在真实场景中评估模型的个性化隐私对齐能力。
AI.method: 构建CIDER数据集，包含1,650个上下文披露边界集（每个边界集包含9种共享变体的披露决策），覆盖60个人际沟通场景。设定预测任务：模型基于用户的历史披露边界，在不同上下文信息条件下预测新的披露决策。对12个开源和专有模型进行系统性评估，对比不同模型规模在利用语义上下文与结构化启发式上的差异。
AI.result: 基于上下文的个性化在仅使用6个历史示例的情况下可将预测准确率提升最多11.41个百分点。大型模型（如GPT-5.4和Claude Sonnet 4.6）更擅长利用语义上下文理解用户特定的、情境依赖的披露偏好；而较小的模型倾向于依赖基于披露粒度和可识别性的结构化启发式。个性化普遍提升准确率，但大多伴随假阳性和假阴性率的失衡变化，仅Claude Sonnet 4.6实现了两者的均衡改善。
AI.conclusion: 推理时个性化在隐私偏好建模上既展现出潜力也存在局限。CIDER可作为推进个性化隐私对齐研究的重要基准资源，未来需要关注个性化带来的误差均衡性问题。

title: MoNo: Multiscale Optimal Transport Neural Operator for Solving PDEs on General Geometries
summary: Transformer-based neural operators have achieved substantial progress in solving Partial Differential Equations (PDEs) by projecting spatial observations into compact latent tokens and learning physical interactions in latent spaces. However, we reveal that existing learnable projection mechanisms cannot ensure stable and balanced assignments from observation points to latent tokens, causing some latent tokens to be over-assigned while others remain underutilized. This limitation further restricts the design of hierarchical architectures, as assignment imbalance is continuously inherited and amplified across latent spaces, eventually causing severe token collapse in deeper spaces. To address these issues, we propose MoNo (Multiscale Optimal Transport Neural Operator), a progressive multiscale neural operator that efficiently solves PDEs on general geometries through stable latent-space construction. At its core is CoTAP (Cross-scale Optimal Transport Assignment and Projection), a novel latent-space construction method that formulates cross-space assignment between adjacent spaces as an entropy-regularized optimal transport problem, thereby constructing balanced bidirectional projections and stable latent spaces. CoTAP also ensures stable information transfer across multiple latent spaces, further enabling multiscale architectures on general geometries, which in turn support more efficient learning of long-range physical interactions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MoNo outperforms existing state-of-the-art neural operators in both prediction performance and computational efficiency. Code is available at https://github.com/ZijiangY1116/MoNo.

AI.tldr: MoNo是一种基于多尺度最优传输的神经算子，通过CoTAP机制实现稳定的潜空间构建，高效求解一般几何上的PDE，在预测性能和计算效率上均超越现有最先进方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于Transformer的神经算子在将观测点投影到潜token时，可学习的投影机制无法保证稳定且均衡的分配，导致部分token过度分配而另一些未被充分利用；这种不均衡在多尺度层级结构中会被持续继承和放大，最终导致深层空间出现严重的token坍塌，限制了层次架构的设计。
AI.method: 提出MoNo（多尺度最优传输神经算子），核心是CoTAP（跨尺度最优传输分配与投影）机制。CoTAP将相邻潜空间之间的跨尺度分配形式化为带熵正则的最优传输问题，从而构建均衡的双向投影和稳定的潜空间；同时确保跨多个潜空间的稳定信息传递，支持一般几何上的多尺度架构，进而高效学习长程物理相互作用。
AI.result: 大量实验表明MoNo在预测性能和计算效率两方面均优于现有最先进的神经算子方法。
AI.conclusion: MoNo通过最优传输理论解决了现有神经算子潜空间构建中的token分配不均衡与坍塌问题，在一般几何上实现了稳定高效的多尺度PDE求解，代码已开源。

title: From Relevance to Execution Utility: Reward-Aware Dynamic Execution Gating for Skill-Based LLM Agents
summary: Agent skills are increasingly used to equip large language model (LLM) agents with reusable procedural knowledge. Although recent work has substantially improved skill retrieval due to the increasing skill libraries, retrieving a plausible skill bundle does not guarantee that executing it is worthwhile. Since every skill-conditioned rollout is computationally expensive, deciding whether a retrieved bundle should be executed has become an increasingly important challenge. To this end, we introduce the Reward-Aware Dynamic Execution Gate (RADEG), a lightweight, retriever-agnostic decision layer between skill retrieval and agent execution. RADEG learns a low-cost surrogate model that predicts the execution utility of a query--bundle pair before the expensive rollout is launched. To obtain informative supervision while controlling for task difficulty, we locally perturb each retrieved bundle by deleting, adding, or replacing one skill, producing matched same-query rollouts that isolate the effect of bundle composition on verifier reward. During deployment, RADEG updates only a warm-started logistic head as new verifier feedback becomes available, enabling inexpensive adaptation of the execute/skip boundary without retraining either the retriever or the agent. Under a query-level held-out evaluation on 288 collected rollouts, RADEG substantially reduces unnecessary agent executions while preserving a large fraction of the downstream verifier reward. It consistently outperforms relevance-based and random gating across different execution budgets, demonstrating that execution-aware surrogate modeling provides a practical and cost-effective complement to skill retrieval.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RADEG（Reward-Aware Dynamic Execution Gate），一个轻量级的、与检索器无关的决策层，位于技能检索和智能体执行之间。RADEG通过训练低成本代理模型预测查询-技能包对的执行效用，在昂贵rollout启动前决定是否执行，从而大幅减少不必要的智能体执行次数，同时保留大部分下游验证器奖励。
AI.motivation: 随着技能库规模增大，技能检索性能虽有提升，但检索到合理的技能束并不保证执行它是有价值的。由于每次技能条件化的rollout计算成本高昂，如何决定检索到的技能束是否值得执行成为一个关键挑战。
AI.method: RADEG包含三个关键组件：（1）训练一个低成本代理模型预测查询-技能束对的执行效用；（2）通过对检索到的技能束进行局部扰动（删除、添加或替换一个技能），生成了匹配的同查询rollout对，隔离技能束组成对验证器奖励的影响，从而获得信息丰富的监督信号；（3）部署时仅更新一个热启动的逻辑回归头，利用新的验证器反馈进行低成本自适应调整，无需重新训练检索器或智能体。
AI.result: 在288个收集的rollout的查询级留出集评估中，RADEG大幅减少了不必要的智能体执行次数，同时保留了大部分的验证器奖励。在不同执行预算下，RADEG持续优于基于相关性的门控和随机门控策略。
AI.conclusion: 执行感知的代理建模为技能检索提供了实用且具成本效益的补充方案，验证了在执行前进行效用预测的价值。

title: ReliableNet: A Chance-Constrained Approach to Trustworthy Classification in Deep Learning
summary: A prediction that is both confident and wrong is a critical reliability failure because it can bypass abstention and human review precisely when the model is mistaken. Empirical risk minimization (ERM) controls average loss but not this failure directly, while calibration, uncertainty estimation, conformal risk control, and selective prediction methods target related reliability properties rather than bounding the joint failure event during training. We propose ReliableNet, which constrains the Joint Confident-Wrong (JCW) probability, the probability that a prediction is simultaneously confident and incorrect, below a user-specified risk budget $α\in(0,1)$. We formulate this as a chance-constrained ERM problem, use a conservative smooth inner approximation whose population feasibility implies the original JCW constraint. Across four tabular and two image datasets, ReliableNet is the only method certified within the JCW budget for every dataset and seed in distribution, when compared against baselines spanning ERM, post-hoc calibration, conformal risk control, and selective prediction. Under demographic, ambiguity, spurious-correlation, novel-class, and covariate shifts, it achieves the lowest empirical JCW among the compared methods while remaining very competitive in accuracy, coverage, calibration, and selective prediction. Risk-coverage results further indicate that ReliableNet achieves better selective ranking than the benchmark methods on most datasets. Overall, ReliableNet provides a principled approach to trustworthy classification.

AI.tldr: 提出ReliableNet，通过机会约束ERM将联合"自信且错误"（JCW）概率约束在用户指定的风险预算α之下，在所有测试数据集上成为唯一被认证满足JCW预算的方法，并在多种分布偏移下取得最低的经验JCW。
AI.motivation: 一个既自信又错误的预测是关键可靠性失效——当模型出错时，它恰好能绕过弃权和人工审查。经验风险最小化（ERM）只控制平均损失，而校准、不确定性估计、共形风险控制和选择性预测等方法针对的是相关可靠性属性，而非在训练中直接约束这一联合失效事件。
AI.method: 将JCW概率约束建模为机会约束ERM问题，采用保守光滑内逼近，其总体可行性蕴含原始JCW约束，从而在训练过程中显式约束"自信且错误"的联合事件概率。
AI.result: 在四个表格和两个图像数据集上，与ERM、事后校准、共形风险控制和选择性预测等基线相比，ReliableNet是唯一在所有数据集和随机种子下都在分布内被认证满足JCW预算的方法。在人口统计、模糊性、虚假相关、新类别和协变量偏移下，它取得最低的经验JCW，同时在准确性、覆盖率、校准和选择性预测方面保持很强的竞争力。风险覆盖结果显示在大多数数据集上具有更好的选择性排序。
AI.conclusion: ReliableNet为可信分类提供了一种原则性的方法，能直接在训练中约束联合"自信且错误"概率，兼顾可靠性保障与性能竞争力。

title: Agentic Router: An Execution-Grounded Continual Learning Approach With Memory
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents provide a promising interface for command-line-based network operations, but a plausible command may still fail or introduce operational risk after execution. Existing approaches mainly focus on command generation or final configuration correctness, and do not use execution-grounded experience to jointly improve candidate coverage and action selection. We propose an execution-grounded dual-path consequence-aware agent for CLI-based SONiC operations, which generates multiple complete actions, predicts their execution consequences, and selects the final action through utility- and risk-aware reranking. The proposal-side path abstracts reusable operational lessons into retrievable guidance to improve feasible-action coverage without modifying the proposal LLM, while the selection-side path adapts the consequence predictor through session-level LoRA updates using real SSH feedback to improve conditional selection quality. Experiments over multi-turn SONiC operation sessions with different Qwen3 proposal models show that the framework improves feasible-action coverage and top-1 execution success, and that the two adaptation paths provide complementary gains over interaction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于执行反馈的双路径后果感知智能体框架（Execution-Grounded Dual-Path Consequence-Aware Agent），用于命令行SONiC网络操作。该框架生成多个完整动作，预测其执行后果，并通过效用与风险感知的重新排序选择最终动作。提案侧路径抽象可复用的操作经验为可检索的指导，提升可行动作覆盖率；选择侧路径通过会话级LoRA更新利用真实SSH反馈适应后果预测器。实验表明该框架提升了可行动作覆盖率和top-1执行成功率，两条适应路径在交互中提供互补增益。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体在命令行网络操作中，合理的命令仍可能失败或引入运营风险。已有方法主要关注命令生成或最终配置正确性，未利用执行后的真实经验来联合改进候选动作覆盖率和动作选择质量，缺乏执行反馈闭环。
AI.method: 提出一个双路径后果感知智能体框架：1）提案侧（Proposal-side）路径：将可复用的操作经验抽象成可检索的指导（retrievable guidance），在不修改提案LLM的前提下提升可行动作覆盖率；2）选择侧（Selection-side）路径：利用真实SSH执行反馈，通过会话级LoRA（Session-level LoRA）更新后果预测器，提升条件选择质量；最终通过效用与风险感知的重新排序（utility- and risk-aware reranking）从多个生成动作中选出最终动作。
AI.result: 在基于不同Qwen3提案模型的多轮SONiC操作会话实验中，该框架显著提升了可行动作覆盖率（feasible-action coverage）和top-1执行成功率（top-1 execution success）。两条适应路径（提案侧经验抽象与选择侧LoRA更新）在交互过程中提供了互补的性能增益。
AI.conclusion: 执行反馈驱动的双路径适应机制能有效提升LLM智能体在CLI网络操作中的可靠性和安全性，通过提案侧经验复用与选择侧模型适应相结合的方式，在不修改主干提案模型的前提下实现了更好的候选覆盖与动作选择性能。

title: Parameter Exploration for RLVR via Variational Learning
summary: Exploration has been a focus of reinforcement learning research for a long time. Recently, there has been growing evidence that it is also an important ingredient in LLM reinforcement learning recipes that can significantly impact downstream performance. Many existing methods control exploration in the action-space, for example, using temperature scaling. However, these methods cannot reorder tokens but only influence the variance in the output distribution. This limits exploration and can lead to divergence or stalled training. Here, we investigate parameter-space exploration, where rollouts are generated by sampling different policies from a posterior that may each explore different rollouts. Sampling less or more diverse policies is then a complementary control lever over exploration. We introduce a family of methods called Perturbed Parameter Policy Optimization (3PO) which use different sampling strategies and different rollout grouping for reward estimation. Experiments on OLMo-3-1025-7B and Qwen2.5-Math-7B across mathematical reasoning and code generation tasks show that these approaches consistently improve average downstream performance over standard GRPO at a near-identical FLOPs cost. Moreover, using multiple parameter samples consistently produces fewer zero-advantage groups and malformed or incorrect rollouts during training than GRPO and action-space baselines. Overall, our work presents evidence that parameter-space exploration can improve reinforcement learning for LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为扰动参数策略优化（3PO）的方法族，通过在参数空间中采样不同策略生成rollouts来实现探索，从而改进大语言模型的强化学习。实验表明，与标准GRPO相比，3PO在数学推理和代码生成任务上以近乎相同的FLOPs成本持续提升下游性能，并产生更少的零优势组和畸形输出。
AI.motivation: LLM强化学习中的探索对下游性能影响显著，现有方法主要控制动作空间（如温度缩放）的探索，但这些方法无法重新排序token，只能影响输出分布的方差，限制了探索能力并可能导致训练发散或停滞。因此需要探索新的探索机制。
AI.method: 提出参数空间探索方法族3PO（Perturbed Parameter Policy Optimization），核心思想是从后验中采样不同策略来生成rollouts，每种策略可能探索不同的轨迹。通过不同的采样策略和不同的rollout分组方式来进行奖励估计，从而实现多样化的探索控制。
AI.result: 在OLMo-3-1025-7B和Qwen2.5-Math-7B上的数学推理和代码生成任务中，3PO系列方法在近相同FLOPs成本下持续优于标准GRPO的平均下游性能；使用多个参数样本时，训练中产生的零优势组、畸形或错误rollouts显著少于GRPO和动作空间基线。
AI.conclusion: 参数空间探索可以有效改进LLM的强化学习，提供了一种与动作空间探索互补的控制杠杆，为LLM RL的训练稳定性和下游性能提升提供了新方向。

title: Structure-Preserving Uncertainty Propagation in First-Order Proof Search
comment: 79 pages, 6 figures. Executable binaries, documentation, examples, and public samplers: https://github.com/tammet/gkreasoner
summary:
GK is a query-directed first-order prover that extends ordinary resolution-based proof search with explicit positive and negative claims, numerical confidence values, and prioritized default rules with exceptions. It works directly with non-ground clauses, including equality and function terms. Candidate proofs are found by bounded first-order proof search; exception conditions of defaults are checked by further bounded searches, recursively when exceptions themselves depend on defaults. This avoids requiring a finite global grounding, while allowing incomplete searches to be reported as such.
  This paper adds structure-preserving quantitative reporting to that framework. Retained proof histories are used in two calculations. The first reconstructs the uncertain ground premises used by each proof and computes the probability that at least one retained proof is available, without counting shared premises independently. The second resolves positive and negative support at intermediate atoms before that support is propagated through later rules; the same calculation evaluates uncertain exception conditions for individual rule applications. Reports separate positive support, negative support, conflict, and ignorance and identify detected incomplete calculations or fallbacks. The implementation performs bounded reconstruction and dependency traversal after proof search and still requires no global grounding. Analytic examples and independent simulators reproduce the reference calculations on their stated fragments. Comparisons with probabilistic logic, probabilistic ASP, default logic, and goal-directed ASP identify cases of agreement, semantic difference, unsupported translation, and incomplete computation.

AI.tldr: 本文为查询导向的一阶定理证明器GK添加了结构保持的定量报告能力。通过在证明搜索后利用保留的证明历史进行两种计算：一是重建不确定性地面前提并计算至少一个保留证明可用的概率（避免重复计共享前提）；二是在中间原子处解析正负支持，并评估不确定异常条件。实现无需全局基化，报告区分正支持、负支持、冲突和无知。
AI.motivation: GK证明器扩展了基于解析的证明搜索，支持显式正负声明、数值置信度和带异常的优先默认规则，但缺乏对证明结果的定量结构保持报告。现有概率逻辑、概率ASP、默认逻辑等方法与GK在语义上存在差异，需要一种不依赖全局基化即可评估证明可用性和不确定异常条件的报告机制。
AI.method: 利用保留的证明历史进行两种计算：(1) 重建每个证明使用的不确定地面前提，计算至少一个保留证明可用的概率，共享前提不被重复计数；(2) 在中间原子处解析正负支持后再传播至后续规则，同时评估不确定异常条件的规则应用。证明搜索后进行有界重建和依赖遍历，无需全局基化。
AI.result: 实现完成了证明搜索后的有界重建和依赖遍历，不要求全局基化。分析示例和独立模拟器在指定片段上复现了参考计算。与概率逻辑、概率ASP、默认逻辑和目标导向ASP的比较识别出一致、语义差异、不支持的翻译和不完整计算等不同情况。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在保持GK结构特性的前提下实现了定量报告能力，区分正支持、负支持、冲突和无知，并能识别不完整计算或回退情况，为不确定性推理提供了更透明的证明报告机制。

title: Macaron-V1: Towards Open Continual Learning with Self-Improvement and Mixture-of-LoRA
summary: Macaron-V1 is an open agent-model family for experiential intelligence: learning from experience in real environments and continuing to learn after deployment. It is organized around two system goals. Adaptation is pursued through recursive improvement of versioned model-harness pairs, where experience from one configuration is evaluated under an external contract and used to construct its successor. Collaboration is pursued via the Mixture-of-LoRA (MoL) architecture that freezes a base model, composes specialist LoRA adapters, and selects one LoRA per user turn. The flagship Macaron-V1-Venti combines a 744B GLM-5.2 base with four LoRAs for chat, agent, coding, and GenUI; the Qwen3.6-based Macaron-V1-Tall (50B) uses the same design for local deployment. This report presents Macaron-V1 as a co-designed system spanning architecture, algorithms, and infrastructure. The MoL architecture supports continual learning through extensible LoRA specialists. The algorithm combines Model-Harness Co-design and recursive self-improvement loop, including the UI4A component-native GenUI harness, a stateful action substrate, versioned HCP contract, and the agentic RL framework MindForge. The supporting infrastructure includes the post-training platform MinT, the long-context RL method LongStraw, and stability techniques for sparse MoE and DSA base models. We evaluate Macaron-V1 on Personal Intelligence, GenUI, and general capability benchmarks against frontier baselines. Our results validate the current system, while compounding gains from continual learning and collective intelligence remain open questions.

AI.tldr: Macaron-V1是一个面向"体验智能"的开源智能体模型家族，通过递归自我改进和Mixture-of-LoRA（MoL）架构实现持续学习和协作。旗舰模型Macaron-V1-Venti采用744B GLM-5.2基座模型搭配四个LoRA适配器（对话、智能体、编程、GenUI），而Macaron-V1-Tall（50B）基于Qwen3.6用于本地部署。系统覆盖架构、算法和基础设施三层协同设计。
AI.motivation: 现有模型主要在静态数据上训练，缺乏从真实环境体验中持续学习的能力。论文旨在构建一个能在部署后继续学习、从真实环境经验中获取智能的智能体模型家族，同时解决适应（递归改进）与协作（多专家组合）两大系统目标。
AI.method: 方法围绕两个核心系统目标展开：（1）适应：通过递归改进版本化的模型-测试平台对（model-harness pairs），在外部契约（HCP）下评估经验并构建后继者；采用Model-Harness Co-design和递归自我改进循环，包含UI4A组件原生GenUI测试平台、有状态动作基板、版本化HCP契约以及MindForge智能体RL框架。（2）协作：Mixture-of-LoRA（MoL）架构冻结基座模型，组合多个专家LoRA适配器，每个用户回合选择一个LoRA。基础设施包括MinT后训练平台、LongStraw长上下文RL方法，以及稀疏MoE和DSA基座模型的稳定性技术。
AI.result: 在Personal Intelligence、GenUI和通用能力基准上与前沿基线进行了评估，验证了当前系统的有效性。但持续学习和集体智能带来的复利式收益仍是开放问题。
AI.conclusion: Macaron-V1验证了通过MoL架构支持持续学习、通过模型-测试平台协同设计实现递归自我改进的系统可行性。持续学习和集体智能的复合增益有待进一步探索。

title: Signature-Guided Capacity Occupancy for Dense Expert Merging
summary: Dense expert merging combines domain-specialized language models into one single checkpoint, typically by admitting task-vector support in weight space. However, this admission is governed by three decisions that existing methods answer only partially: where to open layer capacity from cross-expert conflict, who should occupy that capacity based on domain demand, and how to admit the resulting support without relying on costly recipe search. To tackle these issues, we propose SigMerge (Signature-Guided Capacity Occupancy), a structured capacity assignment framework for dense expert merging. Starting from a dense base merge, conflict signatures set each layer's capacity from cross-expert conflict, positive base-merge deficits set each domain's share of that capacity, and a sequential occupancy rule admits each expert delta up to the resulting layer-domain budget. Across 21 paired settings spanning seven dense base merges and three model pools, SigMerge improves every one (by 15.0% on average) and achieves the best average rank (1.67) among six merging methods, outperforming three categories of merging baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出SigMerge框架，通过冲突签名确定层容量、正基础合并赤字确定领域分配、以及顺序占用规则将专家增量合并到单检查点，在21个配对设置中平均提升15.0%，平均排名1.67，优于其他六种合并方法。
AI.motivation: 稠密专家合并需要将多个领域特化的语言模型合并为单一检查点，但现有方法对三个关键决策只提供部分解答：在何处打开层容量以解决跨专家冲突、由谁基于领域需求占用该容量、以及如何在不依赖昂贵的配方搜索的情况下接纳支持。这些问题导致合并质量受限。
AI.method: SigMerge（签名引导的容量占用）框架包含三个核心环节：1) 冲突签名（conflict signatures）根据跨专家冲突确定每一层的容量；2) 正基础合并赤字（positive base-merge deficits）确定每个领域在容量中的份额；3) 顺序占用规则（sequential occupancy rule）在层-领域预算约束下依次接纳每个专家增量。整个过程从稠密基础合并出发，实现结构化容量分配。
AI.result: 在跨越七个稠密基础合并和三个模型池的21个配对设置中，SigMerge在每一项设置中均实现改进，平均提升15.0%，平均排名1.67，优于包含三个类别的六种合并基线方法。
AI.conclusion: SigMerge通过显式建模冲突、领域需求与容量分配三个维度的交互，提供了一种无需配方搜索的结构化稠密专家合并方案，并展示了在所有测试设置中的一致有效性。

title: Distill Skills into Weights, Not Prompts: Abstract Skills as Privileged Signals for On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards yields no group-relative signal when rollout groups are uniformly correct or uniformly wrong, which account for 63.0-68.0% of groups in our experiments. We propose SKALD (Skill-Anchored Latent Distillation), an on-policy self-distillation framework that uses two context views of the same Qwen3-Base model: a question-only student and a teacher conditioned on an abstract, explicit-answer-filtered skill card. The student is trained on its own prefixes, transferring the skill-induced advantage into shared parameters without privileged input at test time. To stabilize context-induced distribution mismatch, SKALD employs an annealed exponentially tilted objective that downweights teacher-preferred tokens with very low student likelihood; as the tilt vanishes, it converges to teacher cross-entropy and recovers the forward-KL student gradient. An empirical gate activates distillation only when verified rollouts estimate a positive teacher advantage. Across five held-out mathematics benchmarks, SKALD improves overall avg@8 over GRPO by +2.46, +4.85, and +12.01 at 0.6B, 1.7B, and 4B, respectively. At 1.7B, zero-variance-only distillation recovers 84.7% of the full gain, while SKALD remains +4.06 above FLOP-matched GRPO and exceeds contextual skill exposure by +3.77. These results show that abstract skills provide dense supervision where group-relative rewards become uninformative.

AI.tldr: SKALD是一种基于技能锚定潜在蒸馏的on-policy自蒸馏框架，通过问题仅学生模型与技能条件教师模型的上下文对齐，在群组相对奖励无信息（63-68%的rollout组全部正确或全部错误）时提供密集监督信号，在0.6B/1.7B/4B规模下分别较GRPO在avg@8上提升+2.46/+4.85/+12.01。
AI.motivation: 可验证奖励的强化学习在rollout组内样本全部正确或全部错误时，群组相对信号为零，即出现'零方差'问题。据统计，这类群组占实验数据的63.0%-68.0%，导致传统GRPO训练信号大量失效，需要新的监督来源。
AI.method: SKALD采用同一Qwen3-Base模型的两个上下文视图：仅包含问题的学生模型，以及以抽象技能卡片（经显式答案过滤）为条件的教师模型。学生在其自身prefix上训练以将技能带来的优势迁移到共享参数中，测试时无需特权输入。为稳定上下文引起的分布失配，采用退火指数倾斜目标，对极低学生似然的教师偏好token降低权重；倾斜消失时收敛为教师交叉熵并恢复前向KL学生梯度。经验门控仅在验证rollout估计出正向教师优势时激活蒸馏。
AI.result: 在五个数学基准上，SKALD较GRPO在avg@8上分别提升+2.46（0.6B）、+4.85（1.7B）和+12.01（4B）。1.7B规模下，零方差组仅蒸馏即可恢复完整增益的84.7%；SKALD比FLOP匹配的GRPO高+4.06，比上下文技能曝光方法高+3.77。
AI.conclusion: 抽象技能卡能够提供密集监督信号，弥补群组相对奖励在零方差场景下的信息缺失，是一种有效的补充训练策略，且计算效率匹配GRPO。

title: CRUISE: Vision-Language Model-Guided Uncertainty-Aware Cross-Modal Sensor Fusion for Robust Autonomous Driving
summary: Modern autonomous vehicles are equipped with multiple sensors, such as cameras, LiDAR, and radar, for comprehensive environmental perception. However, robust cross-modal feature fusion remains a critical challenge, as the reliability of each sensor varies significantly across diverse real-world driving conditions, including poor visibility and adverse weather. While uncertainty quantification (UQ) mitigates this issue by allowing models to prioritize reliable signals, existing uncertainty-aware fusion methods typically rely on simple feature-level uncertainty estimates and thus often fail to generalize effectively in complex, out-of-distribution scenarios. To address this limitation, we propose CRUISE, a novel uncertainty-aware cross-modal sensor fusion framework. CRUISE integrates a vision-language model (VLM)-guided UQ module that generates fine-grained, pixel-level uncertainty estimates. By leveraging the VLM's rich prior knowledge and superior contextual reasoning, our approach provides a highly informative guide for the fusion process. Furthermore, we introduce a dynamic adaptive mechanism that explicitly models and captures cross-modal dependencies, ensuring the framework fully exploits the inherent complementary nature of multi-sensor inputs.

AI.tldr: 提出CRUISE框架，利用视觉语言模型（VLM）引导生成像素级不确定性估计，并引入动态自适应机制建模跨模态依赖，以提升自动驾驶中跨模态传感器融合在复杂分布外场景下的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有不确定性感知的跨模态融合方法仅依赖简单的特征级不确定性估计，难以在复杂分布外场景中有效泛化；多传感器在不同驾驶条件下的可靠性差异显著，需要更精细的不确定性引导来实现稳健融合。
AI.method: CRUISE框架包含两个核心组件：(1) VLM引导的不确定性量化模块，利用VLM丰富的先验知识和上下文推理能力生成细粒度、像素级的不确定性估计，为融合过程提供高信息量的引导；(2) 动态自适应机制，显式建模和捕捉跨模态依赖关系，充分发挥多传感器输入的互补特性。
AI.result: 通过VLM引导生成像素级不确定性估计替代传统特征级估计，并利用动态自适应机制建模跨模态依赖，在复杂分布外场景下实现更鲁棒的融合性能。
AI.conclusion: CRUISE通过VLM引导的精细不确定性量化与动态跨模态依赖建模，显著提升了自动驾驶跨模态融合在恶劣环境下的泛化能力和鲁棒性。

title: Multi-Agent AI Safety as an Institutional Design Problem
comment: 17 pages, 5 figures. Code and reproducibility artifacts available in the public POLIS repository
summary: AI agents increasingly work inside systems that govern how they delegate tasks, move information, execute actions, and use shared resources. Recent work already shows that deployment rules can change collective behavior. Here we ask which parts of an AI institution produce safety and how they do it. This is the first paper from POLIS, an ongoing research programme studying algorithmic institutions for multi-agent systems. We report a frozen 5,280-episode study suite. The main pre-specified delegation experiment spans four model families; a targeted high-conflict diagnostic adds three additional model endpoints. In matched structured workflows, the model sees different rule formulations and guards consult different authority states. We also vary the attractiveness of the immediate compliant internal/self fallback and allow blocked workflows to continue. A detailed constitutional prompt produces 0/384 realized violations. A provenance-aware executable guard also produces 0/384, although it blocks prohibited attempts in 51/384 episodes; 44/51 of those episodes later complete safely. The local-state guard's failures concentrate in scenarios where an ordinary transformation changes visible policy while originating authority stays fixed. In matched laundering scenarios, that guard admits violations in 22/96 episodes and provenance enforcement in 0/96 (p = 4.77 x 10^-7).
